descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) organization is seeking an experienced governance/company secretariat professional to support regulated financial services entities in North America & Europe. The successful candidate will join the RCS team, working with NA & UK Boards of Directors comprised of internal senior leaders and Senior Management to ensure regulatory compliance.
This role serves as the single-threaded governance owner for several regulated legal entities across NA and EU, owning end-to-end governance processes including operational and strategic workstreams. As a subject matter expert, this person uses expertise and judgment to influence senior stakeholders, drive strategic outcomes, and implement long-term solutions ensuring compliance, mitigating risks, and driving informed decision-making. The role provides governance oversight of regional expansions, navigating complex governance-related laws and regulations across jurisdictions for scalable business growth, delivering independently while seeking direction as needed on ambiguous initiatives where problems or strategies may be undefined.

Key job responsibilities
• Act as dedicated governance advisor, advising on complex matters and providing expert guidance on governance obligations, compliance, board composition, and roles to support Boards and Senior Management in discharging their responsibilities and compliance objectives—using expertise and judgment to enhance governance processes, determine goals, and inform decisions
• Lead development, review, and enhancement of governance frameworks through independent deep dives and industry benchmarking—designing tailored policies aligned with regulatory requirements, business needs, and diverse legal environments while drafting, implementing, and delivering charters, accountability matrices, terms of reference, policies, and procedures in partnership with Risk, Compliance, and Legal
• Manage the full lifecycle of Board and Management meetings—including scheduling, crafting agendas, guiding paper content preparation, conducting quality assurance reviews to ensure comprehensive and accurate materials for efficient oversight and decision-making, and managing minute-taking and action items
• Navigate complex governance challenges, influence key decisions, and earn leadership trust
• In collaboration with senior leaders, EU CCO & MLRO, Head of NA Risk & Compliance, Legal, and Tax partners, lead the appointment and onboarding of new Board members and provide oversight of board changes, nominations, and appointments
• Ensure the delivery of comprehensive training and induction programs for newly appointed Board and Committee members—ensuring they receive tailored onboarding materials, understand their fiduciary duties and regulatory obligations, and are equipped to effectively discharge their governance responsibilities
• Partner with Compliance and Legal on the appointment of internal control functions (CCO, CISO), ensuring regulatory compliance and alignment with organizational governance standards
• Own oversight of Governance-related KPIs and projects, presenting metrics to Senior Leadership during Board and Committee meetings, developing structured approaches to Board decisions and documentation, and ensuring senior managers across three lines of defense fulfill governance responsibilities
• Maintain comprehensive understanding of each entity's structure, operations, compliance, and risk posture, anticipating challenges and opportunities while ensuring effective communication and escalation of key issues and mitigating long-term risks
• Drive initiatives to streamline and enhance governance processes, fostering transparency and accountability within the organization
• Oversee all governance workstreams and expansions in the EU & NA regions, scaling frameworks across jurisdictions while managing several entities—applying strategic thinking to collaborate cross-functionally with Heads of Risk and Compliance, Chief Compliance Officers, and Legal partners to onboard new entities through in-depth analysis, leading discussions to develop optimal governance while handling complexity of comprehending constitutional laws and cross-checking governance regulations across jurisdictions

A day in the life
The Senior Governance Manager is responsible for supporting licensed legal entities across the NA and EU regions, with focus of ensuring, inter-alia, the following:
• Entities are operating according to high corporate governance standards, and in line with the governance regulatory requirements imposed by their respective jurisdictions
• The Boards of Directors as governing bodies of these Entities, have well-defined and documented roles and responsibilities, and are providing effective oversight and direction for these entities
• Adequate governance and secretarial support are provided to Boards and Committees and is standardized across all Entities.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Governance, Company Secretariat, compliance program management, legal, or equivalent relevant experience with deep understanding of corporate governance frameworks and regulatory environments (ideally with NA and EU experience)
- Experience handling confidential information and advising senior leaders and stakeholders across regions in rapidly changing, growth-oriented environments
- Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex governance portfolios, handle complex problems, decisions, and escalations, and deliver in ambiguous or evolving regulatory environments
- Strong multi-tasking, problem-solving, and ability to make trade-offs between short and long-term needs with experience designing long-term solutions and leading end-to-end delivery
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
- Ability to work within matrix environments, cross-functionally, across time zones, independently and as a team with high energy, creativity, and entrepreneurial spirit

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Governance or Company Secretariat experience in financial services
- Professionally qualified Chartered Secretary, Governance Professional, or equivalent qualification
- Experience working across multiple jurisdictions with diverse regulatory environments

title: Data Center Manager
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for a Data Center Operations Manager to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team in one of our sites.

We are currently expanding our infrastructure management team and we are looking for a manager with experience in people leadership, a strong technical understanding of IT operations, and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations into the future.

Data Center Manager is the leadership role for our compute operations teams within an AWS region. They will have managerial responsibility for safety, security, availability, scaling, costs and efficiency for their department. They lead the team that is installing, maintaining, and de-commissioning network and server equipment in a safe, secure and cost-effective manner across the region. The Data Center Operations Manager must manage across each function but also have the ability to dive deep into any given function as needed.

The successful candidate will be a highly driven, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks solutions to problems. The candidate will have an understanding of network and compute architecture and have experience managing repair requests in a high volume environment, as well as managing response to high severity events. They will have a strong track record of developing talent, and managing performance of their team and organization. They will be creating, tracking and controlling budgets; strategically planning through use of metrics; sponsoring, reporting and delivering large projects while proposing technical solutions to complicated problems. This position requires a candidate with the proven ability to drive continuous improvement and the ability to keep pace with our explosive growth while motivating others to meet the challenges of an extremely deadline-driven environment. While not required, an understanding of critical Electrical & HVAC systems is desired.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
· Lead and supervise a team of Data Center Technicians which is installing, maintaining and decommissioning network and server hardware
· Oversee the safety, security, availability, quality, and performance of the team, while driving a positive customer experience
· Strategic planning and forecasting; manage team and individual performance; delivering performance reviews, and address staffing needs
· Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures
· Mentor, train and develop career progression for direct reports and members of the organization
· Obsess over team learning and development, both from a technical/functional and soft skills (critical thinking, emotional intelligence, and adaptability) development perspective
· Coordinate support of change management resources in partnership with electrical and mechanical operations teams
· Develop, improve, and share operational best practices across the region and with peers globally

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in IT operations or similar roles
- Experience managing teams
- Team, organizational and planning skills
- Proven track record of success in delivering complex projects
- Prior ownership of the operation of a mission-critical team and/or product
- Ability to consistently deliver results despite competing priorities and distractions

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of cumulative experience with information technology infrastructure domains such as compute server platforms, storage server platforms, server components, network devices, cabling best practices and IT service delivery principles and best practices
- Understanding of critical Electrical, HVAC and control systems
- Capacity planning and budgetary experience.
- Data Center experience

title: Fire Protection Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to apply your fire protection expertise to data center infrastructure that operates at a global scale? Are you excited about expanding your knowledge of building systems while contributing insights from your previous experience?

In this role, you will influence all aspects of fire protection design, construction, operations, and maintenance for our data centers. This includes fire suppression, fire detection, fire alarm, and mass notification systems, as well as fire-resistant construction and life safety. You will work with internal and external teams to define, design, detail, and document the fire protection features our facilities require, using both prescriptive and performance-based design approaches. You will contribute your expertise to the continual improvement of our fire protection design standards, ensuring our buildings protect people and keep our customers' data safe and uninterrupted over the life of each facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and oversee fire water service infrastructure, including water supply analysis, coordination with utilities and fire officials, and establishing site-level requirements for fire protection systems.
- Review concept designs and construction documents from third-party vendors to verify compliance with established design standards, local codes, National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) standards, International Code Council (ICC) requirements, and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) expectations.
- Prepare prescriptive and performance-based designs for building fire suppression, alarm, and detection systems, and coordinate fire protection system space requirements, supporting utilities, and equipment locations.
- Collaborate with construction, commissioning, operations, and risk management teams to resolve requests for information, value engineering queries, and technical questions throughout the project lifecycle.
- Drive improvement of fire protection design standards and standard configuration templates across the organization, simplifying and strengthening systems with each iteration.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing active project designs, checking that fire protection elements meet our standards and local code requirements. You may join a cross-functional call with architects, mechanical engineers, and construction managers to align on system layouts for a new build, then shift to evaluating a vendor's submittal package for a fire alarm system. In the afternoon, you might prepare a performance-based design analysis or meet with local fire officials to secure approval of fire protection features. Throughout, you will mentor teammates and share lessons learned to improve quality across the team.

About the team
Our Data Center Design Engineering team includes architects, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, fire protection, and controls engineers working together to design the next generation of data centers at Amazon. We are committed to delivering world-class uptime for our customers and we build facilities that emphasize security, safety, and efficiency while meeting growing demand. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to directly impact our business and contribute to continuous advancements in how we design and build infrastructure at scale.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience in commissioning
- 5+ years of data center engineering or operations, or 2+ years of construction or project management experience
- 5+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
- Licensed Fire Protection Engineer

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
- Experience in engineering, designing, or constructing data centers

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Site Operations Leader, 1MHS - Field Fixed
descriptionHtml:
As a Site Operations Leader within the OneMHS Installation & Deployment (I&D) team, you will serve as the central engineering coordinator for large-scale material handling equipment (MHE) installation projects in greenfield and brownfield Amazon fulfillment environments. You will work directly alongside installation teams on active construction sites, owning the project schedule and coordinating all on-site project teams, sub-team leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver complex MHE systems from equipment receipt through commissioning.

You will independently manage the project schedule, procurement workflows, equipment logistics, and budget administration for MHE installation projects ranging from $50M to $100M+ in scope. Working directly with mechanical installation leads, electrical installation leads, controls engineers, commissioning teams, and external MHE vendors, you will be the single-threaded owner for site-level coordination — ensuring all teams are aligned, resources are sequenced correctly, and the project stays on track.

This is a field-based engineering role embedded within active construction sites. You will operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where you proactively identify schedule risks, resolve inter-team dependencies, and drive continuous improvement in how Amazon deploys MHE systems at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Project Coordination & Schedule Management
• Own and maintain the project schedule for MHE installation across assigned greenfield and brownfield sites
• Coordinate daily activities across all on-site project teams including mechanical installation, electrical installation, controls integration, and commissioning
• Serve as the central point of coordination between sub-team leaders, ensuring work sequences are properly phased and resource conflicts are resolved
• Lead daily site coordination meetings to align all installation teams on priorities, constraints, and upcoming milestones
• Track critical path items across all sub-teams and proactively identify and mitigate schedule risks
• Manage inter-team dependencies — ensuring predecessor work is complete before successor teams mobilize
• Coordinate site access timelines, aligning MHE first access dates with installation and commissioning schedules
• Create and maintain integrated project schedules coordinating engineering, supply chain, construction, and commissioning timelines
• Monitor and report KPIs for schedule adherence, budget performance, and installation progress
Site Logistics & Material Coordination
• Coordinate MHE equipment storage, sequencing, and shipment logistics between manufacturers, third-party storage facilities, and installation sites
• Manage equipment inventory tracking across active construction sites to ensure installation teams have materials staged and ready
• Engineer receiving and staging plans for MHE components including unloading coordination, inventory verification, and sequenced material placement
• Develop and maintain receiving instructions and standard operating procedures for installation crews
• Deploy and manage construction monitoring systems for progress documentation
• Coordinate asset tracking technology deployments to maintain visibility of MHE components through the installation lifecycle
• Ensure compliance with Amazon safety standards and construction site safety requirements during all installation activities
Procurement & Financial Management
• Own procurement workflows including purchase order creation, change order controls, and invoice management via Coupa
• Manage project budgets, tracking spend against approved allocations
• Develop and track financial reporting for assigned projects, providing regular budget status updates to leadership
• Coordinate with Global Procurement Organization (GPO) on vendor work allocation decisions and procurement strategies
• Create financial justification documents for equipment purchases and technology investments
• Support development of procurement and logistics strategies for large-scale multi-site deployments
Vendor Coordination & Management
• Serve as primary operational point of contact for MHE vendors on assigned sites
• Coordinate vendor equipment delivery schedules, milestone tracking, and change request alignment
• Lead vendor schedule review meetings and drive resolution of schedule conflicts between vendor and internal installation teams
• Manage vendor work allocation processes, ensuring clear scope definitions between self-perform and contracted work
• Support cross-vendor coordination for integrated installation projects involving multiple equipment suppliers
• Track and manage vendor change requests, ensuring proper documentation and financial alignment
Technical Documentation & Standards
• Develop and maintain cross-vendor work instructions for MHE installation activities
• Create and manage engineering documentation including receiving instructions, site logistics plans, and installation SOPs
• Support development of installation training materials and engineering standards documentation
• Contribute to drawing standards and layout reviews for MHE installation projects
• Participate in design reviews supporting execution between internal teams and outside vendors
• Maintain project documentation in alignment with I&D engineering team standards and best practices
Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
• Communicate project schedule status, risks, and team coordination updates to engineering leadership
• Participate in Daily Business Reviews (DBRs) providing installation progress updates on safety, job plans, and team readiness
• Support Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) with MHE vendor partners covering risks, schedules, commercials, and capacity
• Contribute to Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) with project-level metrics and milestones
• Provide technical input to leadership for data-driven decision-making
• Produce regular status summaries covering team progress, schedule variance, and resource utilization
• Identify and escalate inter-team conflicts, resource constraints, and schedule risks in a timely manner
• Support achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned sites


A day in the life
A typical day for a Site Operations Leader begins with the daily site coordination meeting,
aligning mechanical, electrical, and controls teams on priorities and resolving any
sequencing conflicts. From there, you're walking the active construction site - verifying
material staging, checking that equipment deliveries match the schedule, and
troubleshooting any gaps holding up installation crews. Mid-day often involves vendor
schedule reviews, Coupa procurement actions, and updating the project schedule with
progress from each sub-team. You close out by flagging risks in the DBR, coordinating nextday
material needs, and ensuring every team has what they need to stay on track.

About the team
OneMHS (One Material Handling Systems) is Amazon's in-house program for designing,
procuring, and installing material handling equipment across its fulfillment network. Rather
than relying solely on external integrators, OneMHS brings the full lifecycle of MHE
deployment under Amazon's direct control - from final engineering and equipment
procurement through mechanical and electrical installation, controls integration, and
commissioning. The program supports both greenfield builds and brownfield retrofits,
deploying conveyor systems, sorters, induction systems, and robotic work cells at scale.
OneMHS enables Amazon to deliver faster, more cost-effective installations while
maintaining higher quality and safety standards.

Team is able to hire anywhere in the USA.

Basic qualifications

title: Engineering Operation Technician, AWS Support
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Physical Requirements:
• Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
• Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
• Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
• Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


Key job responsibilities
• Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
• Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
• Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
• Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
• Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
• Technical writing to support change management program
• Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
• On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
• Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
• Role may support more than one location/site.


A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical or mechanical, or 1+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience
- High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience

title: Security Engineer , Region Services
descriptionHtml:
G'day! You've found an opportunity that could define your next chapter.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/.

Based in Melbourne - we offer relocation support for candidates moving other states.

The Mission - Why This Program, Why Now?

You're joining at the defining moment of one of the most significant technology programs Australia has ever undertaken. This program will build and operate the dedicated cloud giving Australia's national security community and its allies the capability to see more, share more, innovate and act faster than ever before.

The architectural decisions being made now - how we structure networking, implement security controls, and automate at scale - will shape how Australia's national security community operates for the next decade. You won't be inheriting someone else's design choices. You'll be making them.

Your Role - Security Engineer, Region Services

AWS Region Services delivers innovations ranging from foundational services, such as Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), to new products and features that distinguish AWS in the industry. As a member of Region Services, you will contribute to the security and operational management of AWS compute, database, storage, Internet of Things (IoT), platform and productivity application services, including supporting customers that require specialised security solutions for their cloud environments.

Our Region Services team redefines how AWS designs, builds and operates AWS Regions, enabling new cloud infrastructure and service offerings for customers of all sizes across every industry, including start-ups, enterprises and public sector organisations.

AWS Region Services is recruiting Security Engineers to lead and contribute to the onboarding and assurance of regional cloud services in Australia. Successful candidates will be analytical problem-solvers who take ownership of complex technical and security challenges. They will have a strong understanding of security risk assessment (SRA), cloud-native technologies and software development, as well as experience with enterprise gateways and data-transfer solutions. This unique team provides opportunities to work with more than 100 AWS commercial service teams globally.

Are you ready to be the person Australia's national security community trusts to get this right?

Key job responsibilities
You'll be the security authority that bridges global AWS innovation with Australia's sovereign requirements — and the impact of your work will be felt across an entire nation's security apparatus.

• Lead security onboarding and assurance for region-specific cloud services, designing scalable mechanisms that ensure the operational readiness of regional AWS infrastructure.
• Engineer and automate security-control onboarding and validation for cloud services and data-transfer pathways using scalable checks and risk-reduction mechanisms.
• Review technical designs, architectures, code, configurations, technical documentation and structured data schemas and transformations (JSON, JSON Schema, XML, XSD, XSLT and XPath), providing actionable engineering guidance to meet regional security requirements.
• Partner with service teams and customers to translate security requirements into technical baselines, control objectives, implementation patterns and measurable acceptance criteria.
• Develop reusable security tooling and mechanisms that reduce manual effort and improve the consistency of service onboarding and assurance.
• Automate security evidence collection, control testing, policy validation and reporting across AWS environments.
• Lead security assessments of data-flow controls, integrating automated assurance with audit frameworks and continuous monitoring.
• Engineer and maintain secure data-transfer patterns, guardrails and reference implementations for services operating in the region.
• Build and maintain security metrics, dashboards and alarms to measure control effectiveness, identify risks and detect non-conformance.
• Investigate security events and instances of non-conformance, determine root causes and implement durable corrective and preventive solutions through automation.
• Evaluate and apply generative AI, AI agents and multi-agent workflows to modernise security engineering processes while maintaining appropriate security controls and human oversight.
• Develop customer-facing technical documentation and provide strategic security guidance to customers, engineers and service teams.
• Work with global service teams to identify product improvements, design scalable solutions and manage security feature requests.
• Deliver maintainable, well-documented engineering solutions under tight deadlines, with a high standard of accuracy and operational excellence.
• Participate in the on-call rotation and improve operational mechanisms based on lessons learned from security events.
• Interpret and apply Australian security frameworks, including the ISM, PSPF and DSPF, to engineer security baselines and controls that achieve the required security posture.


A day in the life
Your day balances strategic security oversight with hands-on engineering. You review service designs, structured data schemas and security submissions; automate control validation and evidence collection; conduct onboarding assessments for regional cloud services; and work with service teams to establish security baselines and control objectives. You may also lead assessments of data-flow controls, investigate instances of non-conformance and engineer durable remediation across AWS environments.

You partner with global service teams to improve products and security mechanisms, develop reusable tooling and patterns, and manage feature requests. You communicate security outcomes to diverse stakeholders, maintain customer-facing documentation and participate in the on-call rotation to support the continuous operational readiness of regional infrastructure.


About the team
AWS Region Services provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS's services and features apart in the industry. As a member of Region Services, you will contribute to the security and operational management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialised security solutions for their cloud services.

Our Region Services team redefines the way AWS designs, builds, and operates AWS regions to enable new AWS Cloud Infrastructure and Services offerings to customers across every industry and of every size, including start-ups, enterprises, and public sector organisations.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Benefits
- Learning & development - AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.
- Health, income protection and life cover - Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you.
- Military differential pay launching in Australia - Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving.
- Employee Assistance Program - Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family - mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.
- Family-building benefit - Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching.
- Amazon Extras & employee discount - cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of industry-based security vulnerabilities and remediation techniques
- Experience in scripting, programming, and security code reviewing in a common programming language (non-internship)
- Experience in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating basic tasks using command line tools (non-internship experience)
- 3+ years of IT Security experience
- Experience securing cloud software services and understanding design for scalability, performance and reliability
- Experience in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of any combination of the following: threat modeling experience, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security experience
- Experience performing security activities across one or more phases of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), such as security design review, threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing
- Experience in application security architecture, security code reviews, security testing, incident response, or security infrastructure
- Experience in one or more of the following: Big Data, DevOps, Security, Systems Administration, software development, cloud technology
- Experience with automation and any version control tools, or experience with threat modeling and penetration testing and experience in Kafka
- Experience working directly with security and engineering teams

title: Infrastructure Technical Program Manager, Interconnect Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) is the backbone that connects the global AWS network. It is dedicated to facilitating the internet traffic that allows users to access their information and applications regardless of where they are in the world. GCNA is also responsible for building and designing a complex backbone network that allows internet traffic to flow efficiently between Data Centers and customers.

The Interconnect team is responsible for delivering the interconnect capacity connecting the Amazon network to the internet.

- Create and maintain APIs that enable analytics teams and data scientists to query log-level data efficiently

- Implement data quality checks, validation logic, and monitoring for data pipelines and services

- Optimize performance and cost efficiency of data processing jobs and queries

- Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews to maintain high engineering standards

- Collaborate with senior engineers to contribute to design discussions and architectural decisions

- Debug and resolve production issues, participating in on-call rotations as needed

- Document systems, processes, and runbooks to support operational excellence

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

title: Finance Manager, Prime Video APAC
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video Marketing is entering a defining chapter. Over the next three years, our content slate scales meaningfully, and marketing must grow its impact faster than its budget. Getting there depends on making sharper investment choices — concentrating spend behind the biggest opportunities, rebalancing toward high-growth markets, building scalable channels, and reinvesting automation-driven savings into working media. Finance is central to making those choices with rigor and conviction.
We are looking for a Finance Manager to serve as the finance business partner to Prime Video Marketing across the APAC region, working alongside the APAC Marketing Director (based in Mumbai). This is first and foremost a strategic business partnering role: you will shape investment decisions, drive allocation rigor, and own the measurement that connects marketing spend to customer and business outcomes. You will also partner closely with Worldwide Prime Video Marketing Finance and the Worldwide Marketing team to align on approach and ensure regional plans and learnings connect to the global picture.
This is a builder’s role at the intersection of finance, marketing, and technology — helping deliver the multi-year marketing strategy, not just report on it.


Key job responsibilities
- Strategic business partnering: The trusted finance partner to the APAC Marketing Director and marketing leaders, bringing financial framing and a clear "so what" to decisions across the region.
- Investment decisions and allocation: Drive rigor in how marketing invests — translating growth opportunity, revenue per subscriber, and effectiveness into a defensible allocation across markets, channels, and titles, and calibrating targets to performance.
- Measurement and ROI: Own the financial view of marketing effectiveness and return, standardizing metrics (ROAS, cost per incremental outcome, incrementality) to shift spend toward the highest return.
- Marketing efficiency: Help the business do more with each dollar and reduce the cost of getting marketing to market.
- Planning: Support OP1/OP2 and long-range planning, coordinating inputs and co-authoring leadership narratives.
- Enabling AI-driven outcomes: The business builds the AI; Finance ensures the intended outcomes and savings land, and is AI-savvy enough to build the dashboards the business needs.
- Vendor and agency economics: Evaluate fees and vendor selection and quantify build-vs-buy trade-offs.
- Worldwide partnership: Align methodology with WW PV Marketing Finance and Marketing and connect regional plans to the global view.
- Reporting: Consolidate APAC inputs into a single view; lead close and variance analysis.
- Process improvement: Drive automation across consolidation and reporting.

A day in the life
- You partner with marketing leaders across APAC to pressure-test investment decisions, reallocating toward the outcomes and markets where each dollar works hardest.
- You surface insights on efficiency, incrementality, and return, and bring a crisp point of view to management.
- You build and maintain the dashboards and views — increasingly using AI-enabled tooling — that give the business timely visibility into marketing performance and efficiency.
- You work with vendor, agency, and automation stakeholders to sharpen the economics of how marketing is produced and delivered.
- You act as the connective tissue between APAC marketing teams, Worldwide Marketing Finance, and regional finance — ensuring marketing financials are accurate, consistent, and clearly communicated.

About the team
This role sits within APAC Prime Video Finance, part of Prime Video International Finance. We operate as business partners who shape investment decisions — not scorekeepers — bringing financial credibility and a business-partnership mindset to how marketing invests across the region. The role works closely with Worldwide Prime Video Marketing Finance and business team as key partners. AI and automation are a growing part of how marketing operates; the business team, with Product & Tech, develops these capabilities, and Finance partners with them to ensure the intended outcomes are realized and measured. Mumbai-based, collaborating across time zones.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science), or Master's degree (MBA or related discipline)
- Experience applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses, or experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

Preferred qualifications

- CMA or CPA, or MBA in finance, accounting or related field
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience in commercial finance business partnering or FP&A (at a multinational organisation), including influencing senior business partners and challenging assumptions
- Experience analyzing data quantitatively and using customer research, data and metrics to back up assumptions, identifying opportunities, and assessing the efficacy of marketing programs
- Experience in similar environments, or experience working with and managing third party vendors

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Principal, Category Leader to own and scale our ''Low ASP (Average Selling Price)'' program and other strategic cross-border initiatives across the MEA region. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role at the center of one of the fastest-growing portfolios in the MEA XB organization — spanning emerging marketplaces (Egypt, KSA) where the Low ASP opportunity is reshaping how customers discover and buy affordable selection.

You will set the strategic direction, own the P&L, and lead the end-to-end execution of the Low ASP program — building the selection, pricing, CX, and economics that unlock mass-market affordability for millions of customers. You will operate as a general manager: defining the 3-year vision, writing the narratives that align senior leadership, and driving cross-functional teams across Selection, Pricing, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Tech to deliver outsized growth.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Vision
- Own the long-term (3YF) strategy and annual operating plan (OP1/OP2) for the Low ASP program across MEA emerging marketplaces.
- Define the Low ASP customer value proposition and the strategic levers — unified fulfillment/shipping (FST), selection rigor, fee structure, and personalization — that drive sustainable, profitable growth.
- Develop the units + incrementality framework to measure true program impact and inform investment decisions.

P&L & Business Ownership
- Own the Low ASP P&L end to end — volume, revenue, contribution profit, and the path to profitability.
- Lead volume modeling, cold-start/CPI solutions, and marketing investment reviews to balance growth and economics.
- Build the business cases and financial models that justify investment and sequence the roadmap.

Selection & Pricing
- Build an affordable, locally relevant selection strategy tailored to price-sensitive customers.
- Partner with Pricing and Fees teams to design a competitive, sustainable fee and pricing structure for Low ASP selection.
- Drive selection expansion through vendor, 3P seller, and cross-border sourcing programs.

Customer Experience
- Define and improve the Low ASP CX mental model — from discovery and basket building to delivery and returns.
- Partner with Tech and Product on CX weblabs, personalization (CAS), and the mobile shopping experience for emerging-market customers.

Cross-Functional Leadership
- Lead a matrixed team across Selection, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, and Tech without always owning direct reporting lines.
- Write and present 6-pagers, business/weekly reviews (WBR/MBR), and strategic narratives to senior leadership (VP/SVP level).
- Influence partner teams and secure prioritization for the program roadmap.

Operational Excellence
- Establish the metrics, mechanisms, and cadences (WBR, MBR, deep dives) to run the business and drive accountability.
- Identify and remove bottlenecks across the fulfillment and selection pipeline.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of team leadership experience

- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- Experience using complex financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to inform strategic business decisions and influence cross-functional stakeholders, with proven business impact (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits), or experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field

descriptionHtml:
The Strategic Engagement Leader is a senior individual contributor and the Europe South Area Sales Director's strategic right hand for the Enterprise (ENT) and Public Sector (PS) business. The role exists to extend the Area Sales Director's reach and effectiveness: turning strategic intent into coordinated action across the sales organisation, keeping the most important priorities moving, and creating leverage so the leader can focus on where they add the most value. It is a broad, trusted role that sits close to the leader rather than a narrow specialist one, and it operates through influence, not through a management chain.


Key job responsibilities
A central part of the role is strategic deal engagement. The Strategic Engagement Leader helps the team crack the portfolio's most difficult deals by engaging on the highest-complexity pursuits (multi-party, cross-segment, CxO-level) where senior air cover, deal strategy, or executive credibility is needed to unlock progress. This is done through the team, not around them; the role does not own accounts and demonstrates impact by assisting in unblocking deals across the portfolio.
Beyond individual deals, the role orchestrates the priorities and operating rhythm of the ENT and PS business on the Area Sales Director's behalf. This includes preparing the leader for key customer, partner, and internal engagements; following through on the decisions and commitments that come out of them; connecting workstreams that span multiple teams; and making sure the right people are aligned and the right actions are progressing between formal reviews. The role represents the Area Sales Director in selected forums and carries context across the organisation so that execution does not stall.
The role also drives sales best practices operationally, cascading expectations rather than managing performance. It sets the bar on deal qualification, pipeline discipline, account-planning rigour, and competitive execution standards, while sales managers remain accountable for delivering against those standards. It acts as a bridge between Europe South field execution and EMEA-level best practices, connecting with the EMEA partner and specialist organisations (for example the EMEA PDM organisation and the WWSO GTM specialists) to import and localise proven co-sell motions, including the Anthropic and OpenAI partner motions where multi-party orchestration is most valuable.
This is an influence role. Authority comes from expertise, credibility, and the Area Sales Director's mandate, not from a management chain, and its leverage comes from raising the whole organisation's execution bar. Success depends on trust, judgement, and the ability to operate across organisational boundaries, and the role must be protected from being pulled into day-to-day operational execution so that it stays focused on the priorities that matter most to the Area Sales Director.

About the team
The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Telecommunication Sector. The position is classified at level Quadro or above, depending on the candidate’s skills, competences and experience.
Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL per i dipendenti di imprese esercenti servizi di telecomunicazione. La posizione è inquadrata al livello Quadro o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

Basic qualifications

- experience in enterprise technology sales, business development, sales strategy, or a comparable role working closely with senior sales leadership.
- Demonstrated experience engaging and influencing at C-level (CIO, CTO, CDO, CFO, CEO) on a regular basis.
- Experience shaping and supporting high-complexity pursuits that are multi-party and/or cross-segment.
- Experience in book building, sales, or technology business development (BD) roles, or a comparable prior strategic-engagement or deal-shaping role.
- Experience coordinating priorities and driving execution across multiple teams without formal line-management authority, operating primarily through influence.
- Fluent English speaker and writer (spoken and written), able to shape and articulate CxO-level commercial and technical narratives with clarity and precision.

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in enterprise sales, sales strategy and operations, strategic deal engagement, or technology BD, including senior roles working directly alongside a sales leader.
- Prior experience acting as a senior leader's trusted right hand, coordinating priorities, preparing the leader for key engagements, and following through on decisions across an organisation.
- Experience in both Enterprise and Public Sector environments, including familiarity with public-sector procurement, sovereignty, and multi-party partner dynamics.
- Experience with co-sell motions and partner-led deals, ideally including GenAI or ISV partner motions (for example Anthropic and OpenAI) requiring multi-party orchestration.
- Strong command of sales mechanisms (deal qualification frameworks, pipeline discipline, and account-planning rigour), with a proven ability to cascade and raise execution standards across a sales organisation.
- Cloud, SaaS, or emerging-technology (GenAI) domain expertise, with credibility to shape CxO-level technical and commercial conversations.
- Experience operating across a matrixed, multi-country organisation (EMEA or Europe South) and importing best practices across areas.
- Professional working proficiency in Italian and Spanish.

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities
* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees
- Experience with process improvements (Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma)
- Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Industry experience in: retail, F&B, military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production or distribution environments.

title: Machine Shop Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced Machine Shop Manager to own and operate the rapid prototyping shop at our Boston Development Center. As the leader for precision fabrication and additive manufacturing, you own end-to-end execution of machined and 3D-printed components that drive our hardware development. This is a prototype shop: short-run, high-mix. Most jobs are unique, every setup matters, and the engineering team's development velocity depends on what leaves the shop each week.

You will manage the full scope of shop operations, multi-axis CNC milling and turning, manual/conventional machining, and industrial 3D printing (metal and polymer). You will hire and develop a team of CNC programmers, precision machinists, and additive manufacturing technicians, set the schedule, and work directly with design and manufacturing engineers to keep first-piece quality high and turnaround tight. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who came up through programming and machining and is still credible at the CAM seat and on the shop floor.

Key job responsibilities
- Own day-to-day machine shop operations end-to-end: job scheduling, work prioritization, resource allocation, and throughput management across CNC machining and additive manufacturing equipment.

- Hire, develop, and manage a team of CNC machinists, CNC programmers, and additive manufacturing technicians. Set performance expectations, coach development, and hold the team accountable for safety, quality, and delivery.

- Manage job queues across multiple concurrent engineering programs, prioritize work to maximize throughput and minimize lead time, balancing urgent R&D prototype requests with operational tooling and fixture needs. Implement job routing and tracking workflows to manage the high-mix, rapid-turnaround queue.

- Work directly with product design and manufacturing engineers to review part designs, advise on manufacturability (DFM), select machining strategies, and ensure first-piece quality meets drawing requirements.

- Oversee CNC programming (CAM), setup verification, first-piece inspection, in-process checks, tool offsets, and changeovers. Troubleshoot machining issues related to programming, tooling, workholding, dimensional variation, and surface finish.

- Manage 3D printing / additive manufacturing operations, job scheduling, material management, build parameter optimization, and post-processing for both metal and polymer systems.

- Drive performance metrics: on-time delivery, first-piece quality, throughput, machine utilization, scrap rate. Use data to identify improvement opportunities and report shop performance to leadership.

- Ensure safety and housekeeping standards are maintained, 5S, PPE compliance, machine guarding, and EHS requirements for a machining and additive manufacturing environment.

- Own equipment maintenance, calibration, and uptime. Evaluate and recommend capital expenditure for new machines, tooling, fixtures, and measurement equipment as the shop scales.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in engineering team management
- Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field; OR equivalent practical experience with Journeyman Machinist certification or relevant technical/trade degree.
- 7+ years of CNC machining experience, with at least 3 years leading or managing a machine shop team (machinists and/or programmers).
- Hands-on background as a CNC programmer or machinist who moved into management — still credible on the floor and at the CAM seat.
- Proficiency with CAM software (Mastercam, Fusion 360, NX CAM, or equivalent) and CNC controls (Fanuc, Siemens, Haas).
- Direct experience with 5-axis machining strategy, workholding design, and complex setup troubleshooting.
- Experience in prototype, high-mix, or short-run machining environments where turnaround time and first-piece quality are critical.
- Strong knowledge of GD&T, blueprint interpretation, and precision measuring tools (micrometers, calipers, indicators, CMM).
- Experience with additive manufacturing / 3D printing operations (metal and/or polymer systems).

Preferred qualifications

- 12+ years of machining experience with progressive leadership responsibilities in advanced hardware, aerospace, robotics, or R&D prototype environments.
- Experience managing both CNC machining and additive manufacturing operations under one roof.
- Experience setting up a machine shop from the ground up — including equipment selection, facility layout, rigging, installation, and building the team in a startup or scale-up environment.
- Capital equipment management experience — building business cases for new machine tools, tooling, and shop infrastructure.
- Experience with metal additive manufacturing (DMLS/SLM) and post-processing workflows.
- Strong understanding of material properties including advanced alloys, tool steels, titanium, stainless steel, aluminum, and engineering polymers commonly used in robotics and electromechanical assemblies.
- Lean manufacturing or continuous improvement experience applied to job-shop environments.

title: Data Center Technical Support Engineering Operations Engineer, BJS - DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services Infrastructure Services team provides comprehensive technical support throughout the design, planning, delivery, and operation of Amazon Web Services infrastructure. We support data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure the customers of Amazon Web Services have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations technical support managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across Amazon and our operating partners to help Amazon Web Services deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for the customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Facility Engineer will be responsible for providing technical support to Data Center Engineering Operations within data centers including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of data center infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.
基础设施技术支持主要负责支持数据中心的基础设施运维，包括对设施/系统存在的风险进行管理，提出缓解措施和改造方案，以及日常的基础设施的维护，供应商的管理，数据的整理归档汇报等。

Key job responsibilities
· Provide technical support for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
· Provide technical support for performance benchmarks establishment, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
· Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
· Work with DCO managers (IT) and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.

· Responsible for supporting the installation of the racks and the provision of power/cooling.
· Support the COLO management of both routine maintenance and emergency services on a variety of essential systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
· Assist in the design, implementation, commissioning and build out of new facilities.
· Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
· Assist in recruiting efforts.
· Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues.
· This role might involve covering 24x7 shift rotation

Maschinenbautechniker, Industriemeister Metall, Elektromeister) oder vergleichbare Fachkräfte als Teamleiter:in Instandhaltung (interne Bezeichnung: Sr. RME Technician) für unseren Logistikstandort in Gera gesucht! Falls Du für die Stelle umziehst und Deine Heimatadresse mindestens 80 km vom Standort entfernt ist, unterstützen wir Dich mit einem Umzugsbonus i. H. v. 6.045$.

Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist der Kern von Amazons Engagement für Innovation. Amazon entwickelt sich weiter und dieses Team sorgt dafür, dass dies auch die von uns verwendeten Technologien und Tools tun. Als Senior RME Technician hilfst Du uns, der Entwicklung einen Schritt voraus zu bleiben. Du setzt die neuesten Technologien ein und identifizierst neue, effiziente Arbeitsmethoden. In dieser Rolle achtest Du genau auf unsere Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere höchsten Sicherheitsstandards befolgen und weiter erhöhen.

*** Die Stelle beinhaltet die Arbeit in einem rotierenden Dreischichtsystem, welches Samstage, Nachtschichten sowie Rufbereitschaft umfassen kann. ***

Wir bieten:
- Einen unbefristeten Vertrag direkt mit Amazon
- Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket inklusive beschränkter Mitarbeiteraktien (Restricted Stock Units durch die Amazon.com, Inc.)
- Umzugsbonus: Bei min. 80 km Entfernung vom Standort, Umzugsbonus von 7.500$

- Hervorragende Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem globalen Unternehmen

Key job responsibilities
- Best Practice und Unterstützen im Bedienen von Geräten und Anlagen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards
- Verfolgen der Geräteleistung durch visuelle Prüfungen, zustandsorientierte Überwachung und vorbeugende Wartungsmaßnahmen und Einplanen zusätzlicher Wartung je nach Bedarf
- Verantwortung für das technische Team während seiner Schicht und dessen Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung
- Lösung von Problemen an Anlagen, um Betriebsausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und die schnellstmögliche Abfertigung von Paketen zu ermöglichen
- Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Systemen und Standardisierung von Prozessen im ganzen EU-Netzwerk

A day in the life


Du betreust ein Instandhaltungsteam innerhalb einer Schicht und sorgst dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden die erforderlichen Werkzeuge zur Verfügung haben und diese einwandfrei funktionieren. Das beinhaltet die Überwachung von Prozessen, damit Vorschriften und Richtlinien befolgt werden, ebenso wie die Gewährleistung der Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungsmaßnahmen, um die Betriebszeit unserer Anlagen zu maximieren. Durch Deine Beobachtungen während der Schichtarbeit machst Du Verbesserungsvorschläge, um unsere Systeme noch effizienter und produktiver zu gestalten, und setzt diese Verbesserungen EU-weit um. Außerdem nutzt Du Tools wie SCADA zur Überwachung von Prozessen, um deren Leistungsfähigkeit zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt administrative Aufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Führungskräften. Du arbeitest vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren. Du arbeitest in Schichtmodellen, die Nächte und Wochenenden umfassen können. Mit den Kenntnissen und Erfahrungen, die Du sammelst, wirst Du Dich zu weiteren Führungspositionen weiterentwickeln.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt. Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen. Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.
