title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Zamboni
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to solve solve business challenges through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services where your code has a direct, measurable impact?

The Zamboni team sits at the intersection of software and physical hardware, managing the fleet of custom Glacier storage units that power Amazon S3's cold storage at exabyte scale. As an SDE II on this team, you'll build and operate the NAWS-based automation that keeps 2,000+ Glacier storage units healthy across global regions — from firmware deployment pipelines to break-fix remediation workflows to the operator tooling that other teams rely on every day.

This is hands-on systems work with real stakes. When a Glacier storage unit goes offline in IAD, your code is part of the response. When a firmware rollout needs to scale across a global fleet, your automation makes it safe. You'll work closely to solve problems that span the full stack — from DynamoDB concurrency to custom storage hardware.

At Amazon, we hire engineers who think big and want to define what comes next. Every day brings new challenges, new skills, and the kind of growth that's hard to find elsewhere. If you want your software to directly impact infrastructure that millions of customers depend on, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate NAWS-based services (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS) that automate Glacier fleet operations including firmware deployment, library onboarding, hardware monitoring, and break-fix remediation
- Contribute to automation projects that reduce manual operational toil — including automated offline library remediation, drive blocklisting, stuck job workflows, and automated ticket escalation
- Build and maintain operator tooling and Fleet Commander integrations that enable safe, auditable fleet operations at scale
- Collaborate with hardware vendors (BDT, Quantum), DCO technicians, partner with other S3 Keystone and Glacier teams to design solutions that bridge software and physical hardware
- Participate in on-call rotations, respond to operational events, and drive improvements that reduce future toil
- Write high-quality Java/Python/Go code with infrastructure defined in CDK


A day in the life
On any given day you might be debugging why a firmware update stalled on a Glacier storage library in IAD, writing a new step function workflow to automate a remediation path, reviewing a design doc for the next phase of Fleet automation, or working through a tricky DynamoDB concurrency issue. The work spans from low-level hardware interactions to distributed NAWS service design. You'll be on-call, you'll ship real automation, and you'll see the direct impact of your work on Glacier storage fleet availability.

About the team
The Zamboni team, part of the S3 Moirai organization, owns the health and availability of Glacier's custom storage hardware: libraries, firmware, fleet automation, and the operator tooling that keeps Glacier running at 99.95% data availability across 12+ regions worldwide. We operate at the intersection of hardware and software, building NAWS-based services that manage a fleet of 2K+ Glacier storage libraries, collectively storing exabytes of customer data.

Our roadmap is ambitious: automated firmware qualification and deployment, predictive hardware monitoring, self-service tooling, and scaling fleet operations to 2X growth year-over-year. If you want to see your code directly impact a storage fleet at AWS scale, this is the team for you.

title: Ausbildung – Mechatronik
descriptionHtml:
Deine Chance: Technik, die bewegt
Bei uns hältst du die Systeme am Laufen, die Produkte vom Klick bis zur Haustür bringen. Du analysierst Störungen, wartest komplexe Anlagen und arbeitest mit Mechanik, Elektrotechnik, Pneumatik und Steuerungssoftware, mit echtem Einfluss vom ersten Tag an.
Hier ist deine Arbeit nicht abstrakt. Sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam. Und dein Weg? Den gestaltest du selbst, mit endlosen Möglichkeiten, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

• Installation, Überwachung, Wartung und Instandhaltung mechanischer und elektrischer Anlagen.
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen an automatisierten Systemen.
• Arbeiten in den Bereichen Metallbearbeitung, Elektrotechnik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und Steuerungstechnik.
• Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren von Komponenten nach Vorgaben und Sicherheitsstandards.
• Unterstützung bei der vorbeugenden Instandhaltung und Inbetriebnahme neuer Anlagen.

Das wirst Du lernen:

Du machst Dich vertraut mit der Installation, Überwachung, Wartung und Instandhaltung verschiedener Anlagen
Du lernst Störungen zu analysieren und zu beseitigen
Du eignest Dir Kenntnisse im Bereich Metallbearbeitung und Elektrotechnik an
Du erlernst die Grundlagen in der Hydraulik, der Pneumatik und der Steuerungstechnik
Du erfährst wie Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren von Komponenten funktioniert

Preferred qualifications

- Grundkenntnisse in Englisch (A2-Niveau)

title: Product Manager - Technical, ASCS Legal
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Legal is seeking a hands-on, AI-native Product Manager – Technical to transform how legal work gets done for Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS). This is a technical product role requiring deep architecture influence, sitting at the intersection of ASCS’s engineering roadmaps and the legal risks our team manages. You will spend the majority of your time building working AI agents and automation, and shaping how ASCS products are built alongside engineering.

As the ideal candidate, you bring enough technical depth to have credibility with the engineering teams you work with. You can dive into technical detail with engineers and drive constructive discussion, ask the right questions about technology choices and architecture trade-offs, spot risks and failure modes, recognize when the technical information you have been given is inaccurate or not yet well understood, and know when a design is complex enough to warrant a principal engineer’s review. You pair that with hands-on building: you have configured AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, and no-code and low-code platforms yourself, with the judgment to know when a tool is good enough to ship and the discipline to measure whether it actually gets used. And you carry enough legal-adjacent fluency (which is to say, you have worked alongside lawyers and understand why a privacy or commercial position matters) to be trusted in both the engineering room and the legal one. You read a manual process, separate the genuine judgment from the scaffolding, and you redesign the work so AI carries the process and the legal team is freed to focus on the judgment.

This role involves access to confidential legal information and requires a high level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.

Key job responsibilities
Build, deploy, and maintain AI agents and automation workflows that scale the legal team’s impact, which includes client-facing tooling that synthesizes existing legal guidance into interfaces that problem-solve quickly.

Own a clear customer experience and roadmap for legal tooling, and make the ongoing strategic decisions about direction and priorities that the product requires.

Engage credibly with ASCS engineering teams early in their roadmaps, evaluate technical proposals and architecture trade-offs, and shape design decisions alongside engineering to influence technical direction for compliance.

Identify technical intersections where compliance can be built into the product, foresee the consequences of design choices, and surface the associated legal risks back to the legal team.

Think big about how automation makes coordination unnecessary rather than merely faster, which enables the team to amplify and scale its impact.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- Experience working independently and directly with all levels of legal and business partners or equivalent
- Hands-on experience building automation workflows using AI tools (chatbots, LLM agents, workflow automation platforms, no-code builders, or equivalent)

title: Software Development Engineer, VirtSat Team
descriptionHtml:
Project Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

This role of a Software Engineer will design, implement, and operate globally available distributed systems geared towards giving Leo the ability to operate within realistic virtual Leo environments at scale. You’ll build systems using the latest AWS technologies, leveraging best-in-industry software engineering practices.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
- Take responsibility for designing and delivering modern, flexible, scalable solutions to complex optimization problems for operating and planning satellite constellations
- Work with our peer teams and customers to design suitable software systems to fulfill the mission needs.
- Write code for production cloud native software systems in Java.
- Utilize AWS and other Amazon technologies to build high-available software services.
- Help on-board and mentor new team members.
- Lead technical roadmap definition efforts and decide what software services to build.

This role is for a Software Development Engineer who will build new cloud services and APIs that facilitates and orchestrates simulation/emulation of software on Leo devices such as satellites, ground gateways, and customer terminals. You will be building low-latency, highly scalable architecture that are critical to getting high quality internet service to customers.

About the team
The team is building the infrastructure which mimics the actual constellations. This is being done to power internal testing of software within Amazon Leo.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

title: Content Writer, Integrated Demand Center, AWS Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a talented Content Writer to join the Content Studio within our Integrated Demand Center (IDC). Content Studio is the creative production engine for AWS Marketing, delivering world-class, customer-centric content across email, landing pages, whitepapers, blogs, social media, paid media, and more.

In this role, you will craft clear, compelling, and brand-consistent copy that powers large-scale, integrated marketing campaigns spanning multiple channels and audiences. The majority of our work is driven by these coordinated campaign programs, so you will collaborate closely with designers, video producers, production managers, campaign managers, and product marketers to translate business priorities and briefs into content that resonates with customers and drives measurable results.

The ideal candidate is a versatile writer who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, can flex their voice across formats and audiences, and is passionate about producing high-quality work at scale. You are equally comfortable owning a short-form social post and a long-form technical asset, and you sweat the details of brand voice, accuracy, and clarity. You also embrace AI as a creative partner, using it to amplify your output and work at scale.

We are a team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement. You will help us raise the bar on content quality while educating stakeholders and refining how we work.

Key job responsibilities
Write, edit, and proofread clear, engaging, on-brand copy across a range of formats: emails, landing pages, whitepapers, blog posts, social media, paid media, and short-form video scripts.

Use AI tools as a force-multiplier to accelerate drafting, editing, ideation, and production, raising both the quality and volume of content you can deliver at scale.

Partner closely with the production management team to align on priorities, timelines, and workflow, ensuring content moves smoothly through intake, review, and delivery.

Collaborate with designers, video producers, campaign managers, and product marketers to turn creative briefs and business goals into effective content.

Help steer and guide external agency partners who support our content production, providing clear direction, brand guidance, and feedback to ensure their work meets AWS quality standards.

Interpret briefs quickly, ask the right questions, and deliver polished copy against tight timelines while managing multiple concurrent requests.

Adapt tone, voice, and messaging for different audiences, channels, and stages of the customer journey.

Ensure all content adheres to AWS brand, style, and quality standards, and is consistent across touchpoints.

Incorporate feedback from reviewers and stakeholders, and contribute to continuous optimization of content and process.

Help educate partner teams on content best practices and the value the Content Studio delivers.

A day in the life
You'll pick up briefs from our intake queue, sync with production management on priorities and deadlines, and draft copy that a designer or video producer can bring to life. You might write a customer email in the morning, use AI tools to accelerate a first draft and free up time for higher-value creative work, refine a landing page headline before a mid-day review, and provide direction to an agency partner on a campaign asset in the afternoon, all while incorporating feedback and keeping brand voice tight. You'll join a short daily sync with the copy team to align on priorities and unblock work.

About the team
Content Studio is the primary creative production unit for AWS Marketing's digital content. We handle design, copy, video, social, paid media, email, whitepapers, landing pages, motion graphics, and blogs, with most of our output powering integrated, multi-channel campaigns. We work in an Agile methodology, using regular syncs, iterative delivery, and continuous feedback to move quickly and improve as we go. Our objectives: deliver world-class, customer-centric content at AWS quality standards; create brand-consistent experiences; scale delivery efficiently with continuous optimization; and grow our capability while educating our stakeholders. We work hand-in-hand with production management and external agency partners, and we lean into AI to work smarter and scale our impact.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion
- Experience producing marketing promotional material for Owned & Operated channels
- Experience in brand identity and voice development
- Experience creating brand marketing content

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in an Agile or Scrum environment
- Experience managing external agencies
- Experience using content management systems and content tools
- Experience writing for B2B, technology, cloud, or enterprise audiences.
- Experience using AI tools (e.g., generative AI writing assistants) to increase productivity, quality, and scale.
- Experience partnering with cross-functional creative teams (design, video, production management, campaign, product marketing).

descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for an opportunity to build a highly available, large scale, enterprise-wide software solution? Does it excite you to find patterns and build generic, composable software solutions to solve complex problems? Are you looking for inventing newer and simpler ways of building solutions? If so, we are looking for you to fill a challenging position in Amazon Payroll Technology team.
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights.  As an SDE II on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g., significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g., performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.) You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You re-use where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned engineer. In this position, you will play a leading role in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex financial applications. You will push your design and architecture limits by inventing and simplifying complex problems. You have strong verbal and written communication skills, are self-driven, and can deliver high quality results in a fast-paced environment. You will work with Amazon engineering and business teams across the globe in planning, designing, executing and implementing this new platform.

title: System Development Engineer II, Manipulation Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Our team is pushing the limits in contact-rich manipulation for robotic systems that pick and move diverse items from cluttered containers at high speed and quality. The field has not settled which architectures, learning and controls stacks, and hardware embodiments will best solve the problem, so we need to create prototype systems quickly, test them in realistic and repeatable conditions, and adapt as we learn. We are looking for a Systems Development Engineer to develop a laboratory test strategy, design and build test infrastructure, and drive the test and learning loop. This role is hands-on, in the lab and in code.

The Manipulation Robotics team develops robotic workcells to pick, grasp, and move millions of items and packages across Amazon's fulfillment network. You will build early surrogate systems, leveraging commercial robots, off-the-shelf hardware, and open-source software where they fit, to enable testing and evaluation before the target platform is ready. As the design matures, you will collaborate closely with the controls engineers and compliant mechanism designers on the test strategy, evaluation, and iteration. Your automation and data pipelines will make results repeatable and trustworthy, giving us the evidence to support deployment and scaling decisions.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the laboratory and test infrastructure that lets the team put new grasping ideas in front of real items quickly, adapting it as the design evolves and keeping it available, maintainable, and documented so engineers and scientists can run evaluations independently.
- Bring up robot arms and workcells in the lab, including motion, safety, and integration with the test harness.
- Partner with mechanical, electrical, controls, and science engineers to answer open design questions through testing, so tradeoffs across performance, cost, complexity, and reliability get settled with data.
- Establish the characterization procedures and infrastructure that inform finger, gripper, arm, and workcell decisions, and produce the data simulation is calibrated against.
- Instrument lab setups broadly from the start, anticipating what data will be needed to answer future questions, compare architectures, and inform which sensing the production design carries.
- Own the software that makes testing possible, including hardware integration, data acquisition, test automation, and analysis tooling.
- Write and adapt bench-level controls firmware, purpose-built to get a mechanism moving and instrumented quickly so an idea can be judged while it is still cheap to change.
- Automate item presentation to support volume and repeatability testing across a variety of workflows and robot embodiments.
- Diagnose problems across hardware, software, and the operating environment when a test result and reality disagree, and eliminate the contributing cause with a permanent fix.

You will start your day reviewing system health dashboards and operational metrics, then shift into building or refining automation that keeps your team's services running smoothly. You might spend part of the afternoon pairing with a teammate on a design review or troubleshooting a tricky production issue. Along the way, you will collaborate with partner teams to align on technical decisions and share best practices. Expect to balance hands-on engineering with mentoring newer team members and contributing to planning discussions.

title: Senior Healthcare Solutions Architect, AI Solutions
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are seeking a Senior Healthcare Solutions Architect to join our Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) Go to Market (GTM) organization. In this role, you will help define and drive our GTM strategy for global healthcare customers and partners. As a senior solutions architect, you will be at the forefront of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies, linking technology with measurable business value for healthcare and life sciences organizations.

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions.

In this role, you will partner with Business Development, Sales Specialists, and Product leadership to develop, accelerate, and sell current and new healthcare products. You will lead technical engagement directly with customers to understand their business challenges, design and propose technical solutions, and guide successful implementation. By establishing and growing business and technical relationships with customers and senior internal stakeholders, you will drive customer adoption and value realization of AWS solutions in the healthcare and life sciences industry. You will use this knowledge to influence the Product organization's roadmap, shaping new features and capabilities based on patterns you identify across customer engagements.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead technical engagement with customers alongside Business Development and Sales leaders, owning the technical strategy for key accounts to understand requirements, propose solutions, and address technical concerns
- Build and deliver technical presentations, demonstrations, and proofs of concept to showcase AWS capabilities to Healthcare customers, including to VP and C-level audiences
- Partner with Sales, Business Development, and Marketing teams to define and execute go-to-market strategies for healthcare solutions, identifying scalable patterns across the customer base
- Collaborate with Product teams to influence the product roadmap, advocating for new features, products, and services based on synthesized customer feedback and market trends
- Establish and codify best practices and reusable technical assets within the AWS solutions architect community, mentoring other SAs on healthcare domain expertise
- Develop customer-facing technical content such as reference architectures, whitepapers, and implementation guides for healthcare use cases, setting the standard for quality and depth

title: Software Development Manager, Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV)
descriptionHtml:
Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV) ensures that Amazon is a safe and trustworthy place to shop and an amazing place to build a successful business selling products. Our mission is to build trust with our Customers and Selling Partners as we scale through technology, analytics, and science. We’re committed to service as a center of excellence for Amazon.
As part of SPIV, Seller Verification owns variety of products which enables us to collect data from WW Sellers in order to let them sell on Amazon marketplace. Our mission is to: (a) make it simple and fast for Sellers to register globally, (b) verify the identity of every person and business selling on Amazon through the Seller lifecycle, and (c) use automation to achieve accuracy, speed, and scale. When we are successful, we enable Marketplace growth and build trust with our Customers. Registration Systems receive ~1.5M hits per week and strive towards providing a seamless experience that cannot be exploited by bad actors. As of today, sellers who intend to go global on Amazon need to register in each region and thus, go through the tedious registration process multiple times, which leads to friction for potential global sellers.
We are looking for a Software Development Manager with a strong sense of ownership and a passion for delivering creative solutions for complex problems on an unprecedented scale. As part of leading a team of engineers, you will have the opportunity to create significant impact on our systems, our business and most importantly, our customers as we take on challenges that can reshape the e-commerce industry.
We are seeking someone who has strong technical, project and people skills with a can-do attitude and a focus on delivering high quality software. We move at a fast pace and deliver software iteratively using AGILE best practices and the latest technologies.
The Ideal Candidate:

title: Embedded Software Engineer II, Ring, Ring Firmware
descriptionHtml:
Ring is growing in Poland and we are looking for experienced Embedded Software Engineers to join our team in Gdansk. You will work on firmware for IoT devices used by millions of customers worldwide, developing new features and shipping products from concept to production.

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will own the design and implementation of firmware subsystems running on resource-constrained hardware. You will work across the full development cycle: architecture, implementation, code review, testing on real devices, and production release. Our team operates with high autonomy and a strong feedback culture.

The ideal candidate:

Has shipped embedded products to production and understands what it takes to go from prototype to millions of devices in the field.
Writes clean, maintainable C/C++ for constrained environments and cares deeply about code quality.
Communicates proactively, raises technical risks early, and drives solutions across teams.
Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift as customer needs evolve.
Is curious about the full stack, from hardware registers to cloud connectivity, and enjoys learning new domains.

Key job responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware in C/C++ for Ring devices.
Specify and implement functionality for embedded subsystems (connectivity, streaming, power management, sensors, or security).
Collaborate with hardware, QA, cloud, and app teams to deliver integrated product experiences.
Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and cross-team architecture decisions.
Debug complex issues across hardware and software boundaries using JTAG, UART, and protocol analyzers.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing a code change from a colleague working on a new sensor driver. After your team standup, you spend focused time implementing a feature for an upcoming product launch, testing it on real hardware at your desk. In the afternoon, you dig into a tricky issue that only reproduces on one board variant, tracing it from application code down to a register misconfiguration. You push your fix, verify it on the device, and close the day knowing it will ship to customers in the next release.

title: Agentic Data Engineer, Frontier AI Tooling
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the products that help AWS ProServe and Frontier AI teams understand customer needs, develop the right solutions, and deliver them at scale? We are looking for a Data Engineer to own the data foundations behind the products and experiences that span ProServe, Frontier AI, and services teams within AWS Sales, Marketing and Global Sales. Your pipelines and datasets will let these teams deeply understand customer challenges, rapidly develop tailored solutions, and orchestrate delivery, directly accelerating how AWS delivers business outcomes to our customers.

You will build and operate the pipelines and datasets that feed the context layer and agentic workflows: ingesting external insights, internal data, and insights collected by sales and delivery teams, and turning them into reliable, well-modeled datasets that models and agents can reason over. You design data models, ETL, and integration services that are flexible, extensible, and scalable, then support and grow them over time. This is a hands-on role where the playbook is written in real time. You ship to production and own the correctness of the data that downstream agents depend on.

You are comfortable with ambiguity and partner with business leaders to build the pipelines that answer their key questions. You will unify fragmented data pipelines, build robust data models, and ensure reliable data lineage across multiple product areas, working closely with software engineers, product managers, and analytics teams. This is a role with high visibility to senior leadership and high opportunity for impact.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end delivery of data pipelines: design, build, test, deploy, and operate
- Build and optimize ETL/ELT jobs that produce the foundational datasets powering the team's products and agentic workflows
- Model structured and unstructured data (external insights, internal data, sales and delivery insights) so it is queryable and consumable by AI agents at scale
- Design the data structures, schemas, and contracts that downstream services and agents depend on
- Build and own data-quality tooling: validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring so bad data does not reach agents or models
- Ship to production regularly in a high-ambiguity environment, balancing speed against reliability
- Raise operational-excellence hygiene (data tests, monitoring, runbooks) for the pipelines you own
- Write clear data models, pipeline design notes, and runbooks a peer can act on

About the team
ABOUT AWS:
 
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
 
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of data engineering experience
- 1+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using ETL/ELT processes experience
- 1+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using data modeling experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience writing and optimizing SQL queries with large-scale, complex datasets

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

title: Finance Manager, Corp FP&A
descriptionHtml:
Would you enjoy providing support for our Chief Financial Officer's decision making, uncovering insights into Amazon's many businesses and investments, and building the tools to do this at scale? We're seeking a self-starter with strong critical thinking and a passion for finding better ways to do things. This role will interest candidates looking for experience analyzing Amazon at a macro level, creating new ways to measure business performance, and helping craft the narrative around our company's near and mid-term outlook.

This position on the Corporate Financial Planning and Analysis team will work closely with various stakeholders including Accounting, Finance, and Financial systems teams to solve complex problems that directly impact Amazon's internal and external financial reporting. The successful candidate will be able to interpret financial results, effectively communicate a business narrative, and implement mechanisms for new reporting insights at scale with a goal to make our data more actionable.

Key job responsibilities
- Design new financial insights and enhance existing financial reporting that enables informed decision-making for senior leadership across Amazon's global operations
- Present ad hoc business analysis and recommendations to senior management by diving deep to build analyses, models, and narratives with broad scope that deliver results
- Own corporate finance reporting definitions and ensure consistency across the finance organization, monitoring for accuracy and establishing processes to audit data and reporting
- Serve as a liaison between accounting and system teams to drive accurate close, navigating across organizations to identify the right teams to participate in discussions
- Recommend improvements and provide scoping documents for system enhancements, identifying opportunities to implement large-scale financial solutions that simplify finance tools, technology, and processes

A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing financial results and identifying trends that need deeper investigation. Throughout the day, you'll collaborate with Accounting, Finance, and Financial systems teams to resolve complex data integrity issues while building scalable reporting mechanisms. Between close, planning, and reporting cycles, you'll lead projects to enhance our financial reporting capabilities and implement automation that makes our data more accessible and reliable.

About the team
The team is part of Corporate Financial Planning and Analysis and provides all global reporting for Amazon to the Chief Financial Officer and Chief Executive Officer. We create robust, fast, and reliable financial reporting that enables strategic decision-making at the highest levels of the company.

Our team operates at the intersection of finance, accounting, and technology, solving complex challenges that impact how Amazon understands and communicates its financial performance. We foster an inclusive environment where collaboration and innovation drive continuous improvement in how we measure and report business performance across all of Amazon's diverse businesses and investments.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of multiple finance and accounting roles experience
- 5+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

title: CTK Sr. Associate (Seasonal), MyHR Centralized Time Keeping
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we strive to be earth's most customer-centric company. Each day presents new opportunities to innovate and overcome challenges. We distribute millions of products annually to our loyal customers worldwide, continuously redefining what's possible through the talent and dedication of exceptional individuals. Amazon's recognition as one of the world's leading brands stems from our commitment to customer obsession and innovation.

We are establishing a shared services team in India to support Amazon's global expansion. This hub will deliver multi-language support to our internal customers, and we seek Senior Associates to join our growing Shared Services Center. HR Services teams will redesign processes and tools to achieve service globalization and infinite scalability, delivering an innovative and frustration-free experience to employees worldwide. The India-based service hub will provide immediate, high-quality support across APAC and globally to Amazon businesses, managers, and employees. Services include employee transactional processes such as onboarding, centralized timekeeping, data management, exits, and compliance-related activities.

About Amazon Centralized Timekeeping (CTK):

The Centralized Timekeeping team streamlines time and attendance data entry to reduce payroll defects and maintain consistent service levels. CTK supports thousands of Amazon Associates with their time and attendance matters. Operators and HR submit edit requests through MyTime and trouble ticketing systems. The team manages these requests on a FIFO basis, prioritizing payroll-impacting tickets to prevent defects. We support the business by handling associates' time and attendance matters with speed, precision, and customer obsession.

Position Description:
Join Amazon's HR Services team in India to make a direct impact on all Amazonians. We seek a Time and Attendance Operational Admin specializing in time and attendance management. This centralized role manages time-related matters across the network and requires precise, rapid data entry skills. You will operate MyTime systems and manage trouble ticket queues for time and attendance issues. Your primary focus includes resolving incoming time and attendance inquiries, with opportunities for expanded responsibilities based on performance. You may contribute to continuous improvement projects. Success requires deep knowledge of Amazon's attendance policies, employee groups, and applicable state and federal laws. Core responsibilities include system administration, ticket management, and data auditing, plus additional projects as assigned. You will report directly to a team manager.

Key job responsibilities
1. Manage time and attendance data entries through various Time and attendance system with high accuracy and speed.

2. Process and resolve trouble tickets following FIFO methodology, with priority for payroll-impacting issues.

3. Handle time-related queries and provide support across the Amazon network through both voice and non-voice channels (email, tickets, calls)

4. Perform regular data auditing and maintain system accuracy.

5. Ensure compliance with Amazon's attendance policies and applicable laws.

6. Participate in continuous improvement projects and process redesign initiatives.

7. Support broader HR Services team objectives and cross-functional collaboration.

8. Execute additional projects and responsibilities as assigned by the team manager.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ months of human resources experience
- 6+ months of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 6+ months of customer service experience
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of human resources experience
- 1+ years of customer service experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience

title: Solutions Architect, Amazon Publisher Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Publisher Services (APS) helps digital publishers around the world build and grow thriving businesses. We provide services and advanced technologies to web, mobile app and advanced TV publishers of all sizes, including many of comScore’s global top 100, to help them monetize their content with demand from multiple buyers. Our server-side header bidding solutions are fast and reliable across devices, handling billions of queries per day, delivering ads in milliseconds. The result is more profitable advertising related systems for publishers and more relevant ads/content for customers.

We are seeking a seasoned Solutions Architect to help continue to scale and improve our publisher integrations across the APS ecosystem. In this role you will oversee launching, optimizing, and scaling technical integrations across web and mobile-inapp integrations. The ideal candidate will also bring experience in working with international customers, as well as experience and knowledge around international requirements such as GDPR.

Key job responsibilities
* Own and develop processes for providing technical solutions to publishers including evaluating, on-boarding, integrating, troubleshooting, and scaling.
* Identify areas for automation, improvement and scalability to support the technical integrations and work with the team to drive these to execution.
* Drive features to optimize integrations and improve operational excellence by collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Account teams.
* Be the voice of the publisher and translate partner feedback into product and engineering requirements.
* Own and analyze long-term vs. short-term opportunities and recommend the right trade-offs that will ultimately benefit our partners.
* Own technical agenda for business reviews with partners.
* Produce and oversee comprehensive technical documentation to simplify and scale partner integrations.
* Champion new product requirements and features for development.
* Be a subject matter expert on advertising integrations and handling privacy requirements such as GDPR.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 4+ Years of hands-on experience in solutions architecture, software development or ad ops at top-tier programmatic bidders (SSPs or DSPs).
- 4+ years of experience working with browser debugging tools such as Chrome Dev Tools, Charles Proxy or Wireshark.
- 4+ years of experience working with client-side web technologies such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Knowledge of programmatic advertising space, including header bidding.
- Knowledge and experience working with international privacy requirements such as GDPR.
- Analytical and data-driven – familiarity with data analysis tools to process and analyze large data sets with AI or at least one database query language

title: Applied Scientist, AWS Applied AI Solutions - Life Sciences
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

The Team Join the next science revolution at AWS Life Sciences Applied AI Solutions where you'll work alongside world-class scientists to build AI that transforms how therapeutics are discovered, developed, and brought to patients.

We're out to revolutionize how medicines are discovered, developed, and brought to patients powered by a new generation of AI. Our team tackles some of the hardest open problems at the intersection of frontier AI and life sciences. We apply biological foundation models large language models and agentic reasoning systems to life sciences problems then put them into the hands of customers as applications and managed services they can fine-tune tailor and deploy on their own data. The science challenges are deep: how do you design agentic systems that reason correctly over complex biological regulatory and clinical logic? How do you enable customers to tailor foundation models to their proprietary data and get better outputs with less effort? How do you adapt models to reason faithfully in high-stakes scientific and regulatory domains?

Today we're focused on two areas. In clinical trials we're building AI that automates and optimizes regulatory and clinical development workflows. In drug design our products (including Amazon Bio Discovery) accelerate discovery by giving bench scientists AI-guided protein engineering and antibody design capabilities. We combine frontier research with production-scale delivery to put breakthrough science into the hands of customers solving humanity's hardest problems.

We value scientific rigor encourage publication and support conference participation. If you want to do research that ships this is the team.

The Role We are seeking an Applied Scientist to build the models and methods behind our life sciences AI products with a primary focus on clinical trial operations and agentic reasoning. You will design train and evaluate systems that reason over complex clinical and operational logic and ship them into products customers use directly. You will work closely with senior and principal scientists on well-scoped research problems own your results end to end and see your work reach production.

This role combines expertise in LLM reasoning and agentic AI with applied impact in life sciences. You will work on how large language models reason plan and act in complex scientific domains while applying domain knowledge to ensure models produce scientifically valid outputs. The problems span multiple fronts:

• How do you build LLM-based agentic systems that correctly reason over clinical protocols regulatory standards and complex multi-step operational workflows?
• How do you evaluate agent reliability and faithfulness rigorously enough to trust in high-stakes clinical settings?
• How do you develop model customization methods (fine-tuning retrieval augmentation domain adaptation) that let customers get strong results from foundation models on their own data?
You will focus on clinical trial operations (agentic automation structured reasoning evaluation domain adaptation) with opportunities to contribute across drug discovery (protein engineering antibody design) as the portfolio grows. You will own end-to-end scientific solutions from research through production and your work will directly shape the tools that scientists use daily.

Key job responsibilities
• Design train fine-tune and evaluate LLM-based agentic systems that reason over clinical protocols regulatory standards and operational workflows
• Build rigorous evaluation harnesses and benchmarks to measure agent reliability faithfulness and failure modes in high-stakes domains
• Develop model customization methods (fine-tuning RLHF retrieval augmentation domain adaptation) that help customers get better outputs on their own data with less effort
• Contribute to graph-based and causal modeling approaches for clinical trial operations
• Partner with Life Sciences domain experts product and engineering to translate scientific challenges into shipped capabilities
• Own experiments end to end: problem framing implementation evaluation iteration and hand-off to production
• Publish at top-tier venues where the work supports it
• Contribute to drug discovery efforts (protein engineering antibody design) as opportunities arise

A day in the life
• Design and run an experiment to validate a new agentic reasoning or fine-tuning method then ship it as a capability customers can use
• Diagnose why a model is failing on a new class of inputs and implement a fix to unblock a delivery milestone
• Build or extend an evaluation benchmark to measure how faithfully an agent reasons over clinical logic
• Meet with domain experts to scope what the next model release needs to do
• Review results with a senior scientist sharpen the approach and get it over the finish line
• Prototype a new idea that could become the next capability in the product

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree or above in a relevant field
- Applied research experience with a track record of solving complex technical problems and delivering results
- Experience with LLMs, reasoning systems, and agentic AI, including architecture design, training, fine-tuning, and evaluation
- Experience building or evaluating agentic systems (planning, tool use, retrieval, verification)
- Publication record at ML or computational biology venues
- PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or related field, or MS with equivalent applied research experience
- Demonstrated ability to apply model customization techniques (fine-tuning, RLHF, retrieval augmentation, domain adaptation) to specific downstream applications
- Excellent programming skills in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX), with a modern development practice that embraces AI-assisted coding and iteration

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing agent evaluations or benchmarks for scientific or high-stakes domains
- Experience with clinical data standards (e.g., SDTM/ADaM) or regulatory science
- Experience with graph neural networks or causal inference
- Domain experience in life sciences or computational biology (protein engineering, antibody design, genomics, or clinical data)
- Experience translating research into products or services that others use
- Experience taking 0-to-1 capabilities from initial research through first customer delivery

title: Senior Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Senior Engagement Manager to lead the delivery of our largest and most complex programs. In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading organizations.

Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives.

This role requires approximately 50% co-location on site with customer, AWS and partner teams within the U.S.



Key job responsibilities
- Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions

title: Area Manager II, Operations, Fulfillment Center - Fixed, Operations
descriptionHtml:
Here at Amazon we are currently seeking for Managers to support our Customer Fulfillment team.

This is an excellent opportunity to be part of the AU Fulfillment Center (FC) leadership team during its phase of expansion and growth, whereby you get to define the process flows and shape up standard work routines as the operations scale up.

As a Manager, you’ll deliver inspiring, inclusive leadership for the teams you supervise. But at the same time, you don’t shy away from getting involved whenever necessary.

You’ll be directly responsible for supervising a team of Associates and a department. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance.


Key job responsibilities
1. Determining, implementing and monitoring purchasing, storage and distribution
strategies, policies and plans - AMs implement and monitor storage and distribution
strategies across FC workflows (receive, stow, pick, pack, ship). They analyse shift
performance against business objectives and drive operational excellence plans.
They oversee projects to streamline processes and optimise productivity across the
network.
2. Preparing and implementing plans to maintain required stock levels at minimum
cost - AMs maintain inventory accuracy and work to meet customer demand while
optimising productivity and cost. They conduct planning sessions and use
advanced analytics to balance competing priorities including stock availability.
3. Negotiating contracts with suppliers to meet quality, cost and delivery
requirements - AMs collaborate cross-functionally with support teams (Engineering,
Quality Assurance, Loss Prevention, HR) to develop plans meeting business
objectives — managing internal "supply" of labour, equipment and process inputs
to meet quality, cost and delivery targets. Specifically, in Dev's role as a Vendor
Return AM, he will be liaising directly with supply chain and external vendors
4. Monitoring and reviewing storage and inventory systems to meet supply
requirements and control stock levels - AMs directly maintain inventory accuracy,
review department-wide metrics, and diagnose root causes of performance gaps.
FC workflows (stow, pick) are fundamentally about managing fast-moving inventory
in storage systems.
5. Operating recording systems to track all movements of supplies and finished
goods, and ensuring re-ordering and re-stocking at optimal times - AMs use
Amazon's WMS (Warehouse Management Systems) to track product movement
through receive → stow → pick → pack → ship. They monitor KPIs and use data
analysis to ensure optimal workflow timing.
6. Liaising with other departments and customers concerning requirements for
outward goods and associated forwarding transportation - AMs work collaboratively
with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices and partner crossfunctionally. The FC's core mission is ensuring customer orders are delivered at the
right time — coordinating the "First Mile" handoff to middle-mile and last-mile
transportation.
7. Overseeing the recording of purchase, storage and distribution transactions - AMs
oversee operational recording systems across all FC workflows, tracking millions of
customer orders through storage and distribution. Data-driven decision-making is a
core requirement of the role.
8. Directing staff activities and monitoring their performance - This is the primary
function — AMs lead teams of 80–120+ associates, motivating, mentoring,
coaching, managing safety, quality, attendance and performance. They conduct
performance management and develop the next generation of leaders.
9. Provision of products and services to meet customer or client requirements - The
entire CF mission: "ensuring customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the
right location" — handling 1.5M+ orders daily, focused on being Earth's most
customer-centric company.

Basic qualifications

- Previous experience in leading large, diverse teams.
- More than 6 months experience as Area Manager.
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays.
- Experience in employee and performance management experience.
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Proven ability in establishing and carry out root cause analysis, and then extract and analyze the data you generate.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with performance metrics, process improvement and Lean techniques.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills.
- Experience with a contingent workforce during peak seasons.
- Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen methodologies would be highly advantageous.

title: Sr. Product Manager, NAS Ship Cost Optimization
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the Earth’s most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. This Product managers will be responsible for driving optimization efforts across various organizations and processes to improve shipping costs at Amazon. This includes defining the right set of metrics and processes, establishing ambitious goals and driving towards them, working with technology and operations partners to design, develop and deploy intelligent processes and improvements.

The North American Stores (NAS) organization is focused on continuously optimizing its P&L to drive long-term profitability. One of the most significant levers? Outbound fulfillment costs. The NAS Ship Cost Optimization (SCO) team tackles this head-on—leveraging technology for scale and launching innovative products that optimize costs systematically and with measurable impact.

This team has delivered over $1 billion+ in cumulative bottom-line improvements over the past four years by reducing packaging waste, correcting dimensional defects, optimizing regional fulfillment, and building Gen-AI products that reimagine how Amazon collaborates with selling partners. In 2026, the team is targeting significant savings through initiatives spanning cube reduction, AI-powered vendor outreach, regionalization strategies, sortability defect reduction, and improved placement—against a total addressable opportunity of $1.5B+.

As a Sr Product Manager on this team, you will own products and initiatives that directly improve the profitability of one of Amazon's largest businesses. You will develop a deep understanding of the inputs driving ship costs—placement, regional fulfillment, sortability, ship method choices, and dimensions—and translate that knowledge into products, policies, and partnerships that deliver hundreds of millions in savings. You will work across partner teams spanning Supply Chain Technology, Operations, Transportation, Finance, and Category Management, and you will leverage AI and automation to build the next generation of cost optimization products.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, communicates with precision, and thrives at the intersection of data, product strategy, and cross-organizational influence.

Key job responsibilities
Own and drive the end-to-end product roadmap for one or more SCO initiatives (e.g., Cube Reduction, CRISP Gen-AI service, regional fulfillment strategies, or Sortability Overrides), from opportunity sizing through execution and measurement.

Develop deep subject matter expertise in the inputs that drive outbound ship costs—placement, regional fulfillment, sortability tier economics, dimensional accuracy, and ship method choices—to identify high-impact opportunities others miss.

Build and scale AI-powered products such as CRISP (Cube Reduction, Improving Sizing and Product Design), a Gen-AI LLM service that delivers automated packaging and product redesign recommendations to 20,000+ selling partners.

Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders across VP-level organizations including Supply Chain Technology (SCOT), Transportation, Fulfillment Tech, Finance, Category teams, and Retail Business Services (RBS) to secure resources, resolve dependencies, and drive shared goals.

Design and run controlled experiments to validate hypotheses, which enable product feature decisions and deliver results at scale.

Define success metrics and tracking mechanisms (e.g., monthly flash reporting, ASIN-level cost attribution, vendor response rates) that create transparency and accountability for initiatives targeting $200MM+ in annual savings.

Partner with Science and Engineering teams to improve targeting methodologies (dynamic ship cost impact models, out-of-stock probability signals, ASIN similarity algorithms) and automate manual workflows.

Represent the team in leadership forums, crafting data-driven narratives that communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs to senior leaders with clarity and confidence.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing product metrics and triaging customer feedback to decide where to focus. Mid-morning, you are in a design review with your engineering and design partners, working through tradeoffs on a feature approaching launch. After lunch, you draft a working-backwards document for a new initiative, pulling in input from finance and marketing stakeholders. Later in the afternoon, you sit in on a customer research session to pressure-test assumptions before finalizing roadmap priorities. You close the day by updating your team on progress and aligning on next steps.

About the team
The NAS Ship Cost Optimization team is a small, high-impact product team that punches well above its weight. Over the past four years, the team has delivered $1B+ in cumulative bottom-line improvements to the Stores P&L by building innovative products—including the Gen-AI powered CRISP service—and championing cost-smart policies across the fulfillment network.

The team operates with strong leadership visibility at all levels, given the scale of results delivered and the innovative, AI-forward approach to problem solving. You will join a closely knit group that Thinks Big, earns trust through results, and works collaboratively across some of Amazon's most complex operational systems.

If you want to own products that move a multi-billion dollar P&L—and do it by combining analytical rigor, creative product thinking, technology-driven scale, and genuine cross-functional partnership—this is the team.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Knowledge of writing and optimizing SQL queries in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in Logistics, Distribution or Fulfillment processes
- Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
- Knowledge of product experimentation (A/B testing)
- Proficiency with tools such as Amazon QuickSuite, Kiro, or MCP (or equivalent BI and developer productivity tools).
- Experience working in a vendor- or seller-facing environment where external partner engagement is a core part of the product strategy.
