descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning and looking for a fast paced environment to work in? As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.

U.S Citizenship Required

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and short timelines.

A day in the life

title: Value Engineering Manager, Value Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon builds fast—and behind every new Fulfillment Center, Sortation Center, Delivery Station, and capital investment is a critical question: **Are we buying the right solution at the right price?** We're looking for a **Cost & Value Engineering Manager** to partner with Amazon's North America Design & Construction stakeholders, delivering construction cost engineering and value engineering services that optimize design, validate costs, and inform capital investment decisions across Amazon's infrastructure network.

This role is high-impact, high-variety, and technically demanding. You'll develop bottom-up cost estimates, should-cost models, and Value Engineering analyses across a diverse portfolio of building types, material handling equipment (MHE), automation, and capital projects. From multi-site retrofit programs to complex, one-off initiatives, you'll evaluate design alternatives, optimize specifications, identify cost drivers, and produce defensible cost models that shape sourcing, design, and investment decisions. Working from early concepts through bid-ready construction documents, you'll apply technical expertise to balance cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements.

As part of Amazon's Global Procurement Organization within the Sourcing Excellence pillar, you'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Construction, Procurement, and Category teams to ensure Amazon is buying the right solution at the right price. You'll also collaborate with AI and Market Intelligence Solutions, leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, develop scalable cost intelligence, and advance next-generation automation that expands the reach and impact of Cost & Value Engineering across Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
Deliver independent, bottom-up cost estimates for construction, equipment, and capital investment projects across Amazon's global portfolio, spanning retrofit, expansion, new-build, automation, and equipment deployment initiatives.
Develop cost estimates from early-stage concepts through supplier selection and implementation, adapting methodologies and analytical depth to available project information and design maturity.
Build and maintain scalable estimating models and templates while developing detailed bottom-up cost models for complex, site-specific initiatives requiring advanced analytical judgment.
Perform should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and Value Engineering analyses to evaluate design alternatives, optimize specifications, identify cost drivers, and ensure Amazon is buying the right solution at the right price.
Leverage AI-powered tools to automate data gathering, cost modeling, benchmarking, and pattern recognition while applying engineering judgment to validate outputs and resolve complex or ambiguous scopes.
Drive the development of scalable AI-enabled cost intelligence solutions by curating project and market data, validating model performance, and identifying opportunities to automate routine analytical activities.
Partner with Engineering, Design, Construction, Procurement, Category Management, and business stakeholders to validate assumptions, communicate cost risks, evaluate alternatives, and influence sourcing and investment decisions.
Peer review cost models, estimates, and Value Engineering recommendations to ensure technical rigor, consistency, and alignment with current market conditions and best practices.

About the team
The Sourcing Excellence team helps Amazon answer two fundamental questions: **Are we buying the right product?** (Value Engineering) and **Are we paying the right price?** (Cost Engineering). **Value Engineering** ensures Amazon is investing in the right construction solutions, equipment, and technologies by optimizing specifications, design, materials, and performance to maximize business value while meeting operational requirements. **Cost Engineering** establishes cost transparency and price confidence through bottom-up cost estimation, should-cost modeling, benchmarking, market intelligence, and cost driver analysis to determine what construction projects, equipment, and services should cost.

Together, these disciplines provide transparent, fact-based insights that enable informed sourcing, design, and investment decisions throughout the project lifecycle. Our vision is to make cost and value transparency a strategic capability across the organization, ensuring every investment delivers the optimal balance of cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. Today, the team supports billions of dollars in managed spend across construction, material handling equipment, automation, and other strategic sourcing categories, and continues to scale its impact through AI-enabled solutions, standardized mechanisms, and cross-functional partnerships.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Control Engineer Intern, AWS Data Center Controls Deployment & Services team
descriptionHtml:
*Internship period: 4 Jan 2027 - 30 June 2027.

Would you like to be part of the AWS Internship Program, helping us build and run the infrastructure behind Amazon Web Services?
Are you curious about how a data center keeps its power and cooling running around the clock?
Do you want to apply what you have learned in control systems, mechanical and electrical engineering to real, live infrastructure?

Cloud computing is changing how the world uses technology. Since 2006, AWS has provided companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. On this AWS Internship Program you will take on real projects, build skills you can use from day one, and be encouraged to build and innovate. You will be a supported member of our internship community, with access to mentoring, coaching and other learning opportunities.



Key job responsibilities
As a Controls Engineering Intern, you will work alongside our engineers in Singapore on live data centers and new builds. You will learn how a control philosophy becomes a working system: how sensors, controllers and sequences of operation keep chillers, air handlers and electrical switchgear running safely. Your work will include:
- Reviewing points lists and sequences of operation against design documents
- Helping build and track digital inspection and testing checklists
- Analysing alarm and trend data to find recurring issues and their root causes
- Keeping technical records, such as as-built drawings and test documents, accurate and current
- Supporting small automation and tooling projects that save the team time

You will need curiosity, attention to detail, and the confidence to ask questions and speak up when something does not look right. No prior data center experience is required. We will teach you the systems. We are looking for solid fundamentals and a willingness to learn.



About the team
The AWS Data Center Controls Deployment & Services team (CDS) sits within the Data Center Capacity Delivery (DCCD) organization. CDS delivers and supports the control systems that monitor and run power and cooling in AWS data centers, including Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). Our Controls Engineers come from electrical, mechanical and software backgrounds. Together we design, deploy, test and support these systems from construction through to live operation, so our customers' workloads stay available.

#auta-sg #auta-asean

- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics or Computer Engineering
- Year 3 or final-year student
- Coursework in control systems (for example feedback loops, PID control or automation)
- Foundational knowledge of electrical engineering (circuits, power distribution) and mechanical engineering (thermodynamics, fluids or HVAC)
- Able to commit the full-time internship
- Candidates must be able to legally work in Singapore

Preferred qualifications

- University project, lab work or internship applying control theory (for example PLC programming, automation or control system design)
- Basic programming or scripting (for example Python)
- Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as BACnet or Modbus
- Interest in data center infrastructure, building services, or critical power and cooling systems

title: Controls Technician, Data Center Capacity Delivery, Amazon Data Services, Inc
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.

Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

title: Software Development Manager, AWS Region Services
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help bring new technology to customers faster? We build the tools that let teams plan, launch, and expand AWS services for customers around the world.

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a Seattle-based team of software engineers at the center of how we deliver products to customers. Your team owns the systems that turn a launch request into a coordinated, largely automated plan, removing the manual steps and hand-offs that slow delivery down.

In this role you will set your team's technical direction, grow the engineers who report to you, and work closely with product and program managers to turn customer needs into working software. You will care as much about how your team operates, its quality, culture, and pace, as about what it ships. If you like building systems that other builders depend on, and you want your work to shorten the time it takes to get new capabilities into customers' hands, this is a place to do it.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers, setting clear goals and technical direction.
- Own the design, delivery, and operation of services that automate launch and expansion workflows, and keep them reliable in production.
- Partner with product and program managers to translate customer needs into a prioritized roadmap your team can execute.
- Recruit, hire, and develop engineers, and give regular, actionable feedback that helps them grow.
- Identify and remove manual, repetitive work through automation and simpler designs, and report progress against delivery goals to your stakeholders.

A day in the life
You start the day checking the health of the services your team runs and clearing anything blocking your engineers. You spend focused time in design reviews, helping the team make sound technical trade-offs, and in one-on-ones supporting the people who report to you. You meet with product and program partners to align on what matters next and give them a clear read on timelines and risks. Throughout the day you look for coordination and manual effort you can automate away, so your team spends its time on work only they can do.

About the team
Our team builds the system that helps teams deliver AWS services and capabilities to customers across the world, as quickly and reliably as possible. We do the shared, behind-the-scenes work so individual service teams can focus on their own engineering rather than the mechanics of launching and expanding. We care about clean interfaces, automation over manual effort, and measuring ourselves by how much time we save the teams we serve. We are a collaborative group that values curiosity, thoughtful design, and helping each other grow.

You’ll help build and operate high-performing systems that will be critical in reducing operational burden for other AWS Dedicated Cloud teams, enhancing regional reliability through scalability, innovation, and automation. You will help us reimagine and continuously improve reliability engineering.

title: Operations Supervisor
descriptionHtml:
P.S. - This is a Nightshift role
Wednesday-Saturday 00:00 - 10:30

Operations is the heart and soul of everything Amazon does. It is thanks to effective operations that items are processed and dispatched to our customers on time. Being an Operations Lead/Supervisor gives you the chance to see how all the different parts of operations work and play a role in making sure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll be the first point of contact for team members during their shift and help them follow the processes that your managers have put in place. This is a hands-on role, which will give you experience in using the tools and systems that make our operations successful.

Key job responsibilities
- Measure and monitor workflows, track onsite performance, and provide important shift information to frontline management to ensure operational excellence across shifts
- Support and train employees to deliver great service and supervise them in their daily tasks
- Support the Shift/Area Manager with projects to improve processes, cultivate a safe working environment, and increase workforce engagement
- Work with other departments to find solutions to address common issues or support needs in areas of key performance
- Use data analysis to identify ways to optimise safety, quality and productivity

A day in the life
As an Operations Lead/Supervisor, you’ll be based in one of our operational sites. You’ll support your Shift/Area Manager to carry out the plan for the shift. That will involve helping with pre-shift meetings with your team and monitoring procedures to make sure everyone is following safety rules, quality processes, and the priority plan for the day.

You’ll escalate any issues you spot to your manager, but sometimes you’ll be the most senior person on shift and will give people the direction they need to complete their tasks. At other times, you’ll support your Shift/Area Manager in planning shifts to make sure you have enough team members working during peak times.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of cutting-edge vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience relevant experience working with data analytics and using metrics to identify problems
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you.
- Experience of stakeholder management including building and maintaining professional relationships
- Experience in an operational environment, such as logistics, retail, hospitality, or customer service

title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Migrations & Modernization, AWS Professional Services, DEU Central Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle. Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
This customer-facing role is exclusively for German speakers, requiring native or C1 German language proficiency.

As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
1. Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
2. Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
3. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
4. Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing architecture designs for an enterprise customer's cloud migration, then jump into a working session with solution architects and engineers to refine a wave plan. After lunch, you could lead a stakeholder alignment meeting with a customer's senior leadership team, translating technical trade-offs into business terms. Later, you may document reusable patterns from a recent engagement or coach a junior consultant on their delivery approach. Your work directly connects technical execution to customer business results.

About the team
Our Professional Services team at AWS partners with enterprise customers worldwide to accelerate cloud adoption and help them achieve meaningful business outcomes. We bring together consultants with deep technical skills and real-world delivery experience, working alongside customer teams and AWS Partners to tackle challenges across industries. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and building solutions that scale. As our customers pursue new opportunities in areas like generative AI and intelligent automation, you will play a central role in shaping how they leverage cloud technology for the future.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management
- 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture and implementation
- Experience leading complex and large-scale project delivery in migration programmes.
- Experience with portfolio assessment and application disposition on large VMware estates (1,000+ servers)
- Experience with wave planning: dependency grouping, capacity balancing, and multi-geography coordination under regulatory constraints
- Able to engage with application owners, infrastructure teams, and cross-functional workstreams (Security, Networking, Replatform) to validate dependencies and unblock migration paths
- Experience with application discovery and dependency mapping tools (e.g., ModelizeIT, AWS Application Discovery Service, or equivalent)
- Fluent in German and English

Preferred qualifications

- AWS experience preferred, with proficiency in a wide range of AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation) and in AWS migration services (e.g., MGN, DMS, AWS Transform, Migration Hub)
- AWS Professional level certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional) preferred
- Experience with automation and scripting (e.g., Terraform, Python, PowerShell)
- Knowledge of security and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR)
- Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Hands-on experience with VMware infrastructure discovery tools (RVTools, vCenter, ESXi clusters)
- Knowledge of database migration considerations (Oracle licensing, EC2 vs RDS, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
- Comfortable operating in complex, multi-vendor environments with incomplete documentation and conflicting data sources
- GenAI tooling experience for delivery acceleration (e.g., Amazon Q, Kiro)

title: Coordenador de Planejamento Comercial, Varejo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) é um serviço que visa ajudar marcas e parceiros estratégicos a se desenvolverem de maneira sustentável com a Amazon. AVS ajuda os paceiros na Amazon a crescer de maneira sustentável, além de aumentar a disponibilidade e a descoberta de seus produtos. A Equipe de Especialistas Supply Chain é especializada em ajudar parceiros com desafios operacionais a alinhar melhor seus processos logísticos com a Amazon, analisar problemas de cadeia de suprimentos e desenvolver soluções sustentáveis para evitar perdas financeiras e trazer a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.Nesta posição, você reportará ao líder de gestão de operações de categoria e trabalhará para construir a estratégia de Supply Chain de contas chave. Você será responsável por liderar o planejamento de previsão de estoque, execução de compras e melhoria operacional de projetos, atuando como ponto de contato chave para gestão de estoque para um segmento de fornecedores. Você irá trabalhar na identificação de oportunidades de simplificar e automatizar tarefas, garantindo que sistemas e processos de inventário atendem às necessidades do negócio, implementando controles sobre estes. A pessoa ideal terá energia para lidar com ambiente em que atividades táticas e estratégicas acontecerão paralelamente.

Nesta posição, você irá gerenciar fornecedores de alta complexidade, trabalhando com autonomia para entregar o serviço. Você também será responsável por projetos de médio a alto impacto, atingindo especialistas de Supply Chain AVS em várias categorias de produtos e implementando melhorias de processos escaláveis para todo o varejo da Amazon.

title: Network Development Engineer , GCNA-D , AWS Internet Edge
descriptionHtml:
Do you like to design, operate, and implement networks of large scale? Would you like your work to play a key role to support all aspects of connectivity to/from Amazon and the outside world, as well as the connectivity between Amazon’s data centers and services to design and architect innovation so networks are fail-proof, infinitely scale and grow?

The AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) Organization is looking for a Network Development Engineer to join our EDGE team. Network Development Engineers partner with our broader Infrastructure organization on configurations standards and tools, and collaborate with Systems and Software Engineers to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, and also deploy and sustain networking software tools.

AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) is the backbone that connects the global AWS network. Focused on managing the internet traffic that allows users to access their information and applications regardless of where they are in the world. GCNA is responsible for building and designing a complex backbone network that allows internet traffic to flow efficiently between data centers and customers.

If you like to work with new technologies, optimizing existing technology, and have experience participating in network/systems support for a large-scale enterprise or service provider environment, we would like to meet you. Your work will play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
Network Development Engineers perform high quality network and/or systems operations, deployments, scaling, technology refresh, sustaining engineering, best practices application, optimization, internal/external customer interactions, and produce appropriate technical documentation.
• Create and implement changes on the network according to our change management standards.
• Work closely with our automation teams in defining the tools that allows us to scale at higher volume.
• Lead network projects in the areas of networking sustaining engineering, network deployment/implementation, network scaling, technology refresh, best practices application, and/or network optimization.
• Maintain Amazon Web Services’ next generation networks for significant AWS customers by providing critical network support to diagnose, mitigate impact, and resolve large-scale networking events.
• Operate and troubleshoot network routing, interconnectivity, platforms, performance, and configurations issues; including necessary low-level application interaction, Unix systems, and new age networking software tools.
• Drive and support innovation from Top of Rack to the Network Border, and everything in between.
• Partner with our broader Network/Infrastructure organization in the areas of network engineering, configurations standards, and tools.
• Work closely with our Network/Systems/Software Engineering teams to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, as well as, assist with deployment and sustaining of networking software tools.
• Maintain standards across the networking toolset and ensure that we are fully compliant to those standards and policies.
• Deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions and processes.
• Collaborate with the highest tier escalation engineers/resolvers.
• Create and review documentation and process regarding network implementation/deployments, recurring issues, new standard operating procedures, knowledge transfer material, etc.

A day in the life
Engineers in the GCNA-D organization have a wide range of responsibilities: we evolve routing policy, implement traffic engineering solutions, grow our peering footprint, secure the “front door” from bad actors on the Internet, and architect the hardware platforms and network design to support any Amazon product that needs to reach end-users worldwide. Our infrastructure moves terabits of traffic to and from the Internet at any given moment, and represents one of the largest edge surface areas in the world, requiring complex solutions to ensure that capacity always stays ahead of demand. To accomplish that, our engineers develop automation, write software, and work with a wide range of partner teams to continually improve and automate our Internet connectivity in areas such as capacity delivery, configuration deployment, impairment detection, and traffic optimization. Internet Edge engineers make decisions on both a day-to-day and long-term strategic basis, which carry a large amount of responsibility and impact across all of Amazon’s products.
• Work in a 24x7 team on call rotation, with ability to drive into workplace for critical events/needs.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.

About the team
GCNA-D provides high-performing Internet connectivity for a wide range of use cases, such as retail (amazon.com), video streaming (Prime Video), content delivery (CloudFront), DNS (Route53), AWS services (such as EC2/S3), consumer devices (such as FireTV/Kindle/Echo), and more.

Within AWS Networking, the GCNA-D organization is responsible for connecting Amazon to the global Internet. With connections to thousands of unique external networks in hundreds of locations across the world, our mission is to deliver an Internet connectivity experience that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security, and cost, making Amazon the clear choice for our customers’ needs.

title: GNC System Development Engineer, Prime Air
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Prime Air is seeking a Systems Development Engineer II to join the Drone Guidance, Navigation & Controls (GNC) team as a DO-178C Requirements and Verification Engineer. In this role, you will be a key individual contributor responsible for developing the software requirements, architecture documentation, interface control documents, and verification evidence that form the backbone of Prime Air's DO-178C-compliant software lifecycle. The ideal candidate brings software development experience background and applies that knowledge to the requirements and verification artifacts that govern how that code is built and tested. You will also develop software tools to support simulation, test automation, and analysis, bridging the gap between requirements engineering and the software development team. You operate with moderate autonomy, own your assigned work products end-to-end, and collaborate closely with the tech lead and senior engineers to ensure your artifacts meet DO-178C objectives and certification standards.

Key job responsibilities
- Work on guidance and navigation and control algorithm software.
- Develop System and Software requirements, capturing functional, performance, and safety requirements for GNC software components in compliance with DO-178C planning and development objectives
- Author software architecture documents describing the structure, components, interfaces, and data flows of GNC software modules, ensuring architectural decisions are traceable to requirements
- Develop Interface Control Documents (ICDs) defining software-to-software and software-to-hardware interfaces for GNC components, coordinating with hardware and systems engineering teams to ensure consistency
- Develop verification evidence including test cases and test procedures for requirements-based testing ensuring coverage of all DO-178C DAL C verification objectives
- Develop software tools in Python, MATLAB, or C/C++ to support simulation, test automation, data analysis, and verification reporting — accelerating the team's ability to demonstrate DO-178C compliance

Basic qualifications

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
- Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related fields
- Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience in software development and experience with automation and any version control tools
- Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
- • 5+ years of engineering experience, with at least 3 years of hands-on software development experience in C, C++, or Python in embedded or real-time systems
- • 2+ years of direct experience developing software requirements (HLRs and/or LLRs) or software architecture documentation in a structured, safety-critical, or regulated engineering environment
- • Experience developing software tools or scripts (Python, MATLAB, C/C++) to support simulation, test automation, or data analysis
- • Familiarity with DO-178C (or DO-178B), IEC 61508, ISO 26262, or equivalent safety-critical software standards, including at least 1 year of direct exposure to structured lifecycle processes

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with distributed systems at scale
- Master's degree or above in engineering or equivalent
- Experience with hardware/software integration and real-time systems
- Direct experience developing DO-178C lifecycle artifacts (HLRs, LLRs, test cases, test procedures, ICDs) at DAL C or higher
- Experience developing Interface Control Documents (ICDs) for software-to-hardware or software-to-software interfaces in an aerospace or autonomous systems context
- Experience with model-based design tools (Simulink/Stateflow) for requirements capture or simulation
- Experience with autonomous systems, robotics, GNC algorithms, or unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs)

This role owns the financial case for every launch intake request within the Service Design scope, building investment models that drive go/no-go decisions based on operational cost, readiness investment, and expected downstream service value. It partners with Service Design leaders to develop cost frameworks, methodology, and upstream influence programs that ensure launches are accurately captured and that the financial cost of CS-readiness is consistently quantified, defensible, and evaluated against a clear return.
Beyond launch finance, this role enforces the financial discipline that the business needs: budget control and building the cost structure, leading planning cycles, and continuously improving the models and processes that give CS leadership the clarity to make decisions

Key job responsibilities
Launch investment modeling : build and maintain financial models for launch intake, evaluating cost, readiness investment, and expected service value to support go/no-go decisions with a clear financial rationale

Upstream influence: partner with leaders to embed financial accountability into launch planning, ensuring CS cost is a visible input before decisions are made, not an afterthought after they land

Controllership and planning :Manage Fixed Cost and Variable non productive headcount, budget accountability, actuals tracking and forecasting planning cycles

Financial performance and improvement: identify where cost structures can be optimized, where investment is misaligned with outcomes, and where the business is absorbing costs that are not necesary

Strategic financial stewardship

title: Senior Customer Solutions Manager, Global Financial Services (GFS), AWS
descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Financial Services is hiring a Senior Customer Solutions Manager to lead our cloud partnership with two of Japan's largest financial institutions: a global megabank with $3T+ in assets and operations across 50+ countries, and a leading securities and investment banking firm with significant capital markets presence across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas.

As a Sr. CSM, you own the transformation strategy end-to-end: from establishing vision with C-suite executives, through programmed execution across multiple business units and geographies, to delivering quantifiable outcomes in revenue, adoption, and workload migration. You are the senior technical advisor these institutions rely on to navigate cloud adoption at scale, including AI/ML, Generative AI, data modernization, core banking, and payments.

This role requires someone who can operate autonomously with Japan's most senior banking executives, bring programmatic rigor to complex multi-stakeholder environments, and deliver results across cultural and regulatory boundaries that most people find impenetrable.

Key job responsibilities
- Own executive relationships (CxO, Group CTO/CIO, BU heads) at assigned customers, establish trust, align on strategic outcomes, and drive decisions that unlock enterprise-wide AWS adoption
- Define and execute the cloud transformation strategy for each customer, including migration targets, modernization priorities, AI/ML adoption roadmap, and new solution development, with clear milestones and measurable KPIs
- Lead cross-functional programs spanning multiple geographies, business units, and regulatory regimes, coordinating AWS account teams (GAM, SA, TAM, ProServe) and customer stakeholders to maintain velocity
- Drive AI/ML and Generative AI adoption: identifying use cases, facilitating working-backwards sessions, and accelerating proof-of-concept to production deployment
- Install governance structures and Cloud Business Office capabilities that make the customer self-sustaining, not dependent on AWS hand-holding
- Act as voice of customer into AWS product, engineering, and leadership: unblock roadmap gaps, secure executive sponsorship for customer-critical features, and close the feedback loop
- Mentor CSMs across the region, raising the bar for executive engagement, technical depth, and strategic thinking through direct coaching and community contribution
- Track and report transformation outcomes (migration velocity, service adoption breadth, revenue growth, workload count) to customer executives and AWS leadership

A day in the life
Lead working-backwards sessions with megabank executives to define Generative AI roadmaps. Review migration velocity metrics with a securities firm's Cloud CoE: identify blockers, escalate gaps. Facilitate QBRs with Group CIOs presenting cloud value realization. Coach CSMs on executive stakeholder management. Join GFS EMEA-APJ leadership syncs to share Japan market insights. You operate across Tokyo, London, and US time zones, balancing deep customer work with team leadership.

About the team
The AWS Industries (AWSI) team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

GFS Japan sits within the broader GFS EMEA-APJ organization. The team partners with Japan's leading banks and capital markets firms to drive cloud transformation at enterprise scale. You'll work alongside a senior GAM leader, a dedicated SA team, TAMs, and Professional Services consultants. The culture is high-trust, high-autonomy: we hire people who operate with conviction and don't need permission to do the right thing for the customer.

- 2+ years of customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
- Experience leading technical and non-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams
- Japanese Fluency and Business level English

title: Senior Building Management System Specialist, Global BMS Technical Services
descriptionHtml:
Global BMS Technical Services (GBTS) is Amazon's centralized Building Management System (BMS) technical support organization. GBTS operates within the Global Energy, Sustainability & Automation (GESA) division, which is part of OPS - GEMS (Global Engineering, Materials & Sustainability). OPS - GEMS is the enterprise responsible for driving engineering excellence, materials innovation, and sustainability initiatives across Amazon's global operations infrastructure.

OPS - GEMS leads the design, deployment, integration, and lifecycle management of building automation platforms, energy infrastructure, and sustainability technologies across Amazon's worldwide operations network. This includes HVAC sequence of operations, environmental controls, energy metering, power distribution, and carbon reduction strategies.

Within this mission, GBTS serves as the frontline technical arm. We ensure that every facility's BMS operates at peak performance while advancing Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment.

GBTS is a destination for engineers and technical professionals who excel in high-impact, operationally demanding environments. We operate at the intersection of building science, automation engineering, and sustainability, tackling complex technical challenges at scale.

We foster an open and inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and technical expertise. Our strength lies in deep cross-functional collaboration: controls engineers partnering with energy analysts, sustainability specialists aligning with program managers, and field technicians providing critical insights that shape platform architecture. We are committed to operational excellence, uphold the highest standards of safety and quality, and are driven by the understanding that the systems we design, build, and maintain directly enable Amazon to deliver on its commitment to customers and the planet.

Join us and be part of the team that powers, optimizes, and sustains Amazon's global operations infrastructure, ensuring every facility runs smarter, safer, and more sustainably.

Key job responsibilities
We are seeking an experienced Senior Building Management System (BMS) Specialist to join an existing team that supports post-project activities across one of the largest BMS portfolios in the world. This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong technical foundation in BMS programming, HVAC controls, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will maintain, enhance, and optimize our global services, ensuring seamless BMS functionality and delivering unparalleled customer experiences.

1. Support the development and execution of a comprehensive strategy for maintaining, improving, and expanding our global support services
2. Collaborate closely with GRBD&E, D&C, Sustainability, RME, and other stakeholders to understand customer requirements, business objectives, and operational needs
3. Design, implement, and manage BMS standard operating procedures, policies, and processes that are scalable across the globe
4. Maintain and optimize BMS technologies, IoT platforms, and data analytics tools
5. Monitor and maintain ticket and work order queues, ensuring customer care and quality meet the high bar
6. Ensure compliance with change management processes
7. Monitor and analyze BMS data to proactively identify and action opportunities for optimization, energy efficiency, and cost savings
8. Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and vendors, ensuring a customer-centric approach
9. Provide strategic insights and recommendations to management on BMS trends, improvements, issues, root causes, team skillsets, industry best practices, and emerging technologies
10. Take ownership of BMS initiatives, develop technical documentation, manage timelines, and coordinate with stakeholders
11. Lead training sessions and development programs to continuously enhance the capabilities and technical skills of field RME teams and BMS Specialists
12. Drive a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team
13. Willingness to work flexible shifts to provide 24/7 BMS support across global time zones

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Electronics/Communications Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent work experience)
- Experience in BMS programming, commissioning & troubleshooting
- Ability to integrate multiple communications protocols such as BACnet, LON, Modbus, and SNMP to a single platform with normalized data for standard visualization
- Ability to remotely troubleshoot BMS communication issues, including fieldbus (BACnet, LON, Modbus via RS485), Network Gateways and IP-based protocols (Niagara Fox, MQTT, BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP)
- Deep understanding of HVAC, lighting, utilities, field devices, and other building systems, as well as energy management principles
- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize initiatives in a dynamic environment
- Excellent problem-solving skills with a strategic and innovative mindset
- Organized and self-motivated to take ownership of complex tasks
- Provide 24/7 BMS support through flexible shift coverage, ensuring global customers receive timely and reliable assistance

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in cross-regional BMS projects with multicultural teams
- Proficiency in cloud-based IoT platforms, data analytics, and visualization tools
- Certification in relevant programming languages or BMS systems
- Certification with Tridium Niagara
- Certification with Distech Controls
- Strong customer relationship management skills
- Experience and understanding of facility management and relevant electrical and mechanical aspects of BMS equipment
- Proficiency in additional spoken languages

title: Senior Creative Lead, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Senior Creative Lead to own and evolve the Fauna brand across every touchpoint. This is a hands-on, high-impact role, and the distinction matters: this is a creative lead, not a creative director. You won't be setting the tone from the top down. You'll be capturing, harmonizing, and amplifying the tone that already lives inside this company, its mission, and its people.

You'll be responsible for visual design, brand strategy, social content, web design, and creative direction, all working together as one cohesive visual system. You'll report into the marketing team and work closely with the rest of the product design team.

This isn't a role where you sit in a silo. You'll be embedded in the work, shaping how Fauna looks, feels, and sounds to the world, from our website to our social channels to our product launches. We need someone who's hungry to build something from the ground up and isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves.

Key job responsibilities
- Capture and amplify Fauna's creative vision across the brand identity, ensuring consistency and quality across all channels and formats

- Design and produce high-quality visual assets for social media, web, product marketing, events, and campaigns

- Own brand strategy and creative direction, translating Fauna's mission and product story into compelling visual narratives

- Ask the hard questions that resolve ambiguity: define who we are and who we aren't, and make sure every piece of creative reflects that clarity

- Build and maintain a scalable visual design system that ties together web, social, product, and marketing

- Drive the design and evolution of Fauna's web presence, ensuring it reflects the brand and follows the visual system as a whole

- Develop social content strategies and produce content that builds community and drives engagement

- Collaborate directly with founders and cross-functional teams to bring creative ideas from concept to execution, functioning as a true player-captain who leads by doing

- Raise the creative bar and establish processes that allow the brand to scale as the company grows

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing campaign performance data and refining a creative brief for an upcoming initiative. By midday, you are leading a cross-functional review with design, marketing, and agency partners — pressure-testing concepts and sharpening the narrative. In the afternoon, you could be evaluating new generative AI tools for creative production or presenting strategic recommendations to senior leadership. Throughout it all, you are balancing hands-on craft with big-picture thinking, ensuring every touchpoint ladders back to a clear creative vision.

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Keynote
- Experience leading creative development of innovative creative from concept to delivery
- Experience managing creative (internal team of designers, copywriters, external agencies and freelancers)
- Experience presenting creative concepts effectively to senior executives
- Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines

title: HR Manager
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Manager is a key strategic partner on the PXT team, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, culture, and change management. This role balances tactical excellence with strategic insight, leveraging both technology and human judgment to align local leadership, centralized support, and systems in delivering high-quality employee experiences.

You will drive operational excellence through strategic leadership at your site(s), translating priorities into actionable plans while leveraging technology and data to enhance decision-making. Leading a diverse team of HR professionals, you'll balance automation with human insight to drive excellence throughout the employee lifecycle. Success demands operational excellence, leadership presence, and the ability to connect strategic vision to execution.

The HR Manager leads and is responsible for operational excellence and organizational health through strategic PXT leadership and effective people management. They strengthen culture and deliver business results by translating organizational priorities into actionable plans through their site’s PXT function. HR Managers execute business goals through hands-on leadership and data-driven decision making, while partnering with business leaders to improve leadership effectiveness and employee experience.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility, ensuring personal connection and hands-on leadership where needed.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead a diverse team of HR professionals with varying levels of experience to drive operational excellence through high-judgment decisions, risk mitigation, and employee experience enhancement. Guide your team in ensuring practices comply with company policies, procedures, and federal, state, and provincial laws or regulations, while fostering their professional growth and expertise.

- Partner with Business Leader(s) to strengthen culture and deliver business results. Create an environment where employees feel safe, valued, and respected through data-driven workforce solutions and effective people management practices.

- Monitor employee sentiment through regular floor presence, data analysis, and feedback mechanisms. Hold leaders accountable for delivering positive employee experiences and implement targeted action plans to strengthen culture.

- Drive adoption and optimization of HR technology solutions to enhance efficiency, data accuracy, and employee experience. Lead the HR team in developing digital fluency, leveraging analytics for decision-making, and utilizing AI to streamline processes while maintaining a human-centered approach.

- Own end-to-end PXT operational excellence through rigorous process execution, structured inspection routines, and effective use of tools and data. Ensure consistent documentation standards and timely issue resolution while escalating systemic concerns appropriately.

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic leadership and hands-on people management, requiring excellent organizational and interpersonal skills to manage multiple priorities. Using AI-powered analytics and data insights, you'll identify trends and opportunities in areas like attrition, attendance, and engagement. From coaching leadership teams to implementing innovative HR technologies, you'll balance technical expertise with human judgment in complex situations. In this fast-paced environment, you'll have the opportunity to create sustainable improvements and meaningful impact across your site and broader organization, helping build a workplace where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to perform at their best.

title: オペレーション改善アシスタント, Sort Center
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は、東京都品川区八潮の物流拠点です。

Amazonでは、地球上で最もお客様を大事にする企業になることを目指しています。これに向けてモチベーションにあふれ、聡明かつ実行力の高い人材が必要となります。Amazonの著しい成長を支えているのが、自社で保有している高品質な輸送ネットワークです。将来の物流業界の変化及び貨物量の増加を見据え、慣習に捉われない新たな輸送網・サービスを構築しており、その輸送ネットワーク上の重要拠点であるソートセンター(SC)の運営管理を行う工程管理アシスタントを募集します。

※ソートセンター(SC)とは
Amazonの自社輸送網において、全国にある大規模倉庫と、各ご家庭までの配達拠点の中継地となる拠点です。お客様への配送スピードを担保しながらより効率的に輸送できるよう、荷物の仕分けを行っています。

困難でもやりがいがあり変化の速い環境の中で成長できる能力があれば、Amazonは最適な職場です。常に改善の機会を探し続ける組織の中では、現状に甘んじることなく常に変化し続け、毎日が初日のような新鮮な気持ちで迎える為、Still Day 1と社内では呼んでいます。日々、お客様の利便性向上の為に考え行動し続けます。その結果として初めてAmazonの今日の成功と、厳しい競争環境の中でも将来の成功が約束されます。そしてもちろん、貴方にもその機会があります。

title: Sales Manager, Theatrical Distribution | Responsable des ventes Distribution Salles, France, Amazon MGM Studios
descriptionHtml:
Amazon MGM Studios is seeking a Sales Manager for France, responsible for implementing sales and distribution strategies across all theatrical releases.
The Sales Manager drives commercial operations to optimize box office performance and profitability for each title, while executing local market strategies aligned with the studio's global objectives.
This role involves actively contributing to the release strategy for Amazon MGM Studios films in France. Key responsibilities include deploying local strategic plans, managing exhibitor relationships, coordinating release scheduling, producing commercial analysis reports, and overseeing the French sales team. This position reports to the Head of Theatrical Distribution, France.

Description du poste
Amazon MGM Studios recherche un·e Responsable des ventes pour la France, chargé·e de mettre en œuvre les stratégies de vente et de distribution pour l'ensemble des sorties en salles.
Le·La Responsable des ventes pilote les opérations commerciales afin d'optimiser les performances au box-office et la rentabilité de chaque titre, tout en exécutant les stratégies de marché local alignées sur les objectifs globaux du studio.
Il s’agit de participer activement à l’élaboration de la stratégie de sortie des films Amazon MGM Studios en France. Avec notamment pour missions de déployer les plans stratégiques locaux, gérer les relations avec les exploitants, coordonner la programmation des sorties, produire des rapports d'analyse commerciale et encadrer l'équipe commerciale française. Ce poste est rattaché à la Directrice de la distribution Salles France.


Key job responsibilities
- Execute sales strategies across theatrical releases in France that align with commercial objectives
- Support deal negotiations under the guidance of the Head of France Theatrical Distribution.
- Develop and maintain strong local exhibitor relationships to drive release performance
- Assist with weekly session planning and negotiate with local exhibitors to secure optimal terms and holdovers to maximize screen count
- Analyze local market trends, audience behavior, and box office performance to inform tactical decisions
- Coordinate operations and technical delivery standards across local exhibition partners

Responsabilités clés
- Participer activement à la mise en œuvre des stratégies commerciales pour l'ensemble des sorties en salles en France, en cohérence avec les objectifs
- Accompagner les négociations commerciales sous la direction du·de la Responsable de la Distribution en Salles France
- Développer et entretenir des relations solides avec les exploitants afin de maximiser les performances des sorties
- Contribuer à la planification hebdomadaire des séances et négocier avec les exploitants pour obtenir les meilleures conditions et prolongations
- Analyser les tendances du marché local, le comportement des audiences et les performances au box-office afin d'éclairer les décisions tactiques
- Coordonner les operations et les standards techniques de diffusion auprès des partenaires d'exploitation

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in French and English at C1 level or above
- Proven experience in theatrical distribution
- Strong interpersonal skills
- Strong negotiation and optimization skills
- Proficiency in commercial and industry analysis tools (Power BI, Rentrak Movies, Numero, Showtime Dashboard…)
- Strong analytical mindset combined with the ability to manage multiple priorities; proactive attitude
- ----Qualifications de base---
- Expérience d’au moins 5 ans en distribution salles
- Capacités relationnelles solides
- Sens de la négociation et de l’optimisation
- Maîtrise des outils d'analyse commerciale et sectorielle (Power BI, Rentrak Movies, Numero, Showtime Dashboard…)
- Esprit analytique affirmé double d’une capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités, proactivité

Preferred qualifications

- Team oriented mindset
- Knowledge of the French theatrical exhibition market dynamics and trends
- Familiarity with film industry economics, revenue models, and box office analytics
- Problem-solving mindset with ability to adapt to rapidly changing market conditions
- ----Qualifications annexes----
- Sens du travail en équipe
- Connaissance des dynamiques et tendances du marché français de l'exploitation en salles
- Connaissance de l'économie de l'industrie cinématographique, des modèles de revenus et parfait analyse du box-office
- Savoir résoudre des problèmes et avoir la capacité de s'adapter à des conditions d’un marché en évolution rapide

title: Learning Program Manager, JP Ops PXT Learning and Talent Development
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our mission is to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. We are looking for a dynamic, organized self-starter to work in the Japan Operations Learning and Talent Development (LTD) team. The JP Ops LTD team’s mission is to establish the standard learning platform overarching multiple businesses such as Fulfillment Centers, Amazon Logistics, Amazon Transportation Services, Global Specialty Fulfillment and others in Japan Operations by creating, localizing and implement innovative and scalable leadership development solutions with long-lasting and measurable results. The ideal candidate is resourceful, customer-focused and team oriented, with strong communication skills, has the ability to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, is able to shift gears in line with business priorities, and enjoys the challenges of developing and improving processes in a dynamic organization. The successful candidate will also have exceptional written and verbal communication skills, superior attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment. Moreover, the ability to work in dynamic and ambiguous areas is imperative.

Amazonのミッションは、地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になることです。そのためには、優秀で聡明、かつ意欲的な人材が必要です。 私たちは、日本のオペレーション（JP Ops）部門のラーニング＆タレントデベロップメント（LTD）チームに勤務する、広い視野とハンズオンでの業務遂行能力を持ち合わせたセルフスターターを求めています。JP Ops LTDチームのミッションは、大規模物流拠点や輸配送網など、JP Ops部門内の複数の事業における様々なレイヤーの社員に向けた標準的な学習プラットフォームを確立することです。 本ポジションでは、自ら各ビジネスにおける人材育成上の課題を洗い出し、適切な育成機会を提供できるようにプログラムを企画し、運営するところまで一貫して担います。 育成プログラムはAmazonグローバルで課題に応じた様々なものが用意されており、これをJP Opsの現状の課題にあわせて導入したり、日本独自のカリキュラムをグローバルチームとともにスクラッチから開発を行ったりします。課題設定から解決までを一貫して担うことのできるポジションです。 そのため、本業務では、人材育成に関する知見・経験はもちろんのこと、担当するビジネスとの連携を密に取って本質的な課題を理解し、ソリューションを提示することができる優れた分析力・提案力や、国内外のプログラム開発チームなどのステークホルダーと強固な関係を築くことができる連携力、細部にまで繊細に目を配れる注意力、文書及び口頭でのコミュニケーション力、及びマルチタスクで業務を行う中で優先付けをしながら緩急をつけて業務遂行できる能力が必要になります。 既存のプロセスに捉われずに開発・改善を行うことのできる挑戦心のある方、不確実性の高い環境でも恐れず道を切り拓けるフロンティア精神のある方のご応募をお待ちしております。

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。




Key job responsibilities
This role owns the strategy and execution of leader onboarding and development programs, defining success measures based on business impact. The Learning Program Manager develops and delivers scalable, world-class learning that enables leaders to serve customers best. Responsibilities include establishing consistent processes to design programs across modalities—online, classroom, virtual instructor-led, and blended—using rapid, agile techniques. The role partners with global stakeholders such as the Global Ops Learning Development team, and with local stakeholders—senior leaders, functional learning teams, and HR business partners—to align programs with business needs.

本ロールは、リーダーのオンボーディング・育成プログラムの戦略立案と実行を担い、事業インパクトに基づく成功指標を定義します。スケーラブルで世界最高水準の学習を開発・提供し、リーダーが顧客に最高のサービスを提供できるようにします。オンライン・集合研修・バーチャル講師主導型・ブレンドなど多様な形式でプログラムを設計する一貫したプロセスを、迅速かつアジャイルな手法で確立します。Global Ops Learning Developmentチーム等のグローバルステークホルダー、およびシニアリーダー・部門別学習チーム・HRビジネスパートナー等のローカルステークホルダーと協働し、プログラムを事業ニーズに整合させます。

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of project management experience
- Experience analyzing data to make business decisions
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 3+ years’ work experience creating Learning and Development program or experience of people development.

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Instructional Design, Adult Learning, Learning Design Principles, Learning Science, Educational Psychology or a related field
- Experience formulating and implementing training and performance improvement strategies
- Experience with eLearning authoring tools and other design programs including: Storyline/Rise 360, Vyond, Adobe Creative Suite, and Camtasia
- Experience creating and validating competency and job architecture models, including creating KSA (knowledge, skills and abilities) and competencies assessment to drive learning paths and learning program design
- Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

title: Brand Designer, Devices Brand Studio
descriptionHtml:
Device Brand Studio, an internal agency within the Devices group at Amazon, is seeking a talented Brand Designer to help bring new Amazon offerings to market, products, services, and features within our devices portfolio. The Brand Designer will execute brand identity and creative assets for product lines and campaigns within Amazon Devices, working within established brand systems and creative direction.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in visual design, typography, and brand systems, and the ability to take creative direction and translate it into polished, on-brand work across a range of formats. You will work closely with creative directors, art directors, and copywriters to bring concepts to life, iterating quickly based on feedback and factoring in customer and business requirements. You should be comfortable presenting your work to peers and leads, taking direction well, and knowing when to ask questions versus when to execute. You should have working knowledge of brand guidelines and creative briefs at a top consumer-facing brand like Amazon.

Because the work is varied and fast-paced, you should have strong craft fundamentals and the ability to manage your own time across multiple projects. You will partner with creative directors, art directors, copywriters, and production to deliver design work across product detail pages, merchandising assets, retail fixtures, and packaging.

This role is for a design-forward contributor who executes with precision, takes direction well, and is looking to grow their craft within a fast-moving in-house creative team.

Key job responsibilities
• Execute brand-consistent design work across digital, retail, and packaging touchpoints, guided by established creative direction
• Apply brand guidelines accurately and consistently across a range of formats and surfaces
• Collaborate with creative directors, art directors, and copywriters to bring concepts to life
• Iterate quickly on design work based on feedback from creative leads and stakeholders
• Prepare and organize design files and assets for handoff to production and other teams
• Contribute ideas and point of view in creative reviews, while executing to the direction set by leads
• Manage time and priorities across multiple concurrent design requests

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of design experience
- Have an available online portfolio
- Experience working with agile development teams (agile/scrum/kanban)
- Experience in Adobe Creative Suit applications, with high proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, and Acrobat using macOS

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with e-commerce, search, social, and other major application types and their UX patterns
- Experience creating services and applications with multiple user touch points on different platforms and devices
