title: Commissioning Engineer, AWS Commissioning
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS is looking for a dynamic Commissioning Engineer. It is the responsibility of all Amazonians to have alignment with our leadership principles and demonstrate these at the highest level.

The responsibilities of the ACx Commissioning Engineer (CxE) include, but are not limited to, oversight and coordination of multi-discipline division of work related to design review and commissioning of Amazon critical infrastructure for new construction and special projects. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems including medium and low voltage power systems, Generators, UPS, HVAC, Chilled Water, BMS, and EPMS systems. They shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to develop and review electrical and mechanical component and integrated systems testing along with other commissioning documents to ensure they are compliant with the basis of design, specification, industry standards and sequence of operations. It is the CxE responsibility to ensure that all commissioning procedures follow the appropriate safety practices and policies. CxE is responsible for auditing commissioning activities continuously to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. The CxE proactively communicates with the ACx Regional Manager and the ACx team to ensure that the applicable test documents are created and executed in accordance with all commissioning requirements. This individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects, lessons learned, and program improvements to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and tight schedules.

Key job responsibilities
Physical Requirements

• Walk job sites in uneven terrain
• Work at heights and from ladders
• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
• Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
• Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
• Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
• Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
• Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
• Work in a noisy environment
• Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment


Additional Job Requirements

• Ability to relocate to the North Virginia area.
• Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 50% of the year. Typical travel is 20%.
• Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Systems Development Engineer, Identity and Access Management
descriptionHtml:
Helis is Amazon's attribute-based authorization platform, part of Identity and Access Management. Thousands of Amazon services use Helis to author access policies, evaluate authorization decisions, and resolve the attributes those decisions depend on. As adoption grows through company-wide security programs, so does the operational load on the team. We are looking for a Systems Development Engineer who wants to own that load and engineer it away.

You will sit between our customers and our engineers. Service teams across Amazon come to Helis to onboard, integrate, and get unblocked, and you will be their first point of contact. You will troubleshoot integration and authorization issues in systems you did not write, resolve routine requests, and hand code-level defects to the owning engineers with a clear reproduction and analysis. Then you will turn what you learn into durable mechanisms: runbooks, operational dashboards, AI agent skills for our support assistant, and automation that resolves routine requests end to end. We measure your success by how much recurring work you eliminate, not by how many tickets you close.

This role is a good fit for an early-career engineer who likes debugging, enjoys helping
other engineers, and wants to build tools with real users from day one. You do not need prior authorization or security experience; you will learn it here, with mentorship from senior engineers on the team.

Key job responsibilities
- Act as first-line technical support for Helis customers in chat and the ticket queue, covering onboarding, integration, security-program, and routine requests.
- Troubleshoot issues across policy evaluation, attribute resolution, connectivity, and client libraries, and escalate defects to the owning team with a reproduction and initial analysis.
- Build and extend AI agent skills that answer recurring customer questions and resolve routine requests.
- Automate routine ticket workflows, such as service limit increases and access requests, end to end with human approval.
- Build and maintain operational dashboards for ticket volume, age, SLA, and deflection.
- Write and maintain runbooks for recurring issues and new programs.
- Participate in weekly operational reviews and contribute to post-incident analyses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth

title: Finance Manager, Amazon Supply Chain Services - Finance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) enables third-party merchants to leverage Amazon's fulfillment, distribution, and transportation network across multiple services including Shipping, Freight, Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCCF), Air, Multi-Channel Distribution (MCD), and Veeqo. As the organization scales, capital investments, network design decisions, and long-term cost structure planning are becoming increasingly critical to ASCS profitability and strategic direction. We are looking for a Finance Manager to own CAPEX investment analysis, network finance, and long-term financial modeling across all six ASCS businesses.

This role sits at the intersection of ASCS Finance, Operations, Network Planning, and the corporate CAPEX finance team. The ideal candidate has strong experience building return on investment models, analyzing capital allocation decisions, and translating complex financial analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership. They are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, partnering with operations and cost owners to evaluate trade-offs, and presenting investment cases to VP-level audiences. This role reports into ASCS FP&A Finance.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end CAPEX investment analysis and reporting across all six ASCS businesses (Shipping, Freight, MCCF, Air, MCD, Veeqo), delivering consolidated views for monthly, quarterly, and annual planning cycles.

- Build and maintain Return on Invested Capital (ROIC) and Return on Assets (ROA) models to evaluate the financial performance of ASCS capital deployments

- Develop long-term free cash flow models to inform multi-year investment strategy and help leadership understand the cash generation trajectory of ASCS.

- Partner with operations teams on network design decisions, providing financial analysis on facility investments, capacity expansion, and network topology changes

- Analyze long-term cost structure across ASCS to identify opportunities for cost optimization, margin improvement, and investment prioritization

- Partner with the corporate CAPEX finance team to ensure ASCS capital requests are properly justified, documented, and aligned with Amazon-wide capital allocation frameworks

- Work directly with cost owners in each business to understand cost drivers, validate assumptions, and build bottom-up investment cases

- Present investment analytics and recommendations to ASCS leadership (L8-L10), translating complex financial models into clear narratives that shape capital allocation decisions

- Support OP1/OP2 annual planning and QxG quarterly cycles with CAPEX and investment-specific inputs, bridging variances and forecasting future capital needs

- Build long-term scalable solutions leveraging AI, including dashboards, automation workstreams, and self-service tools for business and finance leaders

- Thrive and deliver results in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment with competing priorities across finance, operations, and business teams

A day in the life
As part of a team that is building from scratch, you will spend your time connecting with key stakeholders across operations, the corporate CAPEX finance team, and business cost owners. You will build financial models that evaluate capital investment trade-offs, present analytics to help shape where ASCS invests, and own the numbers that inform network design and long-term cost decisions. One day you might be modeling the ROI of a new sort center, the next day you could be analyzing the free cash flow impact of a fleet expansion. The work is highly visible, directly influencing decisions made by VPs and senior leadership.

About the team
Our Finance team is dedicated to providing the insights and analysis that help Amazon make smart, informed decisions at every level. We operate in a collaborative environment where analytical rigor meets creative problem-solving, and where every team member has the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, large-scale outcomes. We are focused on building scalable processes, strengthening financial governance, and continuously raising the bar on how we support the business. If you are looking for a team where your work has visible impact and your growth is supported, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 5+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 5+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience

descriptionHtml:

Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds and operates some of the largest internet infrastructure on the planet; providing companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. With AWS, customers provision compute power, storage, database, and other cloud resources as their business demands them. To meet the growing demand for AWS Services around the globe, we need exceptionally motivated people who are driven by learning and innovation.

Key job responsibilities
Amazon has a collaborative, purposeful and enthusiastic environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” On a typical day engineers might dive deep into understanding the root cause of a customer issue, investigate why a metric is trending the wrong way and consult with the top engineers at Amazon. We own our services and believe in making out-of-hours support as painless as possible. To achieve this, we implement Operational Excellence best practices and strive to automate manual processes.

Our Senior Systems Engineers are considered technical leaders for their team and become subject matter experts in multiple services. They work efficiently and routinely deliver the right things with limited guidance. They use technology to solve complex problems. They are able to improve and/or drive improvements to these services and features for their team. They understand how their work impacts multiple teams. They are able to take a project, when the problem is not defined and deliver on schedule, applying appropriate technologies and industry systems-engineering best practices. They make effective implementation trade-off decisions and are able to assist others with trade-off decisions.

Our Senior Systems Engineers identify when implementations are not highly available, performant, secure, stable, maintainable, or have defects; and are able to determine short- and long-term mitigations. They have a depth and breadth of understanding in multiple areas of technology and they are excellent diagnosticians. They utilise their Linux expertise to troubleshoot, innovate fixes and workarounds, keep software up-to-date and provide data and metrics that help manage the capacity and efficiency of services.

Our Senior Systems Engineers are able to lead team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions. They understand how technical decisions impact their team, and other, teams’ services and recommend opportunities and solutions for these problems. They optimize and/or automate team processes, ensuring they meet organisation goals. They lead implementation reviews (e.g., designs, code, operational readiness, deployment plans, system changes, etc.). They anticipate and mitigate patterns that affect the performance, reliability, or availability of their team(s) systems to create automation that simplifies workloads that scale operations.

Our Senior Systems Engineers drive SOP, documentation, and runbook creation, reviewing them for accuracy; they drive the use of best practices. They actively recruit and interview for their team and help others leverage their own expertise, by coaching and mentoring. They communicate clearly and collaborate with others to deliver results. They are self-starters, comfortable dealing with ambiguity and change. They are customer-obsessed, always looking to understand customer pain points and find resolutions quickly and completely.

A day in the life

title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.
• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.
• Support the business on an as needed basis by serving as a peer trainer and/or working at nearby site locations within the area
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!
• Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road
• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.
• Long-term growth potential via comprehensive training in transportation with Amazon.
• Dependent on business need, you may have the opportunity to earn your Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) paid for by Amazon.

Join ATS! ATS is one of the fastest growing business lines within Amazon over the past 5 Years with continued growth to come!

If requested due to business need, Transportation Associates must obtain their Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) and Driver Qualification File (DQF) and utilize it as a condition of the role, paid for by Amazon. If Associate is requested to become CDL and DQF certified to drive Over-the-Road for Amazon, this position becomes regulated by the Department of Transportation (DOT) and follows regulations issued by the DOT’s Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must hold a valid driver’s license for the state in which they reside and be eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements. For Department of Labor/Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration roles (roles for which you receive a CDL), English proficiency is required per federal regulation.
The timing of this requirement is dependent on business need. Continuing in the position with CDL and DQF certification is contingent upon the successful completion of a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening, a DOT physical and Amazon’s pre-employment drug test.

descriptionHtml:

You will have your leadership capacity stretched to its full potential, As a front-line leader, you will have an opportunity to truly invest in others and develop a people-focused leadership style, while mastering the tools, processes, and operations that have created the most customer-centric company on Earth. title: Sr. Product Manager, Refunds CX, Refunds CX
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR), we aspire to zero: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects.

We are an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are constantly innovating to create long-term value at Amazon by investing in the future and focusing on the planet, not just on the bottom line. WWRR includes business, product, program, operational, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products.

WW R&R includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WW R&R, you will partner across these teams to help customers get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

Refunds Customer Experience (Refunds CX) is a charter of WW R&R that is dedicated to providing the best-in-class refunds experience to customers, by prioritizing faster refunds and ensuring 100% completeness. We strive to build a strong enforcement function to preserve CX, mitigate risk & avoid policy abuse.

We are looking for a seasoned Product Leader who has a passion for working in cross-functional environments, strong communication skills (verbal & written) in addition to proven product management experience. Join us if you want the opportunity to make a big impact in a quickly growing team that can make a big difference in the customers' journey with Amazon.

Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WW R&R, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will
- Work with product managers, software developers, program managers and operational partners to improve the customer return experience and re-commerce programs.

- Champion global Amazon processes, identify improvement opportunities, devise strategies and guide and implement the improvement effort worldwide.

- Be a leader, required to collaborate cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business retail teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

- Create vision, disambiguate complex problem spaces, roadmap, and execution across a suite of refund products to improve customer trust.

- Develop worldwide mechanisms with huge customer-facing and financial impact

The ideal candidate for the role demonstrates
- Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize workloads, maintain a strong attention to detail and work independently in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment

- Excellent Product Management skills with a proven ability to design scalable solutions and drive projects to successful implementation

- Strong analytical and data gathering skills, including the ability to translate large amounts of data into actionable insights

- Participate in internal business performance reviews and business reviews to understand trends, develop action plans, and share business plans and performance

A day in the life
You will work with a team of high performing Product/Program Managers, tech counter part on planning and prioritization of product roadmap. You understand the systems and technologies behind your product, their limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons for architectural decisions. You are capable of articulating when a new technology is needed (and when it is not) or discuss the differences between two technology offerings. You proactively mitigate risks and help reduce a product’s exposure to classic failure modes.

About the team
WW Refunds CX team under the broader WW Returns CX (WW RCX) sub-org, plays a critical role in the overall Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WW R&R) org by ensuring customers are provided timely and complete refunds. To address this area of paramount importance, we partner with multiple orgs outside WWRR, primarily CS, Ordering, Payments, and internally with Tech & Data Engineering to ensure faster refunds and 100% refund completion across a varying breadth of diverse use-cases and geographies. This IC role serves as a central orchestrator within this strategic workstream, responsible for designing and prioritizing optimal product investments while coordinating end-to-end execution.

- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

title: Responsable de Site de Remédiation, WHS Due Diligence and Remediation
descriptionHtml:
Au sein de l'équipe Due Diligence et Remédiation Santé et Sécurité au Travail (WHS), vous occuperez le poste de Responsable de Site de Remédiation WHS et jouerez un rôle crucial dans la protection des communautés et de l'environnement. Votre mission : collaborer avec les équipes internes et externes de conception, de construction et d'exploitation, en apportant conseils, soutien et supervision de consultants sur les sites concernés.


Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités du poste

Développer un programme couvrant plusieurs équipes de parties prenantes afin de garantir une gestion sûre et conforme des sites contaminés.
Assumer la gestion départementale des sites contaminés après la due diligence, en veillant au respect de toutes les conditions d'approbation : gestion des contrôles techniques, restrictions d'usage et reporting.
Fournir des directives pour les conceptions de contrôles techniques préparées par les prestataires et les examiner.
Apporter un soutien à la planification de projet en phase de pré-construction, notamment en fournissant les informations de pré-construction et les informations techniques nécessaires aux procédures d'appel d'offres.
Examiner les dossiers d'appel d'offres et les réponses reçues afin de vérifier l'inclusion des exigences de conception et de santé et sécurité.
Examiner et valider les Plans de Gestion des Matériaux (Material Management Plans) et les Plans de Gestion de Site (Site Management Plans) pour s'assurer de leur conformité aux exigences d'Amazon.
Coordonner, inspecter et superviser les équipes prestataires et les cabinets de conseil en environnement lors des activités de construction en sous-sol.
Réaliser des inspections des systèmes de recouvrement (capping) et de confinement des sites contaminés.
Communiquer les risques à l'ensemble des parties prenantes, notamment les équipes de conception, de construction, d'exploitation et de rénovation.
Assurer l'interface avec les équipes de pré-construction/conception et de construction afin d'identifier et d'atténuer les risques environnementaux.
Suivre les calendriers des projets et tenir à jour la documentation des activités de conformité.
Veiller à ce que toutes les phases de développement et d'exploitation des sites respectent les exigences réglementaires.
Soutenir les travaux de rénovation sur les sites contaminés du portefeuille d'Amazon, dans la mesure des capacités disponibles.
Ce poste nécessite une coordination entre plusieurs équipes Amazon, des agences de réglementation et des parties prenantes externes, ainsi que des partenaires tels que les propriétaires fonciers, les structures de promotion immobilière et les équipes prestataires.

Basic qualifications

- Expérience de la communication avec un large éventail de parties prenantes, y compris des collègues et la direction, ou expérience de l'interaction avec une clientèle externe.
- Expérience en saisie et analyse de données précises.
- Un diplôme de licence (Bachelor) ou un niveau de qualification équivalent conformément au Cadre Européen des Certifications (CEC) en Géologie, Sciences de l'Environnement, Chimie, Génie Chimique ou Environnemental, Génie Civil, ou domaine d'études connexe.
- Expérience en construction ou en gestion de projet.
- Expérience en lecture, interprétation et création de plans de construction, de spécifications et de documents de soumission.
- Expérience en construction et gestion de sites contaminés, de préférence avec une expertise en PFAS.
- Connaissance des réglementations environnementales et des exigences de conformité.
- Expérience des contrôles techniques environnementaux et des systèmes de remédiation (recouvrements, systèmes de couverture, systèmes d'atténuation des intrusions de vapeurs/méthane, etc.).
- Expérience du travail avec des restrictions foncières ou de propriété (deed restrictions) et des contrôles d'usage des sols.

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:

The ideal candidate should be able to deal with ambiguity with resilience, successfully influence diverse global senior leadership with holistic mechanism, manage and move forward complex initiatives/programs, and make strategic quality decisions and trade-offs based on data and resources. The experience of working autonomously across various level of experience from global leadership to local business teams in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment is highly preferred.

 • Closely work and review with worldwide counterparts, leadership and business teams for roadmap priority and resources allocation based on data-driven metrics; and relentlessly improve the existing process to ensure a seamless communication across global, emerging central ops team and local leadership team.
 • Define and continuously shape the strategy based on data insight. Utilized Excel, SQL, Python and dashboard to manage data to determine target Sellers/Selection for new product/project adoption. Conduct forecasting by recognizing past data & trends.

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Amazon Business - External Integrations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Business System Integrations connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner procurement, ERP, and finance systems. We build the APIs, protocols, and agentic experiences that let customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that make these integrations smarter, faster, and more reliable. You will drive model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across external systems integrations.

Our work includes API-based and protocol-based shopping, such as punchout and emerging agent protocols, along with agentic interactions where buyers and AI agents search, compare, and purchase through natural language. It also covers partner onboarding and integration automation, mapping and normalizing catalog, product, and order data across many partner formats, and evaluation frameworks that measure the quality, accuracy, and latency of our agents.

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will work across three dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence.

Invent: You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches and emerging research. You practice customer-obsessed science, working backwards from the needs of business buyers, procurement teams, and integration partners to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methods for agentic shopping, product search and matching, schema and data mapping across partner systems, and automated evaluation of agent quality. You help define the research agenda for our agentic and protocol-based capabilities, and you lead the scientific strategy for accurate, low-latency responses in conversational and API-driven procurement. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations.

Implement: The ML components you develop are integrated directly into production systems serving Amazon Business customers and partners worldwide. You make sound tradeoffs between accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and short-term and long-term solutions, favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the right level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI frameworks, largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with catalog, offer, cart, order, and partner data sources and with the services that power external integrations.

Influence: You contribute to planning for the team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for expanding agentic and integration capabilities across new partners, protocols, and countries. You collaborate with engineering, product, and program teams across Amazon Business so that data integration and ML pipelines are robust and scale with adoption. You mentor scientists and engineers, champion best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC), and provide peer feedback on research methods and results. You help recruit bar-raising talent through interview drives, and you are visible in the broader scientific community as a subject matter expert, including serving as a Program Committee member or reviewer for peer-reviewed venues.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 8+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
- Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

title: Sr. Design Technologist, AWS Search, Security, Observability, Governance
descriptionHtml:
Most design teams hand off static mockups and hope engineering builds them faithfully. Our team runs a design intelligence flywheel — Delight Lab, where we prototype and test new patterns in real code; DesignBrain, knowledge-backed design agents that learn from what we test and hold our evolving library of evidence-cited design guidelines; and the front-end experience layer that turns all of it into production-quality interfaces. We're looking for a Senior Design Technologist to live at the center of that loop.

This is a role for someone who thinks in both design and code and refuses to treat them as separate disciplines. You'll build high-fidelity, interactive prototypes that behave like the real thing — not clickable facades — so we can put genuine experiences in front of customers and learn fast. You'll help extend DesignBrain so that what we learn in Delight Lab becomes reusable intelligence rather than tribal knowledge. And you'll raise the quality of our front-end craft, building the components, patterns, and tooling that let designers and engineers move at the same speed without losing fidelity between intent and implementation.

You should be as comfortable in a design critique as in a pull request. You'll turn ambiguous design ambition into working systems, make our prototypes indistinguishable from product, and help our team prove that design is a competitive weapon — by shipping the evidence.

Key job responsibilities
1. Build high-fidelity, interactive prototypes in real code — experiences that behave like the product, not clickable facades — so the team can put genuine interactions in front of customers and learn fast in Delight Lab.
2. Partner with designers to turn ambiguous design ambition into working systems, closing the gap between design intent and front-end implementation so nothing is lost in handoff.
3. Extend DesignBrain so that what the team proves in Delight Lab becomes reusable, evidence-cited intelligence — codified patterns and components rather than tribal knowledge.
4. Raise the quality and velocity of the front-end experience layer: build the components, design-system primitives, and tooling that let designers and engineers move at the same speed without sacrificing fidelity.
5. Prototype net-new interaction patterns for agentic and AI-native surfaces, where the established pattern language doesn't yet exist and has to be invented and tested.
6. Collaborate daily with design, product, and engineering — translating between disciplines and making technical feasibility a first-class input to design decisions, early rather than late.
7. Instrument prototypes so the team learns from real usage, and feed those findings back into the flywheel.
8. Raise the bar for engineering craft across the team through code review, reusable patterns, and mentorship.

A day in the life
Your morning might start in a design critique, where a teammate's concept sparks a "let me just build that" — and by midday you have a working prototype in real code that answers a question no static mockup could. In the afternoon you pair with a designer to pressure-test an interaction, then commit the pattern into DesignBrain so the whole team inherits it. Later you're deep in the front-end layer, refactoring a component so it's production-quality and reusable, not a one-off. Across the week you move between zoomed-out questions (what should an agentic security surface even feel like?) and zoomed-in craft (is this transition, this default, this micro-interaction right?). You're trusted to decide what's worth building to learn versus building to ship — and you're surrounded by designers and engineers who treat prototyping as thinking, not decoration.

About the team
We're the design team behind AWS SSOG experiences, and we run a design intelligence flywheel: Delight Lab (where we prototype and test in real code), DesignBrain (a knowledge-backed design agent that learns from what we test and holds our evolving library of evidence-cited guidelines), and the front-end experience layer that turns it all into production-quality product. We treat design as a competitive weapon, not a line item — and we prove it by shipping the evidence, not just the mockups. We're a senior, tight-knit group that gives our people genuine ownership, invests in craft and tooling, and cares about raising each other's work. For a technologist who refuses to choose between design and code, there's no better place to do the work.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of front-end technologist, engineer, or UX prototyper experience
- Have coding samples in front end programming languages
- Have an available online portfolio
- Experience developing visually polished, engaging, and highly fluid UX prototypes
- Experience collaborating with UX, Product, and technical partners

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of databases and AWS database services: ElasticSearch, Redshift, DynamoDB
- Experience with machine learning (ML) tools and methods

title: Executive Assistant, Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Are you always looking around corners and anticipating needs? Do you believe that details matter and want to support a highly engaged team operating at the pace and scale of a fast-moving global organization?

We are looking for an exceptionally bright, well-organized, and self-motivated Executive Assistant to become part of our team within AWS Forward Deployed Engineering. As an Executive Assistant to two directors, you will have the opportunity to work in partnership with our leaders, a solid team of other Executive Assistants, and key business partners across multiple regions. FDE operates globally across AMER, EMEA, APJC, and WWPS geographies, which means this role requires comfort navigating complex, multi-region coordination and fast-changing priorities. We are seeking a driven, bright, and motivated individual with a history of high performance to support our organization. This exciting role requires superior attention to detail, great organization and prioritization skills, the ability to plan ahead and meet tight deadlines, all while juggling multiple critical requests in a high-velocity, customer-obsessed environment.

A high level of integrity and discretion in handling confidential information and professionalism in dealing with leaders (in and outside Amazon) is important, as is the ability to be flexible and change direction seamlessly all while having fun. The successful candidate will possess the ability to complete complex tasks and projects quickly with little guidance, react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround, and want to take on varied and exciting new projects and learn new skills. Given the pace of FDE engagements and the global nature of our delivery pods, you will need to take effective action without having to know the total picture and efficiently and proactively solve difficult or complex problems that affect people within the department or other related groups.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities for this position include complex calendar management and scheduling of internal and external meetings across multiple time zones, managing travel bookings for a globally distributed organization with active customer engagements, handling expenses, multi-tasking during ad hoc projects, preparing documentation for meetings, assisting with presentations, and a variety of other day-to-day administrative tasks on behalf of the Directors. You will also help coordinate logistics for customer-facing engagements, leadership reviews, and cross-functional activities spanning FDE, AWS ProServe, Marketing, GTM, WWSO, AGS Sales and SA, and Partner organizations.



A day in the life
Organize, prioritize, and appropriately handle time-sensitive, confidential information and ensure action items are addressed in a timely manner.

Organize, execute, and assist with team activities (staff meeting agendas, on-sites/off-sites, team social events, customer engagement events, and FDE pod coordination activities).

Schedule cost-effective air, hotel, and ground transportation. Create detailed travel itineraries, both domestic and international, including smooth transitions between time zones to support leaders who travel frequently for customer-embedded engagements across global regions.

Coordinate with in-house travel agents and manage international travel processes. Submit expense reports in a timely fashion.

Coordinate closely with Recruiting teams, Facilities team, HR team, and other Executive Assistants within the Amazon community, as well as with cross-functional stakeholders across the FDE and broader AWS ProServe ecosystem.

Track and help drive completion of key deliverables and follow up on items to include meeting notes and action items, ensuring leadership stays connected across a fast-moving, globally distributed organization.

About the team
AWS Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is on a mission to make every business an AI-powered business. Backed by a $1 billion investment, FDE embeds small pods of experienced AWS engineers directly into customer environments to build, deploy, and scale production-grade agentic AI systems in days, not months. Our model is agentic-first: we compress timelines, deliver measurable business outcomes, and ensure customers are fully self-sufficient when engagements end. We work with some of the world's most ambitious organizations and we are just getting started. We pursue bold opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of senior level leadership support, or 1+ years of Amazon experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with executive level calendar management

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company
- Experience managing multiple calendars

title: Principal Security SA, AWS Industries Tech, Security Specialists
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to solve the hardest security challenges behind the world's most ambitious innovations? Join AWS as a Principal Security Solutions Architect and become the advisor that industry-leading organizations rely on to move faster and safer in the AI era, against a threat landscape that reinvents itself every day.

Our team is dedicated to the world's largest and most recognized enterprises - the organizations whose innovations define their industries - and you will be part of the group that supports them directly. The toughest, highest-stakes security problems are the ones standing between their boldest ideas and real-world impact, and that is where you come in. You turn security, risk, and compliance into an accelerator for innovation rather than a barrier to it, helping customers adopt AWS - including AI specific solutions - securely, modernize their security capabilities and practices, and help customers defend against emerging threats. You'll be the trusted advisor who owns multiple CISO relationships and earns a place on their speed dial, sitting shoulder to shoulder with the business and technology decision makers at these organizations to turn their hardest problems into outcomes that move their industry forward. Internally, you'll be recognized as a key thought leader and influence how AWS shapes its platform to meet the evolving needs of our customers - raising their security bar while enabling them to move faster and safer.

This role supports our largest customers in the telecommunications industry, so an interest in or exposure to that space is a welcome bonus, though it is the security and AI expertise you bring that matters most.

If you love solving hard problems, want your work to matter, and get energy from helping others succeed, this is a place to do the best work of your career.

Key job responsibilities
As a Principal Security Solutions Architect, you will:

- Serve as the trusted security advisor to the customers you support, owning relationships with CISOs and other senior business and technology decision makers
- Operate in ambiguous, first-of-their-kind situations where no established playbook exists, bringing clarity and creating the approach others will follow
- Decompose your customers' hardest security, risk, and compliance problems into clear architectures they can confidently implement
- Think big and drive security change at industry scale, shaping how entire sectors - not just individual customers - adopt and secure emerging technology
- Advise on securing AI workloads, from protecting sensitive data to safely adopting new generative and agentic capabilities
- Help customers stay ahead of a fast-changing threat landscape and strengthen their defenses against emerging threats
- Operate with a high degree of independence, setting your own direction and delivering strategic outcomes with minimal guidance
- Create reusable guidance, reference architectures, and best practices that scale your impact far beyond any single engagement
- Advocate for your customers by channeling their needs and emerging trends into the AWS services roadmap
- Establish thought leadership, inside AWS and publicly, through writing, speaking, and engagement with the broader security community

A day in the life
No two days look the same. One morning you might be deep in a working session with a customer's security architects, untangling a thorny compliance question that's been holding up a major launch. By the afternoon you're in front of a CISO, helping them think through how to safely adopt AI without slowing their teams down. In between, you're comparing notes with other security advisors, sharing a pattern you developed, and flagging a customer trend to the AWS service teams who can act on it. Some days you're writing or speaking; every day you're making security a little easier for the people who depend on it.



About the team
We are a team of security advisors to the world's largest and most recognized enterprises, and our mission is simple: make security the thing that helps our customers move faster and safer, not the thing that slows them down. We work alongside each other and with teams across AWS - service owners, account teams, and industry specialists - to solve problems no one has a playbook for yet. Our culture runs on trust, deep technical curiosity, and a bias for sharing what we learn so the whole organization gets better (raising the bar for all customers). We have each other's backs, we take real ownership of our customers' hardest challenges, and we care as much about building each other up as we do about the work itself.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in cloud architecture and CXO level engagement
- Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications
- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience in one or more of the following: application security frameworks, security code reviews, incident response, security infrastructure, penetration testing, mobile security, cloud security, AI security, identity and access controls

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Knowledge of distributed systems design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Knowledge of database design and implementation or equivalent

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 6, 2026

About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical
- 2+ years of Mechanical or Electrical apprenticeship experience

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The starting pay for this position is listed below. Final starting pay will be based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits.

title: Solution Architect, Vehicle Technology CoE
descriptionHtml:
AWS's Vehicle Technology Team is a global Center of Excellence covering AMER, EMEA and APJ. It helps automakers, Tier-1 suppliers and mobility companies build the next generation of vehicles on AWS. As a Senior Solutions Architect, you'll set the worldwide technical strategy for our three core areas: Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV), ADAS/Autonomous Driving, and E/E Architecture. You'll be the technical lead on pilot engagements with strategic customers. You'll also choose and build relationships with key technology partners, and turn new ideas into demos for the industry's biggest stages.

This role is for a hands-on technologist who can talk architecture with OEM engineering leaders in the morning and build a working prototype in the afternoon. You'll have real influence on how AWS shows up in the automotive industry.

Key job responsibilities
Technical strategy: Guide the worldwide technical strategy for Vehicle Technology across SDV, ADAS/AV and E/E Architecture, and turn industry trends into reference architectures and solution patterns.
Pilot customer engagements: Lead pilot engagements with strategic automotive customers from discovery through proof of concept, and help turn them into production pipeline.
Partner ecosystem: Choose and work closely with key automotive partners (silicon, simulation, middleware, toolchain and systems integrators) to build joint solutions.
Industry demos: Build demos for flagship events such as AWS re:Invent, CES and IAA Mobility, working with account solutions architects.
Ambassador programs: Represent AWS in strategic technology ambassador programs, such as with NVIDIA and OpenAI.
Thought leadership: Speak at conferences, write blogs and whitepapers, and give product teams feedback from the field.

A day in the life
No two days are the same. In the morning you might meet with the E/E architecture team at a European OEM to look at how a zonal compute design maps to a cloud-native development and validation toolchain. Around midday you could join a working session with a silicon or simulation partner to scope a joint reference architecture for virtual ECUs and large-scale ADAS simulation. In the afternoon you might get hands-on with a prototype for the next CES or IAA Mobility demo, working with an account solutions architect who has a customer ready to see it.


About the team
The Vehicle Technology Team is a global Center of Excellence in AWS Automotive, with members across AMER, EMEA and APJ. title: Senior Delivery Consultant AI - Enterprises, AWS Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specialising in AI/ML and generative AI to join our Data & AI practice. In this role, you will lead the technical direction and delivery of complex enterprise AI engagements, working across multiple workstreams and helping customers establish repeatable capabilities for adopting AI responsibly at scale.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role. You will move between strategic and implementation detail: shaping solutions and delivery roadmaps around customer use cases with senior stakeholders, making architecture and engineering trade-offs, reviewing code and evaluation evidence, and removing technical blockers for delivery teams. You will operate effectively when requirements are incomplete, making evidence-based recommendations and creating clarity for customer, AWS, and partner teams.

Beyond individual solutions, you will help customers address the wider conditions required for sustained value from AI, including data readiness, platform architecture, security, governance, operating models, adoption, and value measurement. You will also strengthen the Data & AI practice through mentoring, technical standards, reusable assets, and feedback from customer delivery.

The AWS Professional Services organisation is a global team of experts that helps customers realise their desired business outcomes using AWS. We work with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud and AI transformation initiatives.

Key job responsibilities
- Translate customer use cases and business objectives into well-scoped AI solutions with measurable success criteria, technical requirements, and an iterative delivery plan.
- Design and implement production AI solutions on AWS, including the application, data, integration, security, and operational components required to run them reliably.
- Select and evaluate appropriate AI approaches, which may include traditional ML, large language models, retrieval, model adaptation (fine tuning, continuous pre-training), tool use, or agentic workflows.
- Establish evaluation and responsible AI controls covering solution quality, safety, privacy, security, latency, reliability, and cost.
- Diagnose technical issues across models, applications, data, and infrastructure, and communicate trade-offs clearly to customer stakeholders.
- Work with customer and partner teams to integrate solutions into existing workflows and complete documentation, knowledge transfer, and operational handover.
- Use AI-assisted development practices, and contribute reusable assets and lessons to the Data & AI practice.

A day in the life
A typical day may include working with a customer team to turn an agreed use case into a detailed solution design and delivery backlog. You might review evaluation results from an AI application, investigate a quality, security, latency, or cost issue, and implement and test an improvement. We also value work-life harmony and strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. - Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
