title: Assistant·e RH, PXT (HR)
descriptionHtml:
L’une des nombreuses raisons pour lesquelles Amazon place la barre très haut en matière d’expérience client tient au fait que les RH veillent à ce que nous ayons la meilleure équipe derrière nous. Nous avons besoin d’une main-d’œuvre agile, afin d’avoir les bons talents en nombre suffisant pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients. En tant qu’ Associate Partner, PXT, vous aurez pour objectif de motiver nos collaborateurs·trices et de maintenir leur engagement en leur offrant une expérience enrichissante. En travaillant au sein d’une équipe, vous aurez l’occasion de partager des idées et d’apprendre des autres pour faire évoluer votre carrière.

Key job responsibilities
Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles et les responsables RH dans le déploiement de projets et d'initiatives stratégiques, en contribuant activement à l'engagement des collaborateurs et à l'amélioration continue de l'environnement de travail.

Assurer une gestion RH opérationnelle rigoureuse et réactive, en prenant en charge les processus d'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs, le suivi des temps de travail et des absences, ainsi que le traitement des demandes RH quotidiennes, tout en garantissant une expérience collaborateur de qualité.

Piloter et analyser les indicateurs de performance RH (KPIs) à travers les outils et tableaux de bord internes, identifier les tendances et les axes d'amélioration, et fournir des analyses pertinentes pour soutenir la prise de décision des équipes de management.

Déployer des initiatives favorisant l'engagement, le bien-être et l'expérience collaborateur, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles, afin de renforcer la satisfaction et la qualité de vie au travail.

Garantir la conformité et la fiabilité des processus RH, en réalisant des audits réguliers, en identifiant les écarts et en mettant en œuvre des actions correctives, dans le respect des procédures internes, de la législation du travail et des exigences de protection des données.

A day in the life
Vous n’occuperez pas une fonction de bureau conventionnelle, mais travaillerez sur site au contact de nos équipes d’entreposage. En fonction de votre lieu d’affectation, vous travaillerez peut-être en rotation avec vos collègues Associate Partners Cela signifie qu’un membre de l’équipe RH est toujours à proximité pour répondre aux interrogations du personnel.
Le rôle de l'Associate Partner est très varié. En plus de nous aider à maîtriser les principaux processus RH, vous épaulerez les responsables de votre équipe dans différents projets visant à impliquer le personnel. Il peut s’agir de recueillir les commentaires des employé·es et d’organiser des activités pour les faire adhérer à de nouveaux plans. Vous pourriez, par exemple, avoir à recueillir les commentaires des équipes impliquées, organiser des activités pour les faire adhérer à de nouveaux projets ou participer à la création d’un environnement inclusif dans lequel les employé·es se sentent à l’aise pour poser toutes leurs questions relatives aux ressources humaines.

About the team
Le service RH joue un rôle essentiel dans le fonctionnement de l’entreprise et la gestion des collaborateurs·trices. Baptisée « équipe PXT » (People Experience and Technology Solutions), elle veille avant tout à la mise en place d’un environnement de travail exceptionnel pour que l’innovation, la satisfaction client et l’agilité continuent de faire rayonner Amazon partout dans le monde.
Nous adoptons une approche holistique, proactive et intégrée de la gestion du personnel. Notre équipe a « l’obsession de la satisfaction client ». Elle s’attache à résoudre rapidement les problèmes d’implication et de motivation des employé·es, afin que rien n’affecte l’expérience globale des employé·es et des clients. En définitive, notre travail consiste à veiller à la conformité d’Amazon aux normes RH les plus strictes et à faire progresser la stratégie et les objectifs d’Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Connaissance de la suite MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) dans un environnement professionnel
- Une expérience dans la communication avec un large éventail de parties prenantes, y compris avec vos pairs et la direction
- Parfaite maîtrise du Français, à l’écrit et à l’oral, l'Anglais est préferable.
- Une expérience significative dans le domaine des ressources humaines, des relations avec les employé·es ou de la paie

Preferred qualifications

- Expérience dans le traitement des processus de nouvelles recrues et des tâches administratives
- Connaissances de base du droit du travail et des pratiques en matière de RH et de paie

title: Email Marketing Manager, AWS Marketing Integrated DC
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for an Email Marketing Manager to join our Events Email team. You'll own the end-to-end build and delivery of email campaigns for our global event programs from the moment a campaign is briefed through to building it in our marketing automation platform, quality-checking it, launching it and reporting on how it performed. If you're the kind of person who gets a kick out of a flawless send going out on time to the right audience, in the right language, with every link working, you'll fit right in. Come build the email campaigns behind some of the world's largest cloud technology events, reaching millions of customers across the globe.

This is a hands-on role for someone who's both the strongest Marketo practitioner in the room and a sharp marketer. You'll turn campaign plans into high-quality, localized, compliant emails that go out across multiple regions and time zones, partnering closely with campaign managers, content, localization, and platform teams. You'll also help raise the bar on how we build, test, and quality-check email at scale.

What you'll bring:

Deep hands-on expertise in a marketing automation platform (Marketo / Adobe Marketo Engage)
A sharp eye for detail and calm under tight launch deadlines
Strong understanding of email compliance (consent, suppression, regional tracking rules) and deliverability
Experience building and QA-ing localized email across multiple markets
Clear communication and the ability to juggle many campaigns and stakeholders at once

Key job responsibilities
Build, test, and launch email campaigns and automated journeys in our marketing automation platform including audience segmentation, dynamic content and reusable templates.
Own email quality before launch: run quality reviews and live send tests, and make sure every email renders correctly, all links are live, and the send meets our standards and compliance rules.
Manage the full lifecycle of each email, from intake through build, localization, review, deployment, and post-send reporting keeping sends on schedule across regional launch windows.
Apply consent, suppression, and regional tracking requirements, and protect sender reputation through list hygiene and bounce management.
Coordinate and quality-check multi-language versions of each email so specs and content standards hold in every market.
Build and improve reusable templates and modules that let the wider team create emails faster and with fewer errors.
Partner with campaign, content, and platform teams to translate requirements into technical build specs on short timelines.
Report on performance by send and audience and turn the results into recommendations that improve engagement.
Troubleshoot build, rendering, deliverability and data issues, and work with vendors and engineering on fixes.
Manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders at once while meeting agreed service levels and flagging risk early.

A day in the life
No two days look the same there's always an event on the horizon. You might start by reviewing how an overnight send performed in another region, then build the next campaign in the automation platform: audience, localized content, and logic. Midday, you'll quality-check a teammate's email before launch and give it the green light. In the afternoon, you'll turn a new brief into a build plan, coordinate translated versions, or troubleshoot a deliverability issue with the platform team. and you make sure they land at the highest quality

About the team
We're the Events Email team, and we run the email that powers AWS's biggest global events - Summits around the world, re:Invent, and more. Every invitation, reminder, and follow-up that helps millions of customers discover and register for these events comes through us. We're a tight, globally distributed group that cares deeply about quality: getting the right message to the right person, in the right language, on time, every time. We move fast, support each other across time zones, and take real pride in flawless launches. If you love email done well, you'll feel at home here.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
- Experience in audience segmentation and targeting
- Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
- Experience with at least one enterprise marketing automation platform (e.g., Adobe Marketo Engage, Oracle Eloqua, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud etc.)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in designing, building, and launching successful email engagement programs, specifically events programs
- Experience using at least one enterprise event technology platform (e.g., RainFocus, Cvent, or Jomablue)
- Adobe Marketo Engage Certified Expert or equivalent marketing automation certification

descriptionHtml:

title: Mfg Quality Engineer, Manufacturing Quality Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

The Leo Manufacturing Quality Engineering team is driven to deliver high-quality product lines while maintaining a fast production rate. This position will join the team at an exciting moment, with an opportunity to directly own the quality outputs of some of our critical sub-systems

As a Sr. Mfg Quality Engineer, you will have the opportunity to own product performance for some of the most critical sub-assemblies of the satellite, delivering creative solutions to reduce defects, and planning to prevent defects using your technical quality competencies.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Computer Vision and Robotics, Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Come shape the future of robotic sensing hardware by building the computer vision and ML systems that define how every robot in Amazon's global fulfillment network sees, senses, and understands the world. This is applied science embedded in a hardware development team where you directly shape what gets built, manufactured, and deployed at scale.

As a Senior Applied Scientist on the Amazon Robotics Sensing and Compute hardware team, you will be the ML and perception expert working alongside the Principal Applied Scientist and Principal Hardware Development Engineer to shape the future of deployed and scaled sensing hardware. You will influence sensor selection, compute architecture, optical design, and system level trade offs, ensuring the hardware we build is purpose designed for the algorithms that run on it. You will help define what the next generation of cameras, depth sensors, and edge compute modules need to be, and then prove it with data, experimentation, and production validation.

What makes this role unique:
-Embedded in the hardware development team, directly influencing what gets designed, manufactured, and shipped
-Partner with the Principal Engineers to co define the sensing and compute hardware roadmap for every major Amazon Robotics program
-Own the ML experimentation and validation that drives hardware architecture decisions for cameras, depth sensors, and edge compute
-Solve perception problems no other company is tackling: safety rated vision, multi modal sensor fusion, and real time inference on resource constrained hardware
-Ship to hundreds of fulfillment sites worldwide across autonomous mobile robots, manipulation workcells, barcode sensing, and safety rated human collaborative systems
-Your work does not sit in a research queue. It goes into production hardware that enables the future of Amazon Robotics


Key job responsibilities
-Partner with the Principal Hardware Development Engineer and Principal Applied Scientist to co define sensing and compute hardware requirements, ensuring ML and perception needs drive sensor selection, optical design, compute architecture, and system level trade offs
-Develop and optimize computer vision and deep learning models for robotic perception including object detection, depth estimation, scene understanding, and barcode recognition, purpose built for edge deployment on resource constrained hardware
-Lead ML experimentation and validation that directly informs hardware architecture decisions for cameras, depth sensors, and edge compute modules
-Design and execute benchmarking frameworks to evaluate sensing hardware performance across diverse robotic use cases, providing data driven recommendations on what to build next
-Optimize models for production edge deployment including quantization, pruning, distillation, and inference pipeline tuning to meet strict latency, power, and accuracy requirements
-Drive research and experimentation on next generation perception capabilities in collaboration with the Principal Applied Scientist, including multi modal sensor fusion, safety rated vision, and real time inference for autonomous and human collaborative robotics
-Collaborate cross functionally with hardware engineers, software developers, and robotics program teams to transition models from prototype through production validation and fleet deployment
-Contribute to the sensing and compute hardware roadmap alongside the Principal Applied Scientist, identifying where ML trends and emerging capabilities require new hardware architecture or sensor modalities
-Mentor engineers and scientists on ML best practices for embedded systems and production robotics
-Publish and present research to advance the state of the art in robotic perception

A day in the life
In this role you will work at the intersection of machine learning and physical robotics hardware. You will collaborate with hardware engineers to evaluate how your models perform on real sensors and edge compute, run experiments that directly influence what gets built next, and validate perception systems alongside robotics program teams. You will push the boundaries of computer vision for robotic applications while seeing your work deploy on real robots in real fulfillment centers. This is applied science with immediate, measurable impact at a scale no other robotics company can offer.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The Amazon Robotics Sensing and Compute team powers a customer centric ecosystem built for speed, quality, and innovation. We stay ahead of sensing and compute technology, standardize reusable and cost effective modules, and pair them with deep engineering expertise and a robust supply chain. Every customer gets the right solution, whether off the shelf, rapidly customized, or purpose built, easy to integrate and ready to scale. We are a small, fast moving team of builders who own the full stack from optics through edge compute and take pride in shipping production hardware that enables every major robotics program in Amazon's global fulfillment network. If you want your work to matter on day one, this is the team.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience with one or more deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent
- Experience with 2D and 3D vision tasks including object detection, segmentation, depth estimation, or point cloud processing
- Experience optimizing ML models for deployment on resource constrained hardware including quantization, pruning, or distillation techniques
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Preferred qualifications

- PhD, or PhD and 4+ years of deep learning, computer vision, human robotic interaction, algorithms implementation experience
- Experience with robotic perception systems in industrial, warehouse, or manufacturing environments
- -Experience with sensor fusion across multiple modalities (RGB, depth, lidar, time of flight)
- -Familiarity with edge compute hardware and embedded inference pipelines
- -Experience with real time computer vision systems operating under strict latency and power constraints
- -Track record of transitioning research prototypes to production systems deployed at scale
- -Experience with safety critical ML applications or functional safety requirements
- -Experience collaborating with hardware engineering teams on sensor selection, optical design, or compute architecture trade offs
- -Experience with image signal processing pipelines and camera system characterization
- -Experience mentoring scientists or engineers in applied research environments

title: Sr. Software Development Manager, EBS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is looking for both Leaders and Builders to help us define and build the future of computing. The AWS Elastic Block Store (EBS) service delivers high performance virtualized storage "in the cloud" for EC2. Durable storage is a key building block for any application and as a member of the EBS team you'll work alongside talented engineers and leaders to develop and operate one of the largest storage services in the world.

Be a part of the team that manages and owns the scale of EBS. We’re looking for a Sr. Software Development Manager to lead teams of innovative engineers that own the performance, availability, scalability, and durability of EBS volumes. EBS is a massive-scale distributed storage attached network and this team owns the provisioning, health, and host lifecycle automation technology for the storage nodes that power the EBS service. This is a highly leveraged area of the business, with significant contributions to EBS's cost structure, ultimately helping EBS customers run on the most cost effective block storage service.

Our team works together to provide work/life balance for all team members. We recognize that the circumstances of our team members vary, and we balance work across the team so that we’re all able to maintain high standards on behalf of our customers, while at the same time allowing for rich and happy personal lives.

Upon joining EBS, every employee is paired with a peer buddy who will help you to quickly come up to speed in understanding the technology we’re building, the tools we use and the business problems we’re trying to solve. We hire exceptional people and we recognize the importance of coaching others. We have a formal mentor search application that lets you find a mentor that works best for you based on location, job family, and job level. Your manager can also help you find a mentor or two, because two is better than one. On our internal “Broadcast” video streaming website, you’ll find countless presentations by some of the brightest minds in computing discussing solutions to many of the exciting problems we’re solving in AWS today with new live-streaming videos added every week.

We have a diverse team and drive towards an inclusive culture and work environment. Our team is intentional about attracting, developing, and retaining amazing talent from diverse backgrounds. Our team members are active in Amazon’s 10+ affinity groups, sometimes known as employee resource groups, which bring employees together across businesses and locations around the world. These range from groups such as the Black Employee Network (BEN), Amazon Women in Engineering (AWE) and Glamazon (our LGBTQ+ community).

Key job responsibilities
As a Sr. Software Development Manager, you are responsible for helping your teams bridge the gap between customers and technology to quickly design and deliver scalable and maintainable systems. You will also be responsible for the team’s product definition, technical architecture, driving iterative development, code review, and operations. Along with this, you’ll have the opportunity interact with customers to ensure their needs are met; clear, professional communication with technical customers is an important part of the job.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of engineering experience
- 5+ years of engineering team management experience
- 10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience partnering with product and program management teams
- Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications

title: Real-Time Embedded Firmware Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking an Embedded Firmware Engineer, Real-Time to develop deterministic real-time firmware for SST power-conversion control, PWM generation, diagnostics and protection-related functions.

As an Embedded Firmware Engineer, Real-Time you will develop bare-metal/FreeRTOS C/C++ firmware for PWM and conversion control on DSP/FPGA, delivered independently. You will adhere to ISR timing budgets, fault-detection latency and safe-state transitions coordinated with functional-safety requirements. You will debug real-time interaction between firmware, FPGA, control and power stages and supports HIL and system validation.


About AIS
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
Firmware development:
- Develop bare-metal and/or FreeRTOS firmware in C/C++.
- Implement real-time PWM and power-conversion control drivers on DSP/FPGA platforms.
- Implement deterministic interfaces to sensors, control algorithms and hardware protection.
Diagnostics & fault handling:
- Develop embedded diagnostics and monitoring functions.
- Implement fault detection and fault-state handling in coordination with functional-safety requirements.
- Support watchdog and system-health mechanisms where allocated to embedded software.
Integration & verification:
- Bring up firmware on prototype hardware.
- Debug real-time interactions between firmware, FPGA, control algorithms and power electronics.
- Support hardware-in-the-loop and system-level validation.
SST System Alignment:
- Implement deterministic state-machine, protection, overload, fault recovery and power-sharing functions required by the SST system behavior.
- Support fast response to LVDC disturbances and coordinated ESS behavior during MVAC ride-through events.

A day in the life
As an Embedded Firmware Engineer, Real-Time, you'll focus on developing robust firmware for power-conversion control systems using C/C++ on DSP and FPGA platforms. Your day might include writing and optimizing real-time PWM drivers, implementing fault-detection algorithms that meet strict timing requirements, or debugging complex interactions between firmware, hardware, and control systems. You'll collaborate with hardware engineers and control specialists to bring up new prototype systems, validate designs through hardware-in-the-loop testing, and ensure your code meets the deterministic timing budgets critical to system safety. You may also contribute to solving real-time challenges specific to power-sharing and system recovery during grid disturbances.

About the team
We are the team that keeps the cloud running. AWS Infrastructure Services designs, plans, delivers, and operates all AWS global infrastructure—the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that enable our customers to access the innovation they depend on. Our team tackles some of the most complex engineering challenges in the industry, and we're building solutions that scale across data centers worldwide. We're looking for collaborative engineers who are curious, committed to continuous learning, and excited about contributing to infrastructure that powers businesses globally. You'll work alongside experienced firmware developers, hardware engineers, and control systems specialists who are passionate about solving deterministic real-time challenges. Together, we're advancing how AWS manages power conversion and system reliability at scale.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to celebrate our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and diversity conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We have a career path for you no matter what stage you’re in when you start here. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related experience/ field.
- Experience with real-time firmware in power electronics or comparable high-performance systems.
- Experience and/or demonstrated understanding of PWM, DSP/FPGA interfaces and deterministic timing.
- Experience documenting design decisions, assumptions, trade-offs, risks and technical specifications.
- Experience using engineering analysis and measured evidence to drive decisions.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering.
- Experience in real-time embedded firmware (C/C++, RTOS/bare-metal) for power-electronics or safety-relevant control.
- Demonstrated understanding of PWM, DSP/FPGA interfaces and deterministic timing.

title: Senior Site EHS Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we prioritize health, safety, and well-being above all else. There is nothing more important. To support this priority, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Site Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for partnering with the site level operations team for your designated site in order to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and Kaizen events, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in Amazon’s processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our associates.

In this role, you must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the cross functional operations teams, and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. To do so, you must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will also be required to instruct and train operations leadership and site WHS professionals in company EHS policies while assisting the regional teams in incorporating our safety standards at their sites. Your experience working in safety programs and your relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge in an operations environment will be crucial. You will be responsible for developing a team of safety managers and safety professionals at your designated site. Your teams’ success will depend on your ability to create and execute leadership development plans for your larger team. You must demonstrate your ability to clearly communicate organizational direction through your team. As a senior leader in the WHS organization, you will also be responsible for judging and assessing safety talent to select appropriate bench strength for current and future business needs.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Act as SME of local/regional regulations and company WHS policy.
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon Safety Policies.
- Measure site performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
- Ensure safety record keeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives.
- Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
- Deep Dive safety metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
- Deep Dive trends and propose action plans to Sr. Leadership on site.
- Audit record keeping practices and Global Safety Database entries to ensure compliance to global safety standards and local regulations.
- Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
- Manage and mentor the Safety Managers and Safety Associates in your assigned site.
- Engage the Injury Prevention Specialists (IPS) and Site Leadership to drive long-term strategic actions to achieve incident reduction.
- Perform targeted Kaizen events in partnership with the Operations teams based on the risks identified in each task (force, repetition, and awkward postures).
- Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy.
- Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required safety training.
- Review for effectiveness the deployed safety tools and revise to ensure continual improvement.
- Partner with corporate and other regional field safety personnel to leverage global safety and environmental best practices into NA network standards.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 7+ years of increasing responsibilities in safety and/or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations, or relevant experience applicable to the role
- 7+ years of increasing responsibilities in people and performance management
- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment
- Willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends, as required to support direct reports and site needs

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s degree preferred
- Certified Safety Professional preferred
- Experience in a fast-paced, dynamic organization
- Interest in long-term career development through assignments in multiple business units across the nation
- Prior experience in a management development training program
- Track record of effectively managing a safety operation comprising both salaried and hourly staff
- Demonstrate experience in developing others into higher levels of responsibility in an organization
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort interfacing with Directors and VPs
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. title: Loss Prevention Specialist, WWOS
descriptionHtml:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for hands-on and detail-oriented professionals who want to join our team as Loss Prevention Specialists.

In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external parties (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards

A day in the life
As a Loss Prevention Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews.

Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, for which you contribute to the development of mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality.

You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters.

Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Sitting within the World Wide Security Operations organisation, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:


• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation

Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing reoccurrence.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in security and loss prevention
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with MS Office Professional Suite, including Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with physical security best practices which includes the application of physical security systems, investigation techniques and management of contract security guards
- Experience within a distribution center, logistics, or manufacturing environment
- Experience working with data and leveraging analytics to make decisions
- Valid driver's license

title: Technical Program Manager, Long Term Planning
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever ordered something on Amazon and wondered how it reached you so fast? The answer starts years earlier, with a plan. Long Term Planning decides which of our sites connect to which, how volume flows between them, and how much capacity we need — one to three years ahead of the customer placing the order.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to join that team in Madrid. You will own the mechanisms that turn dozens of separate inputs — demand forecasts, building plans, speed targets, cost targets, capacity constraints — into one coherent plan for Amazon's European network. It is a role for someone who is comfortable both in the data and in a room of senior stakeholders, and who would rather build a repeatable process than run the same manual exercise twice.

Key job responsibilities
Run the planning calendar for one or more planning cycles end to end: set the timeline, secure the inputs, chase the gaps, and keep 20+ partner teams aligned to it.
Own the input intake process. Define what "good" looks like for each input, build the validation checks, and hold partner teams to that standard.
Turn business questions into scenarios, run them through our planning tools, and explain what the numbers say and what we should do about it.
Build and automate the reporting layer — the views that let planners and leadership see plan versus prior plan, and understand what changed and why.
Write concise, data-backed status updates and review documents for senior leadership. Drive open decisions to closure and track them.
Find the parts of the planning process that are manual, slow or error-prone, and work with engineers, scientists and analysts to fix them at the root.


A day in the life
You start by checking whether this week's inputs have landed and passed validation. Mid-morning you are in a partner-team review, unblocking a missing assumption. The afternoon you spend in the data, quantifying what that assumption does to speed, cost and capacity, and writing up the answer for a decision meeting later in the week.

About the team
Long Term Planning designs Amazon's European transportation network one to three years out, optimising for delivery speed, cost to serve and customer experience. Our plans are the basis for building, capacity and investment decisions across the region, so we sit at the centre of a wide set of partners — Operations, Finance, Science, Product, Engineering and Retail. The team is a mix of program managers, business intelligence engineers, scientists and analysts, and we are deliberately transversal: we work on the problems that cross organisational boundaries, because those are the ones nobody else can own.

- Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

title: Customer Support, Veeqo

descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building automation solutions that transform financial operations at scale? Join Transportation Financial Services (TFS) at Amazon, where you'll develop critical systems that power financial reporting and migrations across our global transportation network. In this role, you'll tackle complex challenges in financial data processing, creating automated solutions that enable accurate book closures and seamless migrations.

As a SysDE on the TFS team, you'll work on high-impact projects that directly improve how Amazon manages transportation finances. title: CONTROLS Technician, North Asia, APAC Controls Deployment & Service
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems which monitor and ensure the health of our data centers. APAC CDS’ mission is to safely provide our customers with the unmatched reliability, security, and performance that AWS is known for. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines of deployments (of control systems in new data centers), projects (of controls capital improvement works at live data center sites), and service (of control systems at live data center sites), with additional specializations in the disciplines of colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, on-call support (of data center control systems in the Americas (AMER), Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), as part of a global “follow-the-sun” support arrangement), and governance.

As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.

To be successful in this team, you will also have:
- Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
- Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
- Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed
Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Technicians support data center building automation systems, including Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). In this role, you will deploy and service these critical systems to ensure optimal data center health and performance.

Your responsibilities include deploying new BMS or EPMS installations during data center construction, upgrading existing Amazon-owned or leased facilities, and implementing Amazon hardware in colocated environments. You'll also provide regional servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally support global operations.

Success in this position requires effective collaboration with multiple Amazon teams, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams. You'll maintain strong vendor relationships that drive successful deployments and operations.


Key job responsibilities
- Deploy and maintain critical systems: Install, upgrade, and troubleshoot BMS and EPMS systems across multiple data centers, ensuring optimal performance through diagnostics, programming, and hardware maintenance.
- Execute technical projects: Manage installations from server provisioning to sensor calibration, supervise contractor work, and ensure all activities meet AWS safety and quality standards.
- Drive operational excellence: Provide commissioning support, conduct root cause analysis, create system documentation, and follow change management processes to maintain system integrity.
- Enable team success: Mentor facilities teams on system operations, collaborate with vendors on Factory Witnessed Tests, and recommend design improvements based on operational insights.
- Deliver reliable service: Respond to emergencies, manage on-call rotations, oversee service agreements, and prioritize work through ticketing systems to maintain data center availability.

A day in the life
- Join the cloud leader: AWS has the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip—especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom-designed processors and chips.
- Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
- Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.
- Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.
- Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career.


About the team
About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Call Center Quality Assurance Specialist (Onsite - Tempe, AZ), Amazon One Medical Customer Care
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon One Medical, we're committed to delivering exceptional, patient-centered care. We're looking for motivated people to help us raise the bar in healthcare. If you're passionate about improving the patient experience, this is a chance to make a real impact.

As we grow and innovate in primary care, we're hiring a Quality Assurance Specialist for our Customer Care Center. You'll report to the Quality Assurance Manager and help us keep our promise of high-quality, accessible, and affordable care. You'll do this by auditing member interactions and helping make every one of them excellent.

In this role, you'll use established evaluation templates and the C-I-CARE communication framework to give clear, constructive feedback that drives continuous improvement and service excellence.

The ideal candidate has a strong customer service background and cares about quality in every interaction. You're self-aware, open to feedback, and committed to learning. You give direct, actionable feedback with confidence, build trust, follow through on commitments, and work with others toward shared goals. If this sounds like you, we'd love to connect!

This is a full-time, hourly, in-person position at the Amazon One Medical Customer Care Center in Tempe, AZ.


Key job responsibilities
Review, score, and document patient calls and interactions against established operational and quality standards, using the C-I-CARE communication framework.

Give timely, constructive, actionable feedback to care team members to promote an excellent patient and member experience.

Partner with care team leads and supervisors to address quality concerns, and share recurring issues and best practices in team huddles and other meetings as needed.

Analyze evaluation data to find performance trends, and recommend solutions that improve overall service quality.

Take part in calibration sessions, and help develop and refine quality scoring tools so evaluations stay consistent and accurate.

Stay current on policy, workflow, and compliance changes, and apply them to evaluations.

As business needs dictate, perform patient care functions usually handled by Healthcare Associates. This includes answering inbound calls, documenting routing, and completing other assigned tasks.

A day in the life
Your days will be varied and purpose-driven. You'll review patient interactions and evaluate them against our quality standards and the C-I-CARE framework. You'll write clear feedback that helps care team members improve. You'll also join calibration sessions so scoring stays consistent across the QA team. You'll work closely with care team leads to spot trends, raise recurring issues, and celebrate great work. When business needs call for it, you'll step in to support patients directly. Every evaluation you complete helps create seamless, compassionate healthcare experiences.

About the team
We're a team of professionals who want to change how healthcare is delivered. We believe in continuous learning, supporting each other, and a shared commitment to excellence. We work together to find ways to improve, celebrate our wins, and build a place where every team member can grow and make a difference for patients.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ year of experience in a quality assurance role in a customer service, contact center, or healthcare setting, OR 1+ year of back-end administrative experience in a patient-centered role at a multi-state primary care organization
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to give clear, precise feedback
- Experience supporting process improvement efforts and adapting to changes in policy and compliance
- Able to work varying shifts based on business needs, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to support 24/7 operations

Preferred qualifications

- Healthcare background that supports effective patient-centered work
- Experience with quality monitoring and telephony tools such as NICE (CXone)
- Proficiency with Google Workspace (G Suite) and Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems

title: NW Deployment Planner II, GND - Planning, Implementation, Coordination (PIC) Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

The Global Network Delivery organization is looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Network Deployment Planner to join our growing Planning and Implementation team within AWS Data Center Delivery. The team responsibilities involve scoping and planning interdependent capacity scaling projects and new network capacity deployments across several data center locations. They will review project forecasts and assure physical infrastructure resources are available for their execution.

The Network Deployment Planner will work closely with infrastructure supply chain & procurement, network engineering and technical program managers to plan and deliver customer capacity to the local data center installation & deployment technicians to facilitate smooth capacity execution.

The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate you must be highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and have experience in managing network deployment projects. They will be competent in networking principles, data center operations, cable infrastructure and fiber solutions.

This position will provide the individual with high levels of autonomous work with minimal supervision to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, ambiguous, collaborative environment is essential for success.



Key job responsibilities
* Ensure adherence to timelines.
* Deliver sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes always with an eye on improvement.
* Work closely with our Install/Deployment Technicians, Supply Chain & Procurement, Network Engineers and Technical Project Manager teams to ensure fast, smooth delivery of on-demand customer capacity.
* Knowledge of network cabling and optic types.
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies.
* Familiarity with common networking terms.
* Excellent judgement and analytical skills, ability to prioritize tasks based on fluctuating needs. - Strong prioritization and time management ability.
* Coordination of design, project timeline/schedule and construction milestones.
* Experience in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management. Must be well organized and able to work effectively under time pressure.

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of project management experience
- 1+ years of relevant discipline work experience
- Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center, critical environment, computer hardware repair, infrastructure cabling, network deployment, or data center operations experience
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
- Experience working with customers to diagnose a problem and work towards resolution
- Experience working under pressure in a cross-functional organization

title: Economist, Entertainment Economics
descriptionHtml:
The charter of the Entertainment Economics team includes working on high-impact projects that require economics expertise and a cross-business perspective. Our team supports Amazon’s diverse entertainment businesses – especially Prime Video, Amazon Music, Amazon MGM Studios, and Gaming (Luna) – through complex causal measurements (observational and experimental) and structural modeling. Some of our team’s areas of science expertise include marketing science, long-term value measurement, and experimentation. As a central economics team not embedded in any particular business, we strive to provide objective analyses that take a customer-obsessed, pan-Amazon perspective.

This role partners with the Prime Science team to evaluate and improve the way Amazon allocates Prime subscription revenue across its benefit teams, including entertainment businesses. Prime is Amazon's premiere membership program, with over 200mm members world-wide, bringing in billions in Prime subscription revenue annually. Prime is at the center of many major company decisions that impact Amazon's customers. These decisions span a variety of industries, each reflecting the diversity of Prime benefits: fast and free shipping, entertainment & digital content, reading, healthcare, and grocery. Each of these Prime benefits is supported by a different organization, and each relies on Prime subscription revenue to make critical investment decisions. Our team partners with Prime Science to ensure that these allocations are credible, actionable, and incentive compatible for every benefit.

To support this work, this role will create science models, validate them, and productionize them. In addition to stellar economics expertise, this role requires systems thinking (anticipating how complex interconnected models will respond to changes in data or modeling), strategic thinking (supporting decisions that affect 200 million+ customers and set Amazon’s direction for years to come), and scientifically novel thinking (using AI and the latest science advancements to achieve move).

The ideal candidate is expert in causal inference with experience working in large, complex structural modeling environments. They are a creative problem-solver, able to identify new approaches that solve multiple problems at once while minimizing churn. They think big, not limiting themselves to what’s been done before, while tactfully accounting for the costs of major changes. They can add structure to incredibly ambiguous business contexts, making defensible assumptions and delivering measurements that drive impactful business decisions. They have effective communication and the skill to translate data-driven findings into actionable insights for senior leaders. Finally, they are empathetic and constructive. Our healthy team culture is supportive and fast-paced, and we prioritize learning, growth, and helping each other to continuously raise the bar.

Impact and Career Growth
In today’s entertainment landscape, critical decisions are made with data and economic models. You’ll help leaders ask the right questions, and then deliver data-driven answers, helping to create the future of Amazon. You’ll help define a long-term science vision in this space and translate it into an actionable roadmap. This role combines science leadership, organizational ability, technical strength, product focus, and business understanding – a perfect recipe for career growth as an economist in tech.


Key job responsibilities
• Design and build econometric models, especially causal models, to measure the value of the business and its many features
• Develop science products from concept to prototype to production, incorporating feedback from scientists and business partners
• Independently identify and pursue new opportunities to leverage economic insights across entertainment and Prime
• Write business and technical documents communicating business context, methods, and results to business leadership and other scientists
• Serve as a technical reviewer for our team and related teams, including document and code reviews

Basic qualifications

- PhD in economics or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of industry, consulting, government, or academic research experience
- Experience with handling of large datasets
- Experience in reduced form causal analysis, modeling, and experimental design

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Ads-Full-Funnel Agentic Intell
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Advertising is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive delivery of Ads Agent internal, the AI agent that helps Amazon Ads support, sales, and operations teams resolve advertiser issues faster and with higher quality. You will own the program that takes the agent from pilot to scale. That means coordinating the many science, engineering, and partner teams that build its skills, tools, and evaluations, and making sure each release measurably improves resolution quality and adoption. Your program will directly affect S-Team goals for customer experience and support efficiency.

Key job responsibilities
-Own end to end program delivery for Ads Agent internal, from planning through launch and ramp. This includes phased rollouts across support teams and moving from closed to open beta.

-Write clearly for senior audiences, including program updates, risk reviews, and narrative documents such as OP1 inputs and PRFAQs.

title: Logistics Specialist, AWS DC Operations
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to be part of something from the ground up? We are preparing to launch a new data center and need a Materials Specialist to ensure our inventory and logistics operations are running smoothly from day one. In this role, you will manage the flow of critical hardware components that keep our infrastructure operational — receiving shipments, maintaining stock levels, and getting the right parts to the right technicians at the right time. This is a hands-on position where your organizational skills and attention to detail directly impact how quickly we can build and maintain our data center environment.

Key job responsibilities
Manage inventory levels for critical spare parts and materials, conducting cycle counts, maintaining min/max thresholds, and ensuring accurate records of all inbound and outbound commodities.
Receive and process shipments by verifying contents against purchase orders, logging items into inventory systems, and coordinating with vendors on returns of defective hardware.
Stage and distribute parts to Data Center Technicians and Engineers responding to build and break/fix operations, ensuring parts availability meets operational targets.
Coordinate material flow for bulk deliveries including cabinets, power infrastructure, and networking equipment while maintaining organized and safe storage areas.
Identify and implement process improvements to increase efficiency in logistics workflows, collaborating with peers and escalating risks or roadblocks as needed.

A day in the life
Your day starts at the loading dock, where you process inbound shipments and verify them against purchase orders before logging everything into our inventory system. From there, you move to the parts room where you organizing storage bins, staging spares for technicians working active tickets, and running cycle counts to keep stock levels accurate. You might coordinate a bulk delivery of server cabinets in the yard, then pivot to packaging an RMA return for a defective component. Throughout the day, you collaborate with technicians and engineers, troubleshoot supply gaps, and look for ways to make the operation run more efficiently.

About the team
Our team supports the launch and ongoing operation of Amazon's data center infrastructure. As we bring a new site online, every team member plays a visible role in getting us to operational readiness. You will work alongside technicians, engineers, and operations managers in a collaborative environment where your contributions are felt immediately. Growth here is supported through regular coaching, monthly one-on-ones focused on removing barriers, and active involvement in process improvement initiatives giving you the skills and experience to take on broader responsibilities as our data center community expands.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of shipping & receiving, inventory and warehousing practices experience
- High school diploma or equivalent
- 1+ years of logistics or other relevant experience

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of computer hardware components and operating systems
- Familiar with waybills and shipping procedures with transport companies
- Experience in Warehouse Management Software / Inventory Management Software proficiency
- Ability to manage work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager
- Proficient with computers and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)

title: Area Manager, INFC
descriptionHtml:
Manager, Quick Commerce Hub (Inbound & Outbound Operations)
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

Amazon is seeking a Manager for our Quick Commerce Hub (HU) to lead both the Inbound (IB) and Outbound (OB) functions. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers. In the fast-paced world of Quick Commerce, speed, accuracy, and reliability are everything — and this role sits at the heart of making that happen.

Four key areas that you'll always focus on are the safety, quality, customer experience, and productivity of your department.

Review the work forecasts and determine your productivity requirements to produce during the day/night to meet the overall building objectives.
Partner with other Area Managers to balance labor, ensuring that you are operating a balanced and efficient shift across both inbound and outbound while meeting all of your goals.
Support all safety programs and OSHA compliance to ensure a safe work environment for all associates.
Proactively identify and lead process improvement initiatives and Lean tools.
Own end-to-end Inbound and Outbound flow — from receive, stow, and inventory accuracy through pick, pack, and dispatch — to meet Quick Commerce delivery promises.
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
You and your team of warehouse associates are responsible for getting Amazon customers their orders. You are responsible for ensuring that you have properly trained people, and that their needs are addressed so they can focus on their jobs. This role involves directly leading a team of more than 500 associates across inbound and outbound operations.

In addition, one of the most important aspects of your job is to lead change at internet speed — innovation has made us the global company that we are today.

ADDITIONAL JOB ELEMENTS
Regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head
Walking in the facility and around the area with great frequency; facilities are over a quarter mile in length
Continual standing and/or walking
Ability to work in distribution environments that may be noisy, not air-conditioned
Able to access all areas of the building (ascending and descending ladders, stairs, gangways safely and without limitation)
BASIC / PRIORITY REQUIREMENTS
Experience managing both Inbound and Outbound operations — this is a priority requirement for the role
Night shift availability — candidates must be available to work night shifts regularly
Large-team leadership — proven experience directly managing a team of 500+ associates
Direct management experience for employees and their performance
Experience with performance metrics and process improvement (how, when, who)
Candidates must be flexible to work weekends and/or overnight shifts regularly

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

descriptionHtml:
Since 2006, Amazon Web Services has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud. AWS has been continually expanding its services to support virtually any workload, and it now has more than 240 fully featured services for compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), mobile, security, hybrid, media, and application development, deployment, and management from 105 Availability Zones within 33 geographic regions, with announced plans for 18 more Availability Zones and 6 more AWS Regions in Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Thailand. Millions of customers—including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—trust AWS to power their infrastructure, become more agile, and lower costs.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced Business Development professional who is eager to promote the strategic growth and to shape the future of a world which leverages cloud computing.

You will engage with enterprise clients' CXO/VP level strategically as well as closely collaborate with software developers, IT infrastructure, software designers, architects, data scientists, product development for AWS Cloud and AI/ML adoption. You must also be a self-starter and strategic thinker who is able to initiate and scale up business development and accelerate business progress by enabling the diverse strategic engagements with different key stakeholders in enterprises with a strong execution capability and fear-free to think out of box to find the innovative approach for helping our customers to handle the business and technical challenges.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and develop hi-tech territory of strategic named accounts - containing a mix of existing enterprise customers and net new prospects
- Develop and execute against a comprehensive territory plan to speed up business development and deepen the strategic cooperation foundation with enterprise customers
- Influence (or impact) customer adoption, through consultative selling, thought leadership, executive relationship development and sell-in of professional services from customer’s perspective
- Work with AWS partners to extend reach & drive adoption
- Maintain and deliver results against a set of defined revenue and non-revenue targets by obsessing our customers to support them for reaching the success

In a short, you are not only focusing on Business Development to achieve the defined business KPIs but also acting as a Customer Ambassador to assure their success by adopting the right AWS solutions to solve their business and technical pain-points and to drive their business competitiveness.

A day in the life
AWS is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace to deliver the best results for our customers. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status; we celebrate the diverse ways we work. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please let us know and we will connect you to our accommodation team.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- 10+ years of full sales cycle, technology sales or equivalent business development, sales engineering/consulting or equivalent experience
