title: Front End Engineer, Amazon Quick
descriptionHtml:
Our team — Quick Core Experience — owns the platform layer behind Amazon Quick, an agentic, AI-powered digital workspace. We deliver the critical infrastructure every feature depends on: asset metadata services (indexing, search, list, favorites), real-time customization, the core design system, and enterprise governance adherence across web, mobile, and desktop experiences in Quick.

Quick is where generative AI meets the enterprise workplace. Chat, custom agents, research, BI, workflow automation — all unified, fast, discoverable, and governed at scale. The platform we build is what makes that possible.

We're looking for a Front End engineer energized by hard problems on both sides of the stack. You design and operate large-scale distributed systems, and you love crafting scalable front-end experiences. You'll own real problems: high-throughput indexing pipelines that unify writes across dozens of producer teams, real-time customization services scaling across regions and tenants, and the search and discovery experiences that make the platform feel effortless.

You bring a strong sense of ownership, a high bar for code quality, and genuine passion for design and architecture. You don't just know how to solve problems — you build solutions to address them. You challenge yourself and others to constantly find better solutions. You partner with product managers, UX designers, and fellow engineers to turn ambiguous customer needs into shipped, polished features.

This role offers wide scope, real ownership, and the chance to shape Enterprise governance layers we add in Quick, that every team in the product depends on.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will be passionate about solving complex and broad business problems of cloud marketplaces with simple and straightforward solutions, applying appropriate technologies and software engineering best practices, building solutions that scale and perform well. They will own the design and implementation of major deliverables end-to-end. This position requires passion towards Agentic development, and/or curiosity towards leveraging AI tools in AI-SDLC, and collaboration with other engineers on the team, principal engineers, product managers, and partner teams. You should be comfortable dealing with ambiguity and should have a desire to create, iterate and improve.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional front end, web or mobile software development using JavaScript, HTML and CSS experience
- Experience developing with MVC/MVM frameworks (e.g. React.JS, AngularJS, Vue)
- 2+ years of front-end developer creating prototypes or wire-frames for enterprise web applications or workflows experience

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of agile software development methodology experience
- Experience with common front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JS, TypeScript, and Node

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Transform
descriptionHtml:
With roughly seven out of eight enterprise workloads still running on-premises or on mainframe, the opportunity to help the world's largest organizations move to the cloud is enormous. AWS Transform is building a platform that combines AI-driven automation with deep infrastructure and software engineering to analyze, plan, and execute large-scale application migrations. As a Senior Software Development Engineer on this team, you will work across the full stack, from designing the distributed systems and services that power migration workflows to building the intelligent agents that reason about complex legacy environments.

You will own the end-to-end technical direction of major features, from working backwards from customer needs through system design, implementation, testing, and production operations. Your work will directly shape how enterprises transition their most critical workloads to AWS, and you will collaborate closely with go-to-market teams, professional services, and partner organizations to ensure the solutions you build translate into real customer outcomes. If you are excited about solving ambiguous, high-impact problems that demand both strong systems engineering and applied AI skills, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate distributed services and AI-powered agents that analyze legacy codebases, plan migration strategies, and execute transformations end to end.
- Own your team's architectural direction, making trade-offs across scalability, performance, and security while driving alignment with dependent teams on shared interfaces and infrastructure.
- Write well-documented, production-quality code and lead design and code reviews that raise the engineering bar across the team, ensuring solutions are testable and easy for others to extend.
- Collaborate with go-to-market teams, professional services, and cross-functional engineering groups to translate customer requirements into product features and deliver them incrementally.
- Coach and mentor engineers on the team, share technical knowledge broadly, and contribute to recruiting efforts that strengthen the organization.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a design review for a new service component that automates a migration step previously done by hand. After aligning on the approach with a colleague, you shift to writing and reviewing code, working on infrastructure plumbing one hour and refining an agent's decision logic the next. In the afternoon you join a sync with a go-to-market partner to discuss feedback from an enterprise customer pilot, then wrap up by updating operational dashboards and tuning alerts for a service your team recently launched.

About the team
AWS Transform sits within the Agentic AI organization at Amazon Web Services and is focused on building the next generation of autonomous migration services. The team partners closely with go-to-market, professional services, and enterprise customers to turn complex modernization challenges into repeatable, well-engineered solutions that blend systems infrastructure with applied AI.

We are at an early and exciting stage of product development, which means your contributions will directly shape the platform's architecture and roadmap. We value curiosity, collaboration, and a willingness to experiment, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member can do their best work.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: MBA Pathways Mexico Intern 2027
descriptionHtml:
Pathways are provided with challenging opportunities, intentional mentorship, and enhanced learning, all designed to fast track you into senior leadership. Amazon is looking for candidates who are builders, operators and strong analytical thinkers. Pathways are given the autonomy to think big, innovate, experiment, implement change, and solve on behalf of our customers. The Pathways Program, in our Customer Fulfilment, Supply Chain and Transportation network, is based on a series of crucible learning experiences, stretching your leadership and analytical capability to its full potential. As a Pathways, you will understand the business from the front line onward by leading large teams and learning about our worldwide operations ecosystem. You’ll accelerate into strategic positions, own your space, and solve complex problems with network wide impact. title: Senior Executive Content Marketing Manager, Executive Programs Content
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads helps advertisers build their business and brand through digital and streaming TV media, ad formats, and audience and measurement capabilities that connect brands with customers wherever they spend their time. Within Amazon Ads, our creative and content team is looking for a Senior Executive Content Marketing Manager to shape the narratives that our most senior leaders deliver in both invite-only settings and on the industry's biggest stages.

This is a highly visible role with a seat close to leadership. You'll partner with executives across Amazon Ads around the globe, turn complex product and business strategy into clear narratives, and set the standard for how our most important moments sound and feel. You'll also help define how a world-class content team puts AI to work — using it as a force multiplier across the content lifecycle to speed up output and raise quality at every stage you touch. The role spans two complementary domains: external executive content for select regional and global customer events, and end-to-end content leadership for large-scale internal sales meetings. If you're energized by range — and by work that reaches both customers and thousands of Amazonians — this is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Create presentation materials — slides, scripts, messaging documents, and customer stories — for Amazon Ads senior leadership at small-group executive gatherings and global customer events, and author messaging frameworks that define how each leader shows up externally.
- Partner with events and content teams to shape event strategy and general-session flow, aligning the right mix of speakers to business priorities and brand messaging.
- Lead content and program management for large-scale internal sales meetings — general-session and breakout strategy, speaker selection and preparation, experiential direction, and agency management.
- Use AI tools and workflows to accelerate brief creation, script development, and asset production at scale, and recommend practices that help the wider team adopt AI-augmented approaches.
- Manage multiple high-stakes content projects simultaneously, driving deliverables to deadline and maintaining quality across stakeholder groups — including product marketing, PR, growth, sales, and external agencies — with clear project communications.

A day in the life
On any given morning you might be refining a keynote script with a VP, then shifting to a working session to lock the general-session arc for an upcoming sales meeting. After lunch you could be reviewing AI-generated first drafts of breakout-session briefs, sharpening them before they go to speakers. Later, you'll join a sync with product marketing and PR to align messaging for an executive appearance at a global customer event. Throughout it all, you're the connective thread — making sure every story we tell is on-brand and lands with its audience. It's a marriage of storytelling and program management that runs on keeping the details in sight.

About the team
We are a small, specialized team of four within the creative and content organization at Amazon Ads. We work exclusively with executives, which gives us unique insight into products, organizational goals, and leadership vision. A core part of our work is authoring the messaging frameworks that define how each leader shows up externally. Our closest partners span events, product marketing, PR, growth, and sales. The team's scope is expanding, and this is a great time to join and help shape what comes next.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions
- Experience managing creative (internal team of designers, copywriters, external agencies and freelancers)
- Experience presenting creative concepts effectively to senior executives
- Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines

title: Sr. Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Description
Help shape the future of fulfillment alongside passionate, talented people who are obsessed with delivering for customers. As a Senior Operations Manager at our HOU2 building in Houston, TX, you'll be at the helm of a high-performing robotics fulfillment center that delivers for millions of Amazon customers every day. This is your opportunity to lead, innovate, and make a measurable impact on one of the world's most customer-obsessed supply chains. Be part of something extraordinary from day one.

What You'll Do
Own the operation – Take full accountability for budgetary performance, people development, and operational excellence across your functional area (Inbound or Outbound).
Lead and develop leaders – Manage, coach, and mentor a team of Operations and Area Managers, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable while building the next generation of Amazon leaders.
Drive continuous improvement – Champion Lean initiatives, process innovations, and quality programs that push your team and the FC to exceed business goals.
Deliver a world-class customer experience – Ensure safety, quality, and performance standards are met or exceeded every single day.
Collaborate cross-functionally – Partner with HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety, IT, and peer leaders to secure resources, share best practices, and drive site-wide success.
Cultivate ideas – Source and nurture innovative ideas from your team, translating them into actionable improvement plans that raise the bar across the network.
Share best practices – Take proactive steps to ensure best practices are shared across all departments, shifts, and the broader network.

Additional Job Elements to this Hands-On Leadership Role
Lift and move totes up to 49 pounds each
Regular bending, lifting, stretching and reaching both below the waist and above the head
Walking in the FC and around area with great frequency; facilities are over a quarter mile in length
Continual standing and/or walking an average of 5 miles daily
Ability to work in construction / distribution environments that may be noisy, unlit, unheated, not air-conditioned
Able to access all areas of building (ascending and descending ladders, stairs, gangways safely and without limitation)

Fun Facts About This Location
HOU2 is an 855,000-square-foot Amazon Robotics (AR) Sortable Fulfillment Center, roughly the size of 14 football fields, processing hundreds of thousands of packages per day
Located at 10550 Ella Blvd in Houston, TX, near George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH), making it a strategic logistics hub
HOU2 launched in 2017 as a GEN 9 ARS Sortable building with AFE 3.0 & 2.0 technology, and has grown into one of the top-performing sites in the AR network across Safety, People, Quality, and Productivity
The site achieved Platinum Ship Dock status a recognition of operational excellence, and lives by its motto: "Working Hard, Having Fun and Making History"
HOU2 offers public fulfillment center tours where visitors can see Amazon Robotics in action, with associates working alongside robots to pick, pack, and ship items
Houston is the 4th largest city in the United States and one of the most ethnically diverse metros in the country, with over 145 languages spoken reflected in its incredible food scene featuring world-class Tex-Mex, Vietnamese, barbecue, and international cuisine
Home to NASA's Johnson Space Center, the Texas Medical Center (the largest medical complex in the world), and a world-renowned Museum District with 19 museums, many offering free admission
Major professional sports teams call Houston home: the Texans (NFL), Astros (MLB), Rockets (NBA), Dynamo (MLS), and Dash (NWSL)
Year-round warm weather with proximity to Galveston Island beaches (about an hour away), Buffalo Bayou Park for kayaking and biking, and Hermann Park featuring the Houston Zoo with 6,000+ animals across 50 acres

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Work flexible hours as business demands, including overnight, weekends and holidays
- 7+ years direct management experience, including a salaried workforce, in a manufacturing, production or distribution environment
- Prior experience with performance metrics, process improvement and Lean techniques
- Prior experience with the full staffing lifecycle, including interviewing, hiring, performance management, promotions and termination

Preferred qualifications

- Ability to handle changing priorities and use good judgment in stressful situations
- Interest in long-term career development through assignments in multiple FCs across the nation
- Experience with a contingent workforce during peak seasons
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations or related field. MBA preferred

title: サイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャン
descriptionHtml:
このポジションの勤務地は、東京都板橋区のデリバリーステーションです。

Amazonの配送拠点には、世界最先端の自動化物流設備が導入されています。

RME（Reliability and Maintenance Engineering）部門は、日々物流設備の保全と保守、改善を行い、お客様に満足いただけるように努めております。 今回、RME部門が募集する職種はDSに導入されている物流設備の保全と保守、および設備の安全性や生産性を向上させるための改善を担当いただく「サイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャン」というポジションになります。

本ポジションは物流設備の保全経験者だけでなく、異業界・異職種からのキャリアチェンジをお考えの方も広く募集しています。これまでのエンジニアとしての経験を活かしながら、次のステージへと成長できる環境をご用意しております。入社後は体系的な教育プログラムに加え、豊富な経験を持つ先輩社員によるさぽーとにより、確かな技術力と自信を着実に身につけていただけます。

RMEにて技術力と現場感を身に着けることで将来的なキャリア選択肢は大きく広がります。マネジメント職や技術スペシャリストへのキャリアアップはもちろん、社内公募制度を通じて設備導入、設計、開発など、幅広いフィールドでの活躍も可能です。

【More Information】
■メンテナンス部門について
　・メンテナンスエンジニア特設サイト
　・社員インタビュー/堺FC勤務の社員T.S.さん
　・社員インタビュー/堺FC勤務の社員E.M.さん
■勤務地について
　・デリバリーステーション (DS)
　・勤務地：関東エリアDS

Amazon は多様かつインクルーシブな職場づくりを目指しています。Amazonは男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、 出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。障がいをお持ちの方は、以下をご覧ください。https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp
オペレーション部門のDEIの取り組み

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容】
下記業務をチームで対応いただきます。
■60%：日常点検・異常対応…稼働監視/巡回による設備点検/異常対応、故障復旧/オーバーホール、部品修繕
■20%：メンテナンス業務…予防保全/定期保全/状態保全/事後保全
■10%：安全対策…設備・作業環境の安全対策/5S活動
■5%：カイゼン活動…機械、電気、制御（PLC）と広い範囲でカイゼンや改造を実施
■5%：その他…メンテナンス計画/デザインレビュー
　
【取り扱う設備の一例（サイトによって異なります）】
■マテハン設備（一般的な搬送ローラーコンベア）
■オートソーター設備（商品を搬送しながら自動で仕分けし搬出するコンベア）
■オートラベラー設備（搬送されている商品を自動でスキャンしラベルを貼り付けする設備）

A day in the life
入社後、まずは物流設備の保全・保守を担当いただきます。未経験の作業に関しては、教育システムに則って学んでいただけます。その後、改善や安全対策、効率化施策を手掛けることで今までのキャリアの中で培ってきたスキルを応用し、幅広い領域で活かしていただくことができます。

※公共交通機関が運行しない時間帯でも交代勤務に出社できるようお願いいたします。(通勤時のタクシー、バイクの利用不可。自動車、自転車の利用可。)

※本ポジションはシフト勤務になり「3交代・早番専属・夜勤専属」のシフトパターンがあります。
シフトパターンは希望を考慮の上、決定させていただきますが、将来的なシフト勤務形態の変更の可能性もございます。
シフト構成は月末までに翌月2ヶ月分のシフトを決定しており、希望休も考慮いたします。

＜シフト例＞
※シフトは拠点によって異なります。
・3交代 　　 7:00-16:00, 14:00-23:00, 22:30-7:30

Basic qualifications

- 機械や電気機器の保全や保守、または生産技術・設備導入や立ち上げを1年以上ご経験された方
- PCを使用した作業のご経験のある方。（エクセル、ワード、Outlook）
- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（メールの読み書き、報告、連絡、相談ができる）

Preferred qualifications

- 物流設備の保守保全、もしくはフィールドエンジニアの経験
- 機械部品の取扱経験・知識（モーター・エアシリンダー・動力伝達機構・バルブなど）
- 電気部品の取扱経験・知識（インバーター・光学センサー・BCR・温度センサーなど）
- 制御機器の取扱経験・知識（PLC・サーボアンプ・タッチパネル・調節計など）
- 機械工学、もしくは電気工学の基礎知識 （工業高校または専門学校卒業程度）

title: Data Engineer I, SPIV Data Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Selling Partner Identity Verification is working to identify and prevent fraudulent behavior through all stages of a seller's lifecycle. We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to join our team and help us build and manage the Data for the business domains within the Selling Partner Identity Verification space. As a Data Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our data infrastructure and pipelines. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and efficient data solutions that drive business value.

Key job responsibilities
You will design and develop scalable, high-performance data systems using medallion architecture.

You are expected to collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and implement appropriate solutions.

Optimize data storage and retrieval systems for improved performance and cost-effectiveness.

Implement data quality checks and monitoring systems to ensure data integrity and reliability.

A day in the life
A Data Engineer I on SPIV starts their day by syncing with the team on data pipeline status, checking for any overnight failures in ETL jobs processing seller identity verification data. They collaborate with data scientists to understand new fraud detection requirements, then design and implement scalable data models using medallion architecture to support these use cases.

About the team
SPIV Data Engineering builds the data backbone for Selling Partner Identity Verification - preventing fraud across the seller lifecycle. Our Northstar is to build business domain datasets with data as product mental model. We're a collaborative team that values ownership, technical rigor, and shipping solutions that matter. You'll work with data scientists, analysts, and business teams. We emphasize learning, code quality, and building infrastructure that scales.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience with SQL
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
- Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
- Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc.

title: RME Operator, RME
descriptionHtml:
Na tym stanowisku wspierasz konserwację i naprawę naszej technologii przenośników i budynków, a także systemów produkcyjnych w naszym centrum logistycznym. Wraz z zespołem technicznym zapewnisz wysoką dostępność systemów technicznych dzięki dużej inicjatywie własnej i niezbędnemu know-how technicznemu.

To Twoja szansa, żeby wkroczyć do świata RME. Wykorzystaj ją.

Key job responsibilities
Celem tej roli jest wykonywanie czynności konserwacyjnych na Amazon Robotics Drives (roboty mobilne). Obejmują one kontrolę maszyn, wymianę części zgodnie z instrukcjami konserwacji i testami, a także zapewnienie przestrzegania przepisów i zasad bezpieczeństwa.

OBOWIĄZKI
1. Wykonywanie wszystkich prewencyjnych kontroli konserwacyjnych na Amazon Robotics Drives (roboty mobilne).
2. Wymiana części zamiennych, takich jak sterowniki silników i podnośników, podzespoły elektroniczne oraz elementy mechaniczne zgodnie z procedurami Amazon Robotics.
3. Wykorzystanie skomputeryzowanego systemu zarządzania konserwacją do zamykania zleceń roboczych i zarządzania częściami zamiennymi.
4. Korzystanie z podstawowych narzędzi warsztatowych i odkurzacza.
5. Fizyczne przemieszczanie napędów AR ze strefy serwisowej (zlecone przez certyfikowanego technika AR RME) do klatki serwisowej.
6. Zapewnienie bezpiecznego i czystego stanowiska pracy w trakcie i po wykonaniu prac.

A day in the life
Wynagrodzenie podstawowe dla tego stanowiska jest wskazane poniżej. Amazon kieruje się zasadą całkowitego wynagrodzenia, w związku z czym oprócz wynagrodzenia zasadniczego mogą być przewidziane dodatkowe składniki wynagrodzenia, takie jak premie (w odpowiednich przypadkach). Zespół rekrutacyjny poinformuje Cię o ostatecznej kwocie wynagrodzenia zasadniczego oraz o wszystkich przysługujących dodatkowych składnikach wynagrodzenia, w zależności od umiejętności i wymagań.Dodatkowe świadczenia przysługują na warunkach obowiązujących w Spółce i obejmują m.in. plany emerytalne, dodatkowe ubezpieczenie zdrowotne, dodatkowe ubezpieczenie na życie, ubezpieczenie podróży służbowych, kartę MultiSport, dofinasowanie do posiłków w stołówce firmowej, kod rabatowy dla pracowników i program zniżek pracowniczych (EDC/Extras) oraz Program Wsparcia Pracownika (EAP – prywatne i poufne doradztwo i wsparcie).Wynagrodzenie podstawowe dla tego stanowiska wynosi 37.5 PLN za godzinę.

Basic qualifications

- Praktyka zawodowa lub dyplom ukończenia szkoły średniej
- Podstawowa znajomość języka angielskiego (kraje nieanglojęzyczne)

Preferred qualifications

- Preferowane kwalifikacje nie są wymagane do starania się o stanowisko w firmie Amazon. Z przyjemnością zapoznamy się z kandydaturą osób, które posiadają wszystkie wyżej wymienione kwalifikacje podstawowe.
- Doświadczenie w znajdowaniu błędów w maszynach

- Wiedza i doświadczenie elektryczne

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
Technical writing to support change management program
Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
Role may support more than one location/site.


Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection


This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility


Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

descriptionHtml:
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements

A day in the life
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.

Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).

You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.

About the team
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. descriptionHtml:

title: Mechanical Integration Leader, OMHS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Mechanical Integration Lead to drive the successful installation, integration, and deployment of material handling equipment (MHE) across multiple greenfield and brownfield fulfillment center sites. This role provides hands-on mechanical engineering leadership in complex automation environments, ensuring projects meet Amazon's safety, timeline, cost, and quality standards. The Mechanical Integration Lead will directly manage mechanical installation crews deploying conveyor systems, sortation equipment, and associated structural systems across North America. Reporting to the Site Deployment Manager, you will lead sub-teams responsible for structural steel installation, conveyor prep and placement, mechanical connections and belting, side guide and netting installation, pneumatic systems, and mechanical quality control and commissioning. You will collaborate across engineering, supply chain, and operations to implement scalable solutions, resolve technical issues in the field, and deliver high-impact results across large, multi-site programs.

Key job responsibilities
Mechanical Installation Leadership:
• Directly manage and lead mechanical installation crews deploying MHE across North American facilities
• Oversee structural header steel installation including hanging steel, prebuilding supports, and anchoring to building structure
• Lead conveyor prep and placement operations — rigging, lifting, staging, and setting conveyor sections into final positions on installed supports
• Manage conveyor connections and belting crews — ensuring proper mechanical alignment, bed connections, squaring, leveling, and hardware tightening
• Direct side guide and netting installation ensuring proper alignment and tension
• Oversee belt crew operations including belting and lacing installation on aligned conveyor sections
• Manage pneumatic/air systems installation including air connections to conveyor components, pressure testing, and leak verification
• Coordinate with the logistics and receiving team to ensure materials are inventoried, staged, and distributed to work zones on schedule

Quality Control & Commissioning:
• Lead mechanical QC and commissioning activities including alignment verification, hardware inspections, and match-mark verification
• Oversee conveyor run-in testing, belt tracking verification, and belt tension checks
• Manage mechanical punch list identification and repair
• Verify IOQ checks and ensure all mechanical systems meet specifications before handoff to electrical teams
• Ensure proper match-marking of nuts/bolts to verify tightness across all connections

Technical Leadership & Standards:
• Provide mechanical engineering expertise for automation initiatives across assigned sites
• Implement technical solutions and lead project-level decisions within the mechanical scope
• Follow and help develop mechanical installation standards and best practices
• Create and maintain technical documentation including work instructions, installation SOPs, and QC checklists
• Participate in design reviews and drive mechanical engineering excellence
• Recommend and implement process improvements to increase installation efficiency and quality

Project Execution & Coordination:
• Lead delivery of complex mechanical installation projects with multi-site impact
• Work cross-functionally with engineering, supply chain, and operations teams
• Coordinate with the electrical integration lead to ensure proper sequencing — mechanical work must be complete in each zone before electrical teams
mobilize
• Manage relationships with mechanical vendors and partners
• Provide technical input to leadership for data-driven decision-making
• Drive achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned zones
• Participate in daily business reviews with installation progress updates

A day in the life
As a Mechanical Integration Lead, you start your day with the site coordination meeting, reviewing progress against the installation schedule and identifying any material or sequencing issues with your crews. From there, you're on the construction
floor — walking zones with your structural steel team verifying header hanger loads, checking that the conveyor prep and placement crew has the right sections staged, and ensuring the connections team is properly aligning and torquing hardware. You troubleshoot rigging challenges, coordinate with the Site Operations Leader on material deliveries, and validate that mechanical QC checks are passed before handing zones off to the electrical team. You close out by updating job plans, flagging risks for the daily business review, and planning tomorrow's crew assignments, ratios, and confirming proper routing around obstructions. You oversee wire pulling operations in active zones, ensuring proper cable sizing, bend radius compliance, and pull tension limits are respected. Mid-morning you inspect control panel placements, verifying mounting locations match drawings, checking clearance requirements, and confirming grounding connections. You validate junction box and disconnect installations, review wire terminations for proper torque values and labeling, and address any field conflicts that require engineering clarification. By afternoon, you're tracking installation progress against the schedule, coordinating with the device installation lead on upcoming zone handoffs, and documenting redlines for as-built updates. You close out at the daily business review with progress updates and flag any material or access risks for the next day.

About the team
The OMHS Installation & Deployment team supports the deployment and integration of automation and material handling systems across Amazon's operations network. The team works cross-functionally with engineering, construction, operations, supply chain, vendors, and field execution partners to deliver safe, scalable, and reliable systems.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in engineering including a supervisory role managing people
- Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
- 5+ years of experience in industrial engineering, operations engineering, manufacturing engineering, or project engineering in a manufacturing or construction environment
- Experience in a supervisory role managing installation crews, maintenance technicians, or tradespeople
- Experience with the project management of technical projects in fast-paced, automated industrial environments
- Experience delivering technical projects in active construction environments
- Ability to travel up to 50% domestically; travel may exceed 50% in some instances with short notice
- Ability to read and understand installation drawings

Preferred qualifications

- Prior experience managing millwrights, maintenance technicians, fabricators, ironworkers, riggers, pipefitters, or aircraft mechanics
- Prior experience working for a material handling integrator
- Prior experience installing conveyor or sortation systems
- Experience with rigging, crane operations, and heavy equipment placement
- Experience with structural steel installation and load verification
- Knowledge of AutoCAD, BIM 360, or equivalent CAD software
- Experience working with and managing third-party vendors and subcontractors
- Experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing, or continuous improvement methodologies
- Experience with pneumatic systems installation and testing
- PMP or other project management certification

title: Senior Manager, Security Specialists, AWS Industries Tech, Security Specialists
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a bar-raising leader to manage and evolve the AWS Industries (AWSI) Security Advisory Solutions Architecture team. This is a global people-leadership role responsible for the Security Advisory SA function worldwide - a team of Principal and Senior Security Solutions Architects across North America and EMEA who serve as trusted security advisors to the largest and most complex global enterprise customers at AWS. You will own the strategy, talent, and operating mechanisms for the function, and evolve the team to meet the emerging and rapidly evolving changes in cybersecurity requirements and practices.

The Security Advisory team ensures that security is the enabler and accelerator - unblocking the security, governance, risk, and compliance requirements that stand between a customer and their next milestone. When customers migrate workloads, modernize applications, or deploy AI on AWS, your team operates as trusted advisors embedded in their transformation journey, delivering security assessments, reference architectures, and compliance guidance that translate into actionable guidance and deployable solutions. Your job is to lead, develop, and empower the team that does this work at a world-class level, and to shape the function so its expertise reaches across industries and geographies.

You will lead an established, high-performing team with the ability to evolve it and take it to the next level. You lead people first - the majority of your impact comes through leading, coaching, and developing your team and shaping the function. Also, your ability to build trust and manage strategic relationships with executive leadership at AWS and within customers, especially at the CISO level, will be highly correlated to the success of your team and your customers. At the same time, you stay technically engaged as a player-coach: close enough to the work to raise the bar on your team's architectures and guidance, and to engage directly with senior stakeholders when it matters most. You bring deep, hands-on and leadership experience in cybersecurity and related domains such as governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). You and your team are expected to be strong in AI security across 1\ securing AI workloads, 2\ using AI to secure, and 3\ defending against AI-borne threats, across the full AI lifecycle on AWS - in addition to the security of all workloads customers might build on AWS.

As a senior leader in the organization, you will help define security strategies that move entire industries forward, and create new strategies for the team and organization to execute on that set the standard for how AWS raises the security bar for customers. You will drive thought leadership both across your team and in your own right - your team will be recognized as the go-to security experts for customers, for AWS field and service teams, and in the external market, representing AWS's voice publicly as thought leaders and well-versed speakers, and through external industry workgroups, trade groups, conferences, and standards bodies. You will engage senior customer stakeholders at an executive level, and influence, partner, and collaborate with internal AWS and Amazon executives. You will scale your team's expertise across the entire field - beyond just the security specialist community - so that proven security solutions can be deployed by all, freeing your team to focus on solving the next emerging security challenges for industry. You will operate with a high degree of independence and a strong executive presence.



Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Manager, Security Solutions Architecture, you will:

- Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing team of Senior and Principal Security Solutions Architects across North America and EMEA, raising the bar with every hire
- Lead with empathy and empowerment, building a culture of ownership, bias for action, and trust
- Evolve the team's capabilities to keep pace with rapidly changing cybersecurity requirements and practices
- Own the strategy, operating mechanisms, and metrics to deliver measurable impact for the world's largest enterprises
- Create new strategies that set the standard for how AWS raises the security bar for customers
- Engage CISOs and other business and technology decision makers at an executive level, and partner with AWS and Amazon executives
- Stay technically hands-on enough to coach complex engagements across securing AI, using AI to secure, and defending against AI-driven threats
- Scale the team's expertise across the field so proven solutions can be deployed by all, freeing the team for the next emerging challenges
- Drive thought leadership across the team and in your own right, inside AWS and publicly
- Amplify the voice of the customer to influence the AWS services roadmap

A day in the life
Your day starts with your team: a check-in with an architect working through an AI security question for a major enterprise customer, then a coaching session with a Principal preparing for a CISO briefing. Midday, you're in an executive conversation helping a CISO shape their security strategy. In the afternoon, you're partnering with AWS service leaders on a pattern your team keeps seeing in the field, and reviewing a new reference architecture others can reuse. Some days end with a talk or a hiring loop; every day ends with your team a little stronger.

About the team
We are a team of security advisors to the world's largest enterprises, and our mission is simple: make security the thing that helps our customers move faster and safer, not the thing that slows them down. You'll lead architects across North America and EMEA who work alongside service owners, account teams, and industry specialists to solve problems no one has a playbook for. Our culture runs on trust, technical curiosity, and sharing what we learn so the whole organization raises the bar. We have each other's backs, own our customers' hardest challenges, and invest in building each other up.

- 5+ years of managing a technical team of solution architects, sales engineers or similar technical roles experience
- 7+ years of Information Technology (IT) experience

- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.
- Experience in security or compliance consulting or advisory work in support of a highly technical environment

Preferred qualifications

title: Principal Product Manager - Technical, AWS Assurance
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping organizations manage governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) at cloud scale? AWS is building a new AI-powered GRC service that delivers continuous compliance, real-time risk quantification, and governance for AI agent workloads. We are seeking a Principal Product Manager – Technical (PMT) to own and drive critical product areas as we scale this service for enterprise adoption.

About the Opportunity

The GRC market is $60B+ and undergoing a fundamental transformation. Point-in-time audits are becoming untenable as enterprises operate across multi-cloud and hybrid environments that change daily. AI agents are proliferating faster than compliance programs can adapt. No incumbent GRC vendor has a credible solution for continuous, AI-native governance. AWS is uniquely positioned to win here — and we're building the team to make it happen.

In this role, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, requirements, and go-to-market for a core set of capabilities within a new cloud-native GRC service. You will work backwards from enterprise GRC buyers — compliance officers, risk managers, CISOs, and audit teams — to define what we build and why. You will partner with engineering, science, UX, marketing, sales, and legal to deliver capabilities that win in a competitive and rapidly evolving market.

This is a high-ownership role. You will define the product vision for your area, author PRFAQs and requirements documents, make pricing and packaging decisions, and drive adoption post-launch. You will operate at the intersection of deep domain expertise in compliance/audit/risk and strong technical product management fundamentals.

Key job responsibilities
Leverage deep audit and compliance expertise — direct experience conducting, managing, or overseeing audits — to define product requirements that solve real practitioner pain points

Own the product strategy and roadmap for a core domain within a new AI-powered GRC service — from vision through delivery and adoption

Work backwards from enterprise GRC customers to define requirements, acceptance criteria, and prioritization

Author PRFAQs, pricing narratives, and requirements documents that align engineering execution with customer outcomes

Partner with engineering leads to make architecture tradeoffs, scope MVPs, and drive sprint-level execution through a multi-pod organization

Define and drive go-to-market strategy including positioning, sales enablement, customer onboarding, and partner ecosystem plays

Leverage deep domain knowledge of compliance standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, NIST, EU AI Act), audit workflows, and risk management to inform product decisions

Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and customer telemetry to identify opportunities and inform prioritization

Work cross-functionally with marketing, field sales, solution architects, professional services, and GSI partners to drive enterprise adoption

Represent the service in customer meetings, industry events, and executive reviews

Influence cross-AWS strategy by collaborating with adjacent governance and security teams to deliver integrated experiences



A day in the life
On a typical day, you might review customer feedback from a Fortune 500 enterprise, author a requirements for a new capability, meet with engineering to finalize scope for the next release train, join a customer call with a solution architect to understand an auditor's workflow, analyze service telemetry to identify adoption blockers, and sync with marketing on positioning for an upcoming industry event. You will work across time zones with a globally distributed team. The pace is fast, the problems are complex, and the opportunity is massive — you'll be defining a new category in cloud-native GRC.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
- 5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)

- Conhecer a fundo a arquitetura, as dependências e as prioridades de negócio dos workloads críticos da sua carteira de clientes.
- Conduzir revisões proativas dos workloads críticos, como Critical Workload Reviews (CWR) e Operational Readiness Reviews (ORR), incluindo observabilidade e resiliência, com recomendações priorizadas pelo impacto no negócio, e revisar continuamente os alarmes do AWS Incident Detection and Response (IDR).
- Em incidentes críticos, levar o contexto do cliente ao bridge com os Incident Management Engineers, os Support Engineers e o Technical Account Manager (TAM); depois, conduzir o post-incident review.
- Liderar esforços técnicos que envolvem múltiplos times da AWS, coordenando as equipes de serviço para entregar soluções unificadas aos clientes.
- Representar a AWS junto à liderança dos clientes em discussões sobre incidentes, trade-offs de arquitetura e gestão de riscos.
- Manter cadências técnicas com o cliente, incluindo revisão de service quotas e de mudanças de arquitetura, game days e exercícios de recuperação de desastres.
- Ser o(a) dono(a) da comunicação técnica no seu domínio.

A day in the life
Seu dia vai combinar resolução técnica de problemas complexos com aconselhamento estratégico aos clientes. Como engenheiro(a) designado(a), você será a referência técnica no seu domínio e vai trabalhar em conjunto com o TAM para apoiar os clientes. Você pode começar a manhã em um incidente crítico que envolve vários serviços, levando o contexto do ambiente do cliente ao Incident Management Engineer e aos Support Engineers que conduzem a resolução. Você trabalha lado a lado com as equipes de engenharia e de serviço para chegar à causa raiz e entregar uma solução sob medida. Depois, é você quem conduz a análise posterior. Mais tarde, você pode fazer uma Operational Readiness Review (ORR), incluindo observabilidade e resiliência, com outro cliente, aplicando o AWS Well-Architected Framework para identificar riscos e oportunidades de otimização. Suas recomendações são priorizadas pelo impacto no negócio e geram melhorias mensuráveis em disponibilidade, resiliência ou reduzem o risco operacional.

Ao longo do dia, você define o ritmo do engajamento técnico. Você chega às reuniões de cadência já com o contexto do ambiente, acompanha as mudanças nos workloads e propõe os próximos passos. Você também conduz conversas com a liderança sênior do cliente sobre trade-offs, estratégias de suporte e roadmaps de longo prazo na nuvem. Quando aparece uma necessidade fora do seu domínio, você aciona os especialistas certos dentro da AWS. Você também mantém atualizado o contexto de cada cliente, o que permite um suporte proativo e personalizado em todo o ciclo de vida das aplicações.

About the team
O time de DSEs no Brasil faz parte da AWS Support e atua junto ao Enterprise Support, no AWS Unified Operations, o nível mais alto de suporte da AWS.

Experiências Diversas
A Amazon valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações e habilidades preferenciais listadas nesta descrição, incentivamos você a se candidatar. Se a sua carreira está começando, não seguiu um caminho tradicional ou inclui experiências alternativas, não deixe que isso o(a) impeça de se candidatar.

Por que a AWS?
A Amazon Web Services (AWS) é a plataforma de nuvem mais abrangente e amplamente adotada do mundo. Fomos pioneiros em computação em nuvem e nunca paramos de inovar — por isso, clientes que vão das startups de maior sucesso às empresas da Global 500 confiam em nossa robusta suíte de produtos e serviços para impulsionar seus negócios.

Work/Life Balance
Valorizamos a harmonia entre vida pessoal e profissional. O sucesso no trabalho nunca deve vir às custas de sacrifícios em casa, e é por isso que buscamos a flexibilidade como parte da nossa cultura de trabalho. Quando nos sentimos apoiados no trabalho e em casa, não há nada que não possamos conquistar na nuvem.

Cultura de Time Inclusiva
Aqui na AWS, aprender e ser curioso faz parte da nossa natureza. Nossos grupos de afinidade, liderados por funcionários, promovem uma cultura de inclusão que nos permite ter orgulho das nossas diferenças. Eventos e experiências de aprendizado contínuos, incluindo as conferências Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) e AmazeCon (diversidade de gênero), nos inspiram a nunca deixar de abraçar a nossa singularidade.

Mentoria e Crescimento Profissional
Estamos continuamente elevando a nossa régua de desempenho na busca por nos tornarmos o Melhor Empregador do Mundo (Earth’s Best Employer). Por isso, você encontrará aqui compartilhamento de conhecimento sem fim, mentoria e outros recursos de desenvolvimento de carreira para ajudá-lo(a) a se tornar um(a) profissional mais completo(a).

Basic qualifications

- Diploma universitário em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática ou disciplina relacionada, ou experiência de trabalho equivalente.
- Experiência prática com parâmetros operacionais e solução de problemas em pelo menos uma das seguintes áreas: Infraestrutura/Administração de Sistemas, Redes, DevOps, Compute, Containers, Storage, Bancos de Dados, Migração de Dados, Big Data e Analytics, Segurança, Serverless ou Desenvolvimento de Aplicações, em ambientes de sistemas distribuídos.
- Fluência em português e inglês, com capacidade de conduzir conversas técnicas com engenheiros e lideranças dos clientes.

Preferred qualifications

- Experiência anterior dando suporte técnico a clientes e contas.
- Experiência com serviços AWS.
- Certificações AWS de nível Professional ou Specialty.
- Conhecimento do AWS Well-Architected Framework e experiência em revisões de resiliência e observabilidade e em análise de causa raiz de incidentes.
- Experiência em ambientes regulados de alta disponibilidade, como serviços financeiros, seguros ou telecomunicações.
- Espanhol (desejável)

title: Commissioning Program Manager (Standardization & Compliance), APJC Commissioning
descriptionHtml:
Do you have experience leading standards and compliance programs? Data Center Capacity Delivery Commissioning is looking for a Commissioning Program Manager, Standardization & Compliance. In this role, you will define commissioning standards, measure compliance through clear metrics, drive improvement plans, and build training that makes commissioning execution more consistent.

Your work directly supports a team of experienced commissioning professionals who deliver data center capacity across APAC. You will set the standards for how commissioning is done in the region, and you'll work with AMER and EMEA teams to shape global practice. We work backwards from our customers, and we deliver with speed without compromising Safety, Quality, Time, and Cost.

Key job responsibilities
Standardization Program Management
- Define commissioning execution standards, using technical judgment to separate must-haves from nice-to-haves
- Develop new programs, standards, and processes that improve execution consistency, guided by defined metrics
- Share analysis with business stakeholders, explain its value, and propose changes

Compliance Program Management
- Develop audit mechanisms and compliance metrics to measure adherence to commissioning standards and keep data accurate
- Partner with analysts to automate data extraction and analysis that tests hypotheses
- Define new metrics and use the results to drive change
- Present in leadership operational and business reviews (WBR/MBR/QBR), and call out areas that need immediate action
- Own quarterly improvement roadmaps, using technical knowledge of AWS data center requirements to improve business metrics

Operational Excellence
- Identify process gaps, measure their impact, propose actions, track results, and iterate
- Find training gaps, and create SOPs and training that improve compliance with standards
- Simplify commissioning processes by removing steps that don't add value
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to make the deliverables Commissioning receives and provides more consistent
- Work with APAC, AMER, and EMEA counterparts to drive global alignment

A day in the life
A process is only as strong as its weakest link. You will use your technical knowledge to find and strengthen those weak links, and to build the foundation of AWS commissioning standards. You will work with analysts to test hypotheses with data and use what you find to reduce project risk to Safety, Quality, Time, and Cost globally.

Consistent execution is what makes a process succeed. You will bring your industry knowledge and experience to develop best-in-class practices and build training and other methods that help teams execute consistently. You will have the backbone to tell the business, with data, where it can improve. You will partner with peers on solutions that keep the business agile and able to deliver high-quality builds consistently.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We deliver the critical power, cooling, and mechanical infrastructure that keeps AWS servers, storage, and networking running, so our customers always have access to the innovation they rely on.

The AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery Commissioning team is an independent critical infrastructure validation team within the Data Center Capacity Delivery organization. Our electrical, mechanical, and controls engineers, project managers, operators, and analysts provide rigorous engineering and operational review and testing of designs, equipment, and construction practices across APAC.

We bridge the gap between what a design requires and what operations need. Our success is measured by meeting business demand and delivering infrastructure that delights our customers. We believe that "Tomorrow's Quality is Today's Validation."

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of commissioning experience
- 7+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience
- Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing own tasks and those of other team members for multiple projects
- Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business

Preferred qualifications

- Experience performing and presenting business case analyses
- Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds
- Experience in construction, or experience reading and interpreting construction drawings and specifications
- Experience in stakeholder and communication management

title: Sr Product Manager, Technical, WW Prime
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about shaping products that reach millions of customers? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology and customer experience, turning ambiguity into clear product strategy? As a Technical Product Manager at Amazon, you will own the vision, roadmap, and delivery of products that solve real customer problems at scale. You will partner closely with engineering, design, science, and business teams to define what we build and why — using data, customer insights, and sound judgment to make smart trade-offs. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex technical challenges, influence product architecture decisions, and drive meaningful business outcomes while keeping the customer at the center of everything you do.

Key job responsibilities
- Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap by working backward from customer needs, conducting research, analyzing usage data and market trends, and translating insights into clear problem statements and prioritized deliverables.
- Partner with engineering, scientists, end economists to evaluate technical proposals, define requirements for APIs and system components, and ensure product solutions balance performance, scalability, and long-term architectural integrity.
- Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, science, design, finance, marketing, and operations to deliver products on time and at high quality, influencing teams with different priorities through clear communication and well-structured documents.
- Define success criteria and key performance metrics, distinguish between output and outcome measures, and use data analysis alongside sound judgment to inform decisions — leveraging generative AI capabilities where appropriate to accelerate insight generation and development cycles.
- Influence multiple VP-led organizations on their customer experience approaches and investment priorities
- Own the full product lifecycle from concept through launch and post-launch optimization, monitoring operational health, driving customer adoption, and iterating based on performance data and direct customer feedback.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing product metrics and customer feedback to identify emerging patterns. By mid-morning, you are in a design review with engineers, probing trade-offs in a proposed architecture change and aligning on next steps. After lunch, you draft a product requirements document for an upcoming feature, grounding it in recent customer research. Later, you connect with cross-functional partners in marketing and operations to coordinate an upcoming launch. Throughout, you use AI tools to prototype ideas and accelerate analysis, keeping your focus on delivering the right experience for customers.

About the team
Our team is focused on building products that make a meaningful difference for customers. We operate in a collaborative environment where product managers, engineers, designers, and scientists work side by side to solve complex problems and ship impactful solutions. We value curiosity, clear thinking, and a willingness to challenge assumptions. Looking ahead, we are investing in new capabilities — including AI-driven experiences — to push the boundaries of what our products can do. If you want to shape the future of technology-driven products at Amazon and grow alongside a talented, inclusive team, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or Master's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
- Background in analytics and causal inference (strongly preferred)
- Experience working with Machine Learning Scientists, Economists, or other science domains to develop highly scalable systems that solve challenges around forecasting, optimization, personalization, or similar
- Demonstrated cross-functional ownership of complex, ambiguous initiatives, including communicating with senior leadership

title: Data Centre Engineering Operations Facilities Manager, DCEO
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Data Centre Facilities Manager leads critical infrastructure operations at strategic AWS facilities that power cloud computing services worldwide. This role combines operational excellence, technical expertise, and team leadership to ensure continuous facility availability while driving innovation and cost efficiency.
This position requires hands-on oversight of mission-critical infrastructure and leadership of integrated Data Centre Systems and Mechanical & Electrical teams. The Facilities Manager maintains operational standards, security protocols, facility certifications, and manages third-party vendor relationships while implementing processes that enhance infrastructure reliability and reduce operational costs.

Key job responsibilities
Operations & Infrastructure Management

• Manage 24/7 site engineering operations, including shift planning, maintenance schedules, and Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM)
• Oversee critical infrastructure systems including electrical components (feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units) and mechanical systems (chillers, pumps, air handling units)
• Drive Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) improvements, optimising cooling, power, and infrastructure for maximum efficiency
• Manage and optimise space and power to maximise opportunities for growth and operational efficiency
• Plan and deliver site infrastructure projects on time, within scope, and on budget
• Budget & cost management — develop, manage and control operational budgets
• Vendor & stakeholder management — maintain productive relationships with third-party service providers and internal stakeholders

Leadership & Team Development

• Lead, inspire, and develop teams of experienced technical professionals
• Act as a role model, driving service excellence, training, and development for all team members
• Foster an inclusive environment that encourages innovation and empowers team members to solve complex operational challenges
• Implement rigorous training programs that prepare staff for various operational scenarios through systematic skill development

Compliance & Safety

• Ensure adherence to and exceed Health & Safety standards in all operations
• Maintain compliance with health & safety, security procedures, and compliance accreditations
• Ensure understanding of UK regulatory requirements, particularly health and safety legislation
• Maintain a safe working environment and drive continuous safety improvements
• Risk management & incident response — lead emergency procedures and root cause analysis

Basic qualifications

- Experience in people management and team development
- Experience in engineering work, managing large-scale services
- Experience maintaining SLAs through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
- Experience operating a mission-critical team or product

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units
- Experience in a management position with 5 or more direct reports
- Experience working in data centers with an emphasis on building and equipment operation

title: Finance Apprentice (42-month fixed term contract)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. As we continue to grow and innovate, we're seeking Finance Apprentices to join our dynamic team. In this role, you'll gain hands-on experience in financial management while working alongside industry experts, developing expertise in accountancy, taxation, and business strategy. This is your opportunity to launch your finance career at a company that's redefining the future of commerce, where you'll contribute to strategic business decisions that shape Amazon's future.

A career as an accountancy, finance or taxation professional is diverse and challenging - it's far more than putting numbers into a spreadsheet. You'll inspect complex financial data, provide valuable insights and strategic advice, partner with key stakeholders, and help organisations make responsible, sustainable financial decisions. What makes this programme distinctive is the rotation: throughout your apprenticeship you'll move across three departments - Accounting, Finance, and Tax - giving you a genuine 360-degree view of the field, a broad skillset, and the chance to discover where your passion really lies.

Key job responsibilities
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams on high-impact projects
- Analysing financial data to uncover insights and drive decision-making
- Providing financial suggestions to stakeholders
- Participating in client meetings and presentations
- Learn from industry experts through mentorship and training programmes
- Applying your skills to real-world business needs

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds who have a genuine passion for finance and business insight, with strong problem-solving skills. Excellent communication is paramount - you'll build trusted, lasting relationships and work effectively with teams across the business. You'll bring an eagerness to learn and grow professionally, taking ownership of projects to deliver high-quality work to the right timelines. You'll also need to be flexible, adapting your approach to help stakeholders manage conflicting priorities as circumstances change.

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship you’ll have the opportunity to learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you’re a curious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

You'll work towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) certification alongside the Level 7 apprenticeship standard. As a working student, your focus during your 20% off-the-job time is to develop the skills, knowledge and behaviours that lead to successful graduation. You'll be set goals by your training provider and manager to support your studies.

You'll build your skills over a 42-month period, starting in September, developing both personally and professionally. Your apprenticeship combines classroom and virtual training to cover the knowledge, on-the-job training at your Amazon base location, online learning, and mentoring from our experienced team members.

We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups – including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities - foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Your career isn't a straight path - it's a journey you build as you go. A universe of opportunity awaits, and your next adventure starts here.

Please note: as part of your off-the-job learning, you may be required to travel to a training centre, and this location may differ from your primary work base. Candidates should be prepared for occasional travel as part of the programme. Apprentices at Amazon may be assigned to projects across different business areas, which can include work involving sales of products such as alcohol or pork. We recognise that applicants may have personal or religious considerations related to these areas and encourage candidates to discuss any concerns early in the process so that we can explore possible accommodations early in the process.

Ready to shape the future of finance at Amazon? Apply now and begin your journey to becoming a finance professional!

Basic qualifications

- To qualify for this programme, you must:
- Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027)
- Have the right to live and work in England at the point of enrolment (June 2027). If you are on a visa, this must enable you to legally work and reside in England for the entire duration of the programme from enrolment.
- Have lived in the UK or in the European Economic Area (EEA) for the last 3 years prior to the start date
- Not be registered to study on a UK government funded course ending August 2027 or later
- Be prepared to travel for external/mandatory training as part of the apprenticeship
- 5 GCSEs at grade 4-9 (A-C) or above (or equivalent) including Maths and English.
- Wording about one of the following:
- 3 A Levels at grades BBB (or equivalent) or Finance T-Level at grade Merit or above
- In cooperation with the UK government, we are offering apprenticeship roles aligned with current funding guidelines. Government funding for Level 7 apprenticeships is generally available to young people early in their careers with the right to live and work in England. You can find full details on the UK government website.
- Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of the UK then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/
- Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility and offers are subject to funding approval
- PLEASE NOTE: This position is a 42 month fixed-term contract. You must NOT already have a qualification in a similar subject at the same or higher level than this apprenticeship.
- This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has some or little knowledge/experience of the occupation

Preferred qualifications

- A genuine interest in finance, accountancy, and how businesses make decisions
- Excellent numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with a logical and methodical approach
- Meticulous attention to detail
- Good communication skills, able to explain financial information clearly to a range of audiences
- Well organised, able to manage your own workload and prioritise deadlines
- A collaborative mindset and genuine enjoyment of working as part of a team
- A curiosity and eagerness to learn, grow, and take ownership of your development
