title: Future Operations Leader - Degree Apprenticeship North West (37-month fixed term contract)
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to step into a leadership role in one of the world's most fast-paced, customer-obsessed operations? This is your opportunity to earn a fully funded degree from a Russell Group university while leading in the heart of Amazon's operations - from day one.

Amazon is looking for ambitious, driven individuals to join our Future Operations Leader Degree Apprenticeship. You'll earn a fully funded BSc (Hons) in Leadership and Project Management while working on the ground in one of our fulfilment centres or operational sites, solving real business challenges alongside experienced leaders. This is a hands-on role, not a desk job - our sites are vast (some the size of several football pitches), and you'll be out across the floor where the action happens, covering real distance as you lead teams, drive change, and make a tangible impact.

At its core, this is a people role. Yes, you'll work with data, processes, and technology - but the heart of operations leadership is people. You'll learn how to motivate a team at 3am, how to have difficult conversations with empathy, how to recognise when someone's struggling, and how to create an environment where people want to do their best work. If you're energised by working with others and want to build your career around leading teams, this programme will give you the foundation to do exactly that.

This role involves shift work, including days, nights, and weekends, because our operations run around the clock and great leaders need to understand every part of that rhythm. You'll rotate through different shift patterns, which means early starts, late finishes, and yes, night shifts. It's a demanding, fast-paced environment with a lot to juggle – you'll need to prioritise quickly, stay composed under pressure, and keep the most important things moving. It's a real step up, and we're looking for people who expect that challenge and are ready to run with it. It's a physical, on-your-feet role - you'll be out on the floor, not behind a desk. It's not for everyone, but if you thrive where no two days feel the same and you want to understand operations from the ground up, it's one of the most valuable parts of the experience.

A day in the life can involve:

- Starting with a team stand-up or shift handover, reviewing priorities, performance metrics, and issues from the previous shift

- Shadowing or supporting a team leader or manager on the floor, getting stuck into real-time problem solving - clearing a bottleneck, supporting a team member, or managing workflow across the site

- Working on a project linked to your degree - building a business case for a process improvement, mapping stakeholders for a site change, or analysing quality and risk data to present back to leadership

- On university weeks, attending masterclasses or webinars and completing coursework, then bringing what you've learned straight back onto the floor

As you progress, you'll build relationships across the site, develop your own leadership style, and take on increasing responsibility.

This could be for you if you're the person who captained a sports team, coached younger students, led a group project, completed your Duke of Edinburgh, volunteered in your community, organised something no one asked you to, or put your hand up to be a prefect. Or maybe you've spent a few years in the workplace and found yourself naturally stepping up - training new starters, leading a team, improving a process, or taking ownership of something bigger than your job description. Leadership isn't about a job title; it's about what you do when no one's told you to. If that sounds like you, this programme is your next step.

Over 37 months, you'll develop the knowledge and skills to lead in a complex operational environment, including:

- Business strategy and how organisations operate

- Project planning, scheduling, budgeting, and delivery within time, cost, and quality constraints

- Leading and managing diverse teams, building trust, and driving performance

- Financial controls, business case development, and performance reporting

- Stakeholder engagement, communication, and influencing at all levels

- Organisational change management - preparing teams and operations for change

- Risk identification, quality assurance, and continuous improvement

- Commercial awareness, procurement, and contract management

- Digital innovation, data-driven technologies, and AI in a business context

What you'll achieve:

- BSc (Hons) Leadership and Project Management

- Level 6 Project Manager Degree Apprenticeship

- CMI Level 5 Certificate in Project Management (dual accredited)

- International Project Management Association (IPMA) Level D qualification

Four qualifications. Fully funded. All earned while working.

This is a blended learning programme. Each module follows a 14-week cycle combining pre-reading and preparation, in-person masterclasses at the university, online learning and webinars, and individual study and assignment writing. You'll be supported throughout by a dedicated Academic Mentor, with progress reviews every 12 weeks involving your Line Manager, plus full access to university resources including library services, wellbeing support, and student societies.

Basic qualifications

- To qualify for this programme, you must:
- Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027)
- Have the right to live and work in England at the point of enrolment (June 2027). If you are on a visa, this must enable you to legally work and reside in England for the entire duration of the programme from enrolment.
- Have lived in the UK or in the European Economic Area (EEA) for the last 3 years prior to the start date
- Not be registered to study on a UK government funded course ending August 2027 or later
- Be prepared to travel for external/mandatory training as part of the apprenticeship
- Hold 5 GCSEs at grade 4-9 (A-C) or above (or equivalent) including Maths and English and 3 A Levels at minimum grades ABB (or equivalent). Contextual offers will also apply. https://www.ucas.com/applying/applying-university/individual-needs/contextual-admissions
- Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of the UK then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/
- Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility and offers are subject to funding approval
- PLEASE NOTE: This position is a 37 month fixed-term contract. You must NOT already have a qualification in a similar subject at the same or higher level than this apprenticeship.
- This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has some or little knowledge/experience of the occupation

Preferred qualifications

- An interest in operations, logistics, or supply chain environments
- A genuine enthusiasm for leading, motivating, and working with people
- Natural leadership instincts - the kind of person who steps up without being asked
- Resilient and able to prioritise under pressure - staying composed when the pace is demanding and there’s a lot to juggle
- Great communication skills and naturally able to influence others
- A problem-solving mindset and a willingness to learn
- Comfortable with change and able to stay calm in a fast-paced environment
- Happy working in fast-paced warehouse environment, including shift work (days, nights, and weekends)

title: Aerospace Transformation Business Dev leader, Auto & Manufacturing Industry Specialists and Solutions
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager to join the Industry Specialists team and help build our dedicated Aerospace footprint across EMEA.

In this role, you will own business development for aerospace workloads across the commercial aviation, defense-adjacent, and space value chains — including supply chain optimisation, predictive maintenance and MRO, digital twin and PLM, connected aircraft, and AI/ML for engineering.

You will engage directly with C-suite executives and VPs at leading European airframe OEMs, propulsion suppliers, Tier-1 systems integrators, and MRO providers to translate their most complex operational challenges into cloud-enabled opportunities, build a qualified pipeline, and shape AWS's aerospace-specific go-to-market plays and partner motions.

The ideal candidate will have deep aerospace industry expertise combined with a business development, consulting, or solutions background — with demonstrated experience engaging CxO/VP-level stakeholders at major aerospace companies.

You should understand the tightly coupled aerospace value chain, where product design changes, certification delays, and supply constraints cascade across company boundaries.

This is an individual contributor role for a builder who thrives in ambiguity, can create structure where none exists, and has the ownership and scrappiness to incubate a new segment from the ground up.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and execute the EMEA aerospace BD strategy aligned with the global OneAWS Aerospace roadmap, identifying priority customer targets, use cases, and partnership opportunities across commercial aviation, defense-adjacent, and space segments.

- Engage C-level and VP stakeholders (CEO, COO, CTO/CIO, VP Engineering, VP Supply Chain, VP MRO, VP Digital) at target European aerospace companies to understand their strategic priorities, build trust, and position AWS as a long-term transformation partner.

- Develop and manage a high-quality business development pipeline by identifying, qualifying, and advancing opportunities across aerospace-specific workloads: supply chain visibility and optimisation, MRO predictive maintenance, digital twin and simulation, PLM modernisation, connected product / IoT, compliance (CMMC/ITAR), and AI/ML for engineering.

- Lead the "Reuse, Adjust, Build" approach for EMEA — leveraging proven Automotive & Manufacturing solutions (digital twin, predictive maintenance, supply chain, IoT) and adapting them for aerospace-specific requirements such as MRO workflows, regulatory compliance (FAA/EASA, CMMC, ITAR/EAR), sovereignty, and aircraft lifecycle management.

- Drive strategic partner motions in EMEA with ISVs and system integrators to create differentiated joint solutions for European aerospace customers.

- Provide thought leadership on aerospace digitisation through executive briefings, industry events (Farnborough, Le Bourget, MRO Europe, Hannover Messe), workshops, and published content — positioning AWS as the aerospace industry provider with production-grade AI deployments and measurable business outcomes.

- Leverage Pan-Amazon proof points (Amazon Leo satellite constellation, Amazon Air fleet operations, Amazon Robotics) to build credibility and demonstrate how AWS technologies solve real-world aerospace challenges at scale.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with AWS field sales (AWSI, AGS), solutions architects, professional services, WWPS (for defense-adjacent workloads), partner teams, and product teams — acting as the single-threaded aerospace specialist who brings coherence across organisational boundaries.

- Serve as the "voice of the customer" internally, synthesising aerospace-specific market trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and customer feedback to influence AWS product and solution development.

A day in the life
No two days look the same in this role — and that's the point. You might spend the morning in Toulouse whiteboarding on how to modernise PLM architecture, and the afternoon on a call with a Tier-1 engine manufacturer's VP of MRO exploring how predictive maintenance could cut unplanned downtime. In between, you're swapping notes with your partner counterpart on a joint MRO workshop you're co-building, or briefing an AWS Solutions Architect on a customer's sovereignty and ITAR constraints before a technical deep-dive.

On any given week, you could find yourself:
- Preparing an executive briefing for a CSCO who wants to understand how AWS can help untangle a multi-tier supply chain visibility problem
- Co-developing an aerospace-specific use case (digital twin, engine health monitoring, connected aircraft) with the SA team to present at MRO Europe or Farnborough
- Reviewing competitive intelligence and drafting a plan leveraging Pan-Amazon proof points

- Running an internal "Aerospace Deep Dive" to educate field sales on why generic manufacturing messaging doesn't land with aerospace customers

- Aligning with the WWPS team on CMMC compliance positioning for a defense-adjacent account

- Updating shared account plans and tagging opportunities in the CRM so the broader team has visibility

- Drafting a 2-pager for leadership on a market signal or a customer win that could shape the GTM playbook

The common thread: you're always at the intersection of deep industry knowledge and cloud technology, building credibility with senior aerospace leaders while creating structure and momentum in a segment AWS is standing up from scratch.

About the team
AWS is building a dedicated Aerospace go-to-market capability within the Industry Specialists organisation. Our approach leverages the deep structural overlap between aerospace and our proven Automotive & Manufacturing solutions portfolio — reusing what works, adjusting for aerospace-specific requirements, and building only where critical gaps exist.

We combine AWS's breadth in AI/ML, IoT, HPC, and sovereign cloud with Pan-Amazon proof points (Leo, Amazon Air, Robotics) and a curated partner community to deliver measurable outcomes — not generic cloud messaging.

If you're energised by the prospect of building a new industry vertical from the ground up, working with some of the world's most iconic aerospace companies, and shaping AWS's position in a market where the next 12–18 months will define competitive positioning for a decade — we'd love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in the aerospace industry — in roles such as business development, management consulting, solution sales, product management, or programme management — spanning one or more of: commercial aviation, defense, space, or MRO. Demonstrated track record of engaging and influencing C-level and VP executives at major aerospace companies (OEMs, engine manufacturers, Tier-1 suppliers, or MRO providers). Strong understanding of the aerospace value chain and its key operational challenges: supply chain complexity and multi-tier visibility, MRO and predictive maintenance, digital engineering and PLM, regulatory compliance (FAA/EASA, CMMC, ITAR/EAR), and sovereignty requirements. Familiarity with enterprise platforms and technologies used in aerospace (e.g. SAP, PTC Windchill, Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE, Siemens Teamcenter, IFS) and how cloud and AI/ML technologies complement or transform them. Proven ability to develop and execute market development strategies in complex, matrixed environments that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue results.
- Experience communicating technical concepts to both technical and executive (non-technical) audiences in written and verbal formats

Preferred qualifications

- MBA or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, or related field. Experience with aerospace-specific technologies and concepts: digital twin for aircraft simulation and fleet monitoring, predictive maintenance for engine health and component failure, MRO transformation, HPC for CFD/structural analysis, CMMC/ITAR compliance frameworks, and connected aircraft / IoT. Experience working with or for a major aerospace company (e.g. Airbus, Safran, Rolls-Royce, Thales, Leonardo, BAE Systems) or a management consultancy on aerospace transformation engagements (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Roland Berger, Deloitte, Accenture, Capgemini). Understanding of the defense-industrial base and its intersection with commercial aerospace — including dual-use technology considerations and cross-sector compliance requirements. Track record of evangelising new technologies at aerospace industry events (Farnborough, Le Bourget, MRO Europe, Paris Air Forum, Aeromart). Experience incubating new market segments or industry verticals — building go-to-market from zero, not just executing established playbooks. Proficiency in French is a strong advantage given the Toulouse/Paris aerospace hub; German, Italian, or Spanish are a plus. Willingness to travel across EMEA and occasionally to the US (estimated 30–40%).
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent field, or equivalent professional experience
- Experience engaging and influencing C-level and VP-level executives in a business development or sales context

title: Business Analyst, Customer Experience, Amazon Air, Amazon Air - Customer Experience
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Air operates more than 100 flights a day across North America and is growing fast. The Customer Experience (CX) team owns the analytical frameworks that connect fleet performance, network operations, and on-time delivery outcomes for customers.
We are looking for a Business Analyst who can work on complex, ambiguous problems and turn operational data into clear, actionable insights. You will build and maintain the metrics, dashboards, and data pipelines that drive daily and weekly decision-making across the Amazon Air network. Your work will directly shape how the team understands and improves delivery performance for customers.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the design, development, and maintenance of operational dashboards and performance metrics that track delivery quality across the Amazon Air network, including DEA (Delivery Experience Attainment) and related indicators.
• Identify and investigate delivery performance gaps by diving deep into large, complex datasets across multiple data sources including Redshift, Andes, PerfectMile, and DataCentral.
• Build and maintain ETL pipelines and automated reporting solutions that reduce manual effort and improve the speed and accuracy of operational insights.
• Own the Misbucketing AIR process — identifying packages incorrectly attributed to Air operations and driving corrections through data — and continuously improve the intake and classification workflow.
• Support the AirWatch program by maintaining and improving dashboards that provide visibility into aircraft out-of-service events and their downstream impact on delivery performance.
• Partner with supply chain managers and operations leaders to translate business questions into analysis requirements, and present findings to senior stakeholders.
• Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis validation, and documentation — ensuring pipelines and dashboards can be independently maintained by others.
• Apply generative AI tools to accelerate insight generation and automate routine monitoring and reporting workflows.

A day in the life
On Monday, a delivery performance gap surfaces overnight. You pull the data, trace it to a root cause in the misbucketing pipeline, and have a draft fix to the data engineering team before the morning stand-up.
On Wednesday, an ops leader needs to understand why one gateway is running 15% above its defect target. You build the breakdown, identify the two drivers, and present a one-page summary that gets acted on the same day.
By Friday, you have pushed an updated dashboard to production, cutting a three-hour manual reporting process to fifteen minutes. The team uses it in Monday's business review.
No two weeks look the same.

About the team
Amazon Air's Customer Experience team sets the course for delivering more promises on time across a fast-growing network. We spot risks before they hit customers, and we build the mechanisms that turn a single root cause fix into a lasting improvement across the network.
We work directly with flight planning, linehaul, and data science teams to turn operational insight into action. We use GenAI to automate manual work so we can spend more time solving the next problem instead of reporting on the last one.
We are a small, hands-on team. Every person owns real outcomes, not just analysis.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
- 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
- Experience with Excel
- Experience with SQL
- Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
- Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale

Preferred qualifications

- Experience partnering with business leaders in highly complex and dynamic business settings
- Experience with SQL and database technologies such as AWS Redshift and expertise in performance tuning and scaling in a DWH environment
- Experience in ETL management/data pipeline
- Experience utilizing R or Python
- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or equivalent

title: Work Based Learning Program Data Center Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking Data Center Technicians as part of our Work Based Learning Program (WBLP). This trainee position requires the successful candidate report to a site location. Amazon has multiple WBLP trainee openings between January and December of 2027.

• Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
• Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
• Tolerance for working in non-climate-controlled environments with temperature fluctuations.




NOTE: Amazon is not able to provide immigration sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

NOTE: If applying for positions in Oregon (OR) and Ohio (OH), these sites are within AWS GovCloud region. Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Persons (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).



Key job responsibilities
• Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
• Serving as a contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
• Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
• Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
• Successfully completing the 12-month Work Based Learning Program training curriculum, including all required safety certifications, technical competencies, and performance milestones.






A day in the life
Day in The Life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you will grow into an industry-leading role and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you
• Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
• Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
• Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You may be required to work shifts that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and a valid driver’s license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.


About the team
AWS is committed to providing a safe and healthy work environment. The WBLP training program has a focus on safety, as a WBLP you will be trained on data center safety, policies, procedures, and guidelines.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon ( diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Are 18 years of age or older
- Willingness to participate in shift rotations to support 24/7 data center operations.

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of computer hardware components and operating systems
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager
- STEM classes or vocational course curriculum education

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits.

title: Manager, Solutions Architecture
descriptionHtml:
Cloud Computing and AI technology are changing the world. AWS is heavily investing in New Zealand, and we are looking for individuals who want to help us shape this exciting time, including our $7.5bn investment in the local Region. If you have a passion for using technology to impact the future of our customers, read on…

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced technical manager to lead the solutions architecture organization that helps customers succeed using AWS technologies.

This role is based in New Zealand, and will work with a variety of New Zealand commercial customers across Enterprise and FSI segments.

In this role, you will hire and develop some of the industry’s best cloud-based solutions architects, coach them on cloud and AI adoption best practices, empower them to further develop their technical areas of depth as well as their communication, presentation and strategic advisory skills. You will be partnering with other teams within AWS such as account management, service teams, marketing, and professional services, prioritizing your initiatives and aligning goals to maximize long term value.

Senior Managers work on the most complex customer challenges and opportunities. They have a leading role in developing both the strategy and the team itself. They combine an informed view of the market and their understanding of emerging technology to speed up innovation. Externally, they are seen as thought leaders and influence the IT strategy of our customers.

Key job responsibilities
- As a key member of the business development and sales management teams, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services onto the AWS platform.
- Hire, on-board, coach, and develop new Solutions Architects from internal and external sources.
- Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS, build deep relationships with decision makers within customer accounts to enable them to be “Cloud advocates”.
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
- Guide and motivate the development of whitepapers, data sheets, and other high-value customer facing guidance and best practices. Act as a conduit and liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support.

A day in the life
You and your organization will shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS services within a variety of customers across New Zealand. You will be interacting directly with executive customers to better understand their needs and align the right resources and tools to maximize their success. You will be measuring and delivering results, while staying in touch with the pace of innovation of the AWS technology and its use cases. You will need to be technically capable and credible in your own right as well so that you can shape the customer and solutions-focused initiatives of your organization.
You will get to practice your creativity in driving the link of technology to tangible solutions and educating customers about the art of the possible. Central to this will be your leadership in driving Solutions Architects to create cutting edge reference architectures for a variety of use cases.

About the team
Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of management of technical, enterprise customer facing resources or equivalent experience
- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Bachelor's degree

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Environmental Compliance Manager, Environmental Assurance and Protection
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through scalable, sustainable, and technology-enabled solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.
Southern Europe (SEU) team is seeking an Environmental Compliance Manager who will be responsible for managing environmental compliance at Amazon Facilities within France. They will also provide technical support for existing operations and future expansion across France and SEU. The Environmental Compliance Manager will report to the Sr. Environmental Compliance Manager for France through the EU Environmental Assurance and Protection team.
The Environmental Compliance Manager will partner with operations leadership teams to execute company environmental procedures and ensure compliance with all applicable specific country, state/province, region and local regulations. Utilizing risk assessments and compliance evaluations, this individual will lead site specific continuous improvement initiatives to minimize environmental aspects and impacts and communicate and implement best practices.
This role entails up to 50% travel to multiple sites across France, and EU

L'équipe EAP (Environmental Assurance & Protection) d'Amazon veille à ce que les activités mondiales d'Amazon soient une référence en matière d'excellence environnementale parmi les acteurs comparables. EAP transforme la conformité aux réglementations environnementales en un processus sans faille, grâce à des solutions évolutives, durables et technologiques qui protègent l'entreprise, nos communautés et l'environnement.
L'équipe Europe du Sud (SEU) recherche un·e Responsable de la conformité environnementale chargé·e de piloter la conformité environnementale des installations d'Amazon en France. Cette personne apportera également un soutien technique aux opérations existantes ainsi qu'aux projets d'expansion en France et dans l'UE. Le·la Responsable de la conformité environnementale sera rattaché·e au Responsable senior de la conformité environnementale pour la France, au sein de l'équipe d'assurance et de protection environnementales de l'UE (EAP).
En partenariat avec les équipes de direction des opérations, il·elle mettra en œuvre les procédures environnementales de l'entreprise et garantira le respect de l'ensemble des réglementations applicables aux niveaux national, régional, départemental et local. En s'appuyant sur des évaluations des risques et de conformité, cette personne dirigera des initiatives d'amélioration continue propres à chaque site, afin de réduire les aspects et impacts environnementaux et de diffuser et déployer les meilleures pratiques.
Ce poste nécessite des déplacements pouvant représenter jusqu'à 50 % du temps, sur plusieurs sites en France et dans l'UE.


Key job responsibilities
Gestion de la conformité
• Piloter et exécuter des responsabilités multi-sites afin de garantir la conformité aux lois, réglementations et autorisations environnementales applicables en matière d'émissions atmosphériques, d'eaux pluviales, de déchets, d'eaux usées, d'énergie et autres domaines environnementaux, y compris les obligations de déclaration aux niveaux national, régional et local.
• Participer au développement, à la mise en place, au contrôle, à l'amélioration et à l'application des systèmes de management environnemental, des procédures, des processus et des produits. Mesurer et analyser la performance des sites au regard des exigences définies dans les politiques environnementales. Pour chaque écart constaté, définir et mettre en œuvre un plan de remédiation.

Évaluation et maîtrise des risques
• Agir en tant qu'expert environnemental pour le périmètre attribué ; se tenir informé des évolutions réglementaires, des innovations en matière de maîtrise des risques, et savoir les appliquer à l'échelle des différentes équipes.
• Évoluer au sein de programmes et projets liés aux risques environnementaux où le risque, la problématique métier et la solution ne sont pas toujours clairement définis.
• Favoriser l'atteinte des objectifs et la conformité réglementaire ainsi que la réduction des risques, en contribuant à définir et à mettre en place des mécanismes permettant de ramener les risques à des niveaux tolérables.

Gestion des parties prenantes:
• Développer et entretenir des relations avec les partenaires internes afin de soutenir leur réussite dans les initiatives de conformité, de performance et de durabilité environnementales.
• Coopérer dans les échanges avec les autorités et dans la mise en œuvre des procédures de notification, d'autorisation et d'approbation relevant du droit de l'environnement (eau / eaux usées, prévention des pollutions, air, déchets, énergie).

A day in the life
Every day will be different. You will be visiting Amazon's France locations, engaging with the local teams and ensure the sites and the business as a whole are set up to deliver effective environmental compliance. You could be working with our Legal Team to engage a Regulator, collaborating with Maintenance or Safety partners, or helping sites deliver environmental training.
The ability to flex is essential in this role, as priorities can change in a constantly moving environment. As a team, we need to be able to respond accordingly.

Chaque journée sera différente. Vous vous rendrez sur les sites d'Amazon en France, échangerez avec les équipes locales et veillerez à ce que les sites et l'entreprise dans son ensemble soient en mesure d'assurer une conformité environnementale efficace. Vous pourrez être amené·e à travailler avec notre équipe juridique pour échanger avec un régulateur, à collaborer avec les partenaires de la maintenance ou de la sécurité, ou encore à aider les sites à dispenser des formations environnementales.
La capacité d'adaptation est essentielle dans ce rôle, car les priorités peuvent évoluer dans un environnement en perpétuel mouvement. En tant qu'équipe, nous devons être capables de réagir en conséquence.

About the team
The Environmental Assurance and Protection team protects Amazon businesses and supports the needs of our customers by proactively mitigating environmental regulatory risks and protecting the environment.

L'équipe Environmental Assurance & Protection (EAP) protège les activités d'Amazon et répond aux besoins de nos clients en anticipant la maîtrise des risques réglementaires environnementaux et en protégeant l'environnement.

Basic qualifications

- Excellentes compétences de communication, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, en anglais (C1) et en français (C1).
- Diplôme de niveau Licence (Bachelor) en sciences de l'environnement, en génie de l'environnement ou dans un domaine connexe, ou qualification de niveau équivalent selon le Cadre européen des certifications (CEC).
- Connaissance approfondie des réglementations environnementales de l'UE, y compris au niveau national (France) et local, avec la capacité d'interpréter et d'appliquer les exigences nationales et locales sur plusieurs sites.
- Expérience dans la gestion de programmes de conformité environnementale, d'audit ou de gestion des risques, couvrant la planification, l'exécution et la livraison de projets. Rigueur et sens technique, avec la capacité d'approfondir les sujets avec les équipes d'ingénierie afin de comprendre les processus opérationnels dans le cadre de l'évaluation des risques environnementaux.
- Capacité avérée à travailler en profondeur avec de multiples parties prenantes (ingénierie, juridique, affaires publiques, achats, sécurité) pour comprendre les processus opérationnels. Expérience de la communication auprès de publics techniques et non techniques, y compris des parties prenantes ou clients de niveau exécutif.
- Maîtrise de l'ensemble des applications Microsoft Office.

Preferred qualifications

- Aptitude démontrée à responsabiliser les parties prenantes internes et externes (sur plusieurs sites et à distance)  grâce à des mécanismes structurés de pilotage et de gouvernance. Capacité à influencer ses pairs comme des membres de la direction.
- Capacité avérée à gérer efficacement des prestataires tiers.
- Expérience du travail en partenariat avec des conseils juridiques sur la stratégie réglementaire, la réponse aux actions coercitives et la maîtrise des risques de conformité dans un environnement réglementaire à forts enjeux.
- Connaissance de la mise en œuvre ou de la certification des systèmes de management environnemental ISO 14001 et ISO 50001.
- Expérience opérationnelle concrète en gestion d'entrepôt et en logistique.
- Diplôme de niveau Master en sciences de l'environnement, en génie de l'environnement ou dans un domaine connexe, ou qualification de niveau équivalent selon le Cadre européen des certifications (CEC).

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
